function vxDashShowAllImportant(event) {
  if (event && event.preventDefault) event.preventDefault();
  if (event && event.stopPropagation) event.stopPropagation();
  if (typeof vxGoToAnfragenFilter === 'function') {
    vxGoToAnfragenFilter('offen', 'all');
  } else {
    dashPriorityExpanded = true;
    try { renderDashPriorityList(); } catch(e) {}
    var section = document.getElementById('dash-priority-section');
    if (section && section.scrollIntoView) section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  }
  return false;
}

function renderDashPriorityList() {
  var el = document.getElementById('dash-priority-list');
  if (!el) return;

  var records = (_dashPriorityAllRecords || []).filter(function(rec){ return isManualTaskRecord(rec) || isCustomerVisibleCall(rec); });
  el.classList.add('dpr-command-center');
  // Launch guard: "Laufende Anrufe" darf ausschliesslich echte Live-Calls zeigen.
  // Completed-/duration-Calls mit fehlender Summary sind normale Anfragen, keine temporären Live-Zeilen.
  var tempRecords = [];

  if (records.length === 0 && tempRecords.length === 0) {
    vxSetHtmlIfChanged(el, '<div style="padding:24px 20px;text-align:center;color:var(--slate2);font-size:13px;background:#fff;">' +
      '<i class="ph-bold ph-check-circle" style="color:#059669;margin-bottom:8px;"></i><br>' +
      'Alles erledigt &mdash; ' + getAssistantName() + ' nimmt neue Anrufe entgegen.</div>');
    refreshLucideIcons();
    return;
  }

  var limit = dashPriorityExpanded ? 999 : 5;
  var visible = records.slice(0, limit);
  var tempKeys = new Set();
  tempRecords.forEach(function(rec){
    var f = (rec && rec.fields) || {};
    var recIdKey = String((rec && rec.id) || '').trim();
    var callIdKey = String(f.call_id || '').trim();
    if (recIdKey) tempKeys.add(recIdKey);
    if (callIdKey) tempKeys.add(callIdKey);
  });
  var groups = { overdue: [], today: [], planned: [], calls: [] };
  var groupOrder = ['overdue', 'today', 'planned', 'calls'];

  visible.forEach(function(rec) {
    var keyF = (rec && rec.fields) || {};
    var recIdKey = String(rec.id || '').trim();
    var callIdKey = String(keyF.call_id || '').trim();
    if ((recIdKey && tempKeys.has(recIdKey)) || (callIdKey && tempKeys.has(callIdKey))) return;
    var typeMeta = vxDashGetCommandTypeMeta(rec);
    var dueMeta = vxDashGetDueMeta(rec, typeMeta);
    var key = groups[dueMeta.group] ? dueMeta.group : 'today';
    groups[key].push({ record: rec, typeMeta: typeMeta, dueMeta: dueMeta });
  });

  var html = '';

  if (tempRecords.length) {
    var maxTemp = tempRecords.slice(0, 3);
    html += '<div class="dpr-group dpr-group-calls">';
    html += '<div class="vx-group-head"><span class="vx-group-label"><i class="ph-bold ph-phone-incoming" aria-hidden="true"></i>Laufende Anrufe</span><span class="vx-group-count">' + tempRecords.length + '</span></div>';
    maxTemp.forEach(function(rec){
      var f = rec.fields || {};
      var st = (typeof vxGetCallDisplayState === 'function' ? vxGetCallDisplayState(rec) : null) || (typeof vxGetDefaultCallDisplayState === 'function' ? vxGetDefaultCallDisplayState() : { state:'ready', label:'Neu', isTemporary:false });
      var name = vxDashResolveWorkTitle(rec);

      html += '<div class="vx-row-icon is-call"><i class="ph-bold ph-phone-incoming"></i></div><div class="vx-row-body">';
      html += '<div class="vx-row-name">'+_esc(name)+'<span class="vx-row-pill">'+_esc(st.label)+'</span></div>';

===== _esc | LINES 11067-12717 =====
function _esc(str) {
  return String(str||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
}
// [PR-B] vxLabel — zentrale DE-Labels für alle Badges, Status, Kategorien
function vxLabel(key) {
  var MAP = {
    'new':'Neu','open':'Offen','in_progress':'In Bearbeitung','closed':'Erledigt',
    'hot':'Heiss','warm':'Warm','cold':'Kalt',
    'sonstiges':'Sonstiges','schadenmeldung_akut':'Schadenmeldung (dringend)',
    'schadenmeldung_nicht_akut':'Schadenmeldung','pannenhilfe':'Pannenhilfe',
    'offerte':'Offerte','termin':'Termin','vertrags_aenderung':'Vertragsänderung',
    'vertrags_änderung':'Vertragsänderung','kuendigung':'Kündigung','kündigung':'Kündigung',
    'allgemeine_frage':'Allgemeine Frage','callback_requested':'Rückruf','urgent':'Dringend',
    'planned':'Geplant','archived':'Archiviert'
  };
  var k = String(key||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  return MAP[k] || (k ? k.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + k.slice(1) : '');
}
function _formatDuration(sec) {
  var s = Math.round(Number(sec)||0);
  if (s < 60) return s + ' Sek.';
  var m = Math.floor(s/60); var r = s%60;
  return m + ' Min.' + (r > 0 ? ' ' + r + ' Sek.' : '');
}
function _formatRelativeTime(ts) {
  var now = new Date();
  var d = null;
  try {
    if (typeof parseCallTimestamp === 'function') d = parseCallTimestamp(ts);
  } catch(e) { d = null; }
  if (!d || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
    var tsStr = String(ts||'').trim();
    if (tsStr && !tsStr.endsWith('Z') && !tsStr.includes('+') && tsStr.length >= 16) tsStr += 'Z';
    d = new Date(tsStr);
  }
  if (!d || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  // Zürich-Timezone für alle Zeitanzeigen
  var tz = 'Europe/Zurich';
  var formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('de-CH', { timeZone: tz, hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit', hour12:false });
  var dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('de-CH', { timeZone: tz, day:'2-digit', month:'2-digit', year:'numeric' });
  var dayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('de-CH', { timeZone: tz, year:'numeric', month:'2-digit', day:'2-digit' });
  // Heute/Gestern-Vergleich in Zürich-Zeit
  var zurichParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('de-CH', { timeZone: tz, year:'numeric', month:'2-digit', day:'2-digit' }).formatToParts(d);
  var zurichDay = zurichParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='day';});
  var zurichMonth = zurichParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='month';});
  var zurichYear = zurichParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='year';});
  var nowParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('de-CH', { timeZone: tz, year:'numeric', month:'2-digit', day:'2-digit' }).formatToParts(now);
  var nowDay = nowParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='day';});
  var nowMonth = nowParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='month';});
  var nowYear = nowParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='year';});
  var isToday = zurichDay && zurichDay.value === nowDay.value && zurichMonth.value === nowMonth.value && zurichYear.value === nowYear.value;
  var nowDate = new Date(now);
  var yesterdayNow = new Date(now.getTime() - 86400000);
  var yesterdayParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('de-CH', { timeZone: tz, year:'numeric', month:'2-digit', day:'2-digit' }).formatToParts(yesterdayNow);
  var ydDay = yesterdayParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='day';});
  var ydMonth = yesterdayParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='month';});
  var ydYear = yesterdayParts.find(function(p){return p.type==='year';});
  var isYesterday = zurichDay && zurichDay.value === ydDay.value && zurichMonth.value === ydMonth.value && zurichYear.value === ydYear.value;
  var hhmm = formatter.format(d);
  if (isToday) return 'Heute, ' + hhmm;
  if (isYesterday) return 'Gestern, ' + hhmm;
  return dateFormatter.format(d);
}

function vxSetActiveRequestRow(recordId) {
  var activeId = recordId == null ? '' : String(recordId).trim();
  window._vxActiveRecordId = activeId || null;
  var selectors = [
    '#anrufe-list .dpr-card',
    '#anrufe-list .vx-heute-row',
    '#anrufe-list .vx-anf-row',
    '#anrufe-split-left .dpr-card',
    '#anrufe-split-left .vx-heute-row',
    '#anrufe-split-left .vx-anf-row',
    '#dash-priority-list .dpr-card'
  ].join(',');
  document.querySelectorAll(selectors).forEach(function(el) {
    var id = '';
    if (el && el.dataset) {
      id = String(el.dataset.id || el.dataset.recordId || '');
    }
    if (!id && el && el.closest) {
      var card = el.closest('.dpr-card');
      id = card && card.dataset ? String(card.dataset.id || card.dataset.recordId || '') : '';
    }
    el.classList.toggle('sp-active', !!activeId && id === activeId);
  });
}
window.vxSetActiveRequestRow = vxSetActiveRequestRow;

  vxSetActiveRequestRow(null);

function dprOpenAnfragenDetailFromRow(rowEl) {

  if (!rowEl || !rowEl.closest) return false;

  // vx-anf-row hat data-id direkt; dpr-card als Fallback
  var recId = (rowEl.dataset && rowEl.dataset.id) || null;
  if (!recId) {
    var card = rowEl.closest('.dpr-card');
    recId = card ? card.dataset.id : null;
  }
  if (!recId) return false;
  var rec = typeof vxResolveDprRecord === 'function' ? vxResolveDprRecord(recId) : null;

function vxOpenPriorityRecord(recordId) {
  var recId = String(recordId || '').trim();
  if (!recId) return false;
  var rec = typeof vxResolveDprRecord === 'function' ? vxResolveDprRecord(recId) : null;
  if (!rec) {
    var all = (Array.isArray(window.allRecords) ? window.allRecords : []);
    rec = all.find(function(r){ return String((r && r.id) || '') === recId; }) || null;
  }
  if (!rec) return false;
  window._vxActiveRecordId = recId;
  window._vxLastAnfragenRecordId = recId;
  if (typeof vxSetAnfragenActive === 'function') vxSetAnfragenActive(recId);
  if (rec && typeof isManualTaskRecord === 'function' && isManualTaskRecord(rec)) {
    if (typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') { showTaskDetail(recId); return true; }
    return false;
  }
  if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recId); return true; }
  return false;
}

function dprToggleClick(e, rowEl) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  if (window._vxInboxSelectionMode && rowEl && rowEl.closest && rowEl.closest('#anrufe-list, #anrufe-split-left')) {
    return;
  }
  // Touch-Geräte: click nach touchend ignorieren
  if (e.type === 'click' && (Date.now() - _dprLastTouch) < 800) return;
  if (e.target.closest('.dpr-btn, .dpr-quick-btn, .vx-ibtn, button')) return;
  var _clickedCard = rowEl && rowEl.closest ? rowEl.closest('.dpr-card') : null;
  var _clickedId = (rowEl && rowEl.dataset && (rowEl.dataset.id || rowEl.dataset.recordId)) || (_clickedCard && _clickedCard.dataset ? _clickedCard.dataset.id : '');
  if (_clickedId && typeof vxSetActiveRequestRow === 'function') vxSetActiveRequestRow(_clickedId);
  if (_dprToggleLock) return;
  _dprToggleLock = true;
  setTimeout(function(){ _dprToggleLock = false; }, 400);
  // Als gelesen markieren — Punkt entfernen
  vxMarkRowAsRead(rowEl);
  // Anfragen Split: Klick → direkt Detail-Seite
  if (dprOpenAnfragenDetailFromRow(rowEl)) return;
  // [v3.0] Heute-Tab → immer Detail-Seite (kein Expand)
  var inHeuteList = rowEl.closest('#dash-priority-list');
  if (inHeuteList) {
    var recId = rowEl.dataset.id || rowEl.getAttribute('data-record-id');
    if (recId && vxOpenPriorityRecord(recId)) return;
  }
  _dprToggleExec(rowEl);
}

function dprToggleTouchStart(e, rowEl) {
  _dprTouchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
  _dprTouchMoved = false;
  rowEl._dprPendingEl = rowEl;
}

function dprToggleTouchMove(e) {
  if (Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - _dprTouchStartY) > 12) {
    _dprTouchMoved = true;
  }
}

function dprToggleTouchEnd(e, rowEl) {
  if (_dprTouchMoved) return; // War ein Scroll — ignorieren
  if (window._vxInboxSelectionMode && rowEl && rowEl.closest && rowEl.closest('#anrufe-list, #anrufe-split-left')) return;
  if (e.target.closest('.dpr-btn, .dpr-quick-btn, .vx-ibtn, button')) return;
  // [v2.65 FIX] Long-Press hat Context-Menu geöffnet — Card-Aktion unterdrücken
  if (window._vxLongPressActive) return;
  _dprLastTouch = Date.now();
  var _touchedCard = rowEl && rowEl.closest ? rowEl.closest('.dpr-card') : null;
  var _touchedId = (rowEl && rowEl.dataset && (rowEl.dataset.id || rowEl.dataset.recordId)) || (_touchedCard && _touchedCard.dataset ? _touchedCard.dataset.id : '');
  if (_touchedId && typeof vxSetActiveRequestRow === 'function') vxSetActiveRequestRow(_touchedId);
  if (_dprToggleLock) return;
  _dprToggleLock = true;
  setTimeout(function(){ _dprToggleLock = false; }, 600);
  // Als gelesen markieren — Punkt entfernen
  vxMarkRowAsRead(rowEl);
  if (dprOpenAnfragenDetailFromRow(rowEl)) {
    try { e.preventDefault(); } catch(_e) {}
    return;
  }
  // [v3.0] Heute-Tab → immer Detail-Seite (kein Expand)
  var inHeuteList = rowEl.closest('#dash-priority-list');
  if (inHeuteList) {
    var recId = rowEl.dataset.id || rowEl.getAttribute('data-record-id');
    if (recId && vxOpenPriorityRecord(recId)) { try { e.preventDefault(); } catch(_e) {} return; }
  }
  _dprToggleExec(rowEl);
}

function _dprToggleExec(rowEl) {
  var id = rowEl.dataset.id;
  var container = rowEl.closest('#dash-priority-list, #anrufe-list, .call-list');
  var containerId = container ? (container.id || 'default') : 'default';
  var currentOpen = _dprOpenIds[containerId];
  if (currentOpen === id) {
    dprCloseAll(container);
    _dprOpenIds[containerId] = null;
    _dprOpenId = null;
  } else {
    dprCloseAll(container);
    dprOpen(rowEl);
    _dprOpenIds[containerId] = id;
    _dprOpenId = id;
  }
}

// [PATCH v2.39] Nach Re-Render offenen Row pro Container wiederherstellen
function dprRestoreOpen(containerId) {
  // Mit Container-ID: nur diese Liste wiederherstellen
  if (containerId) {
    var openId = _dprOpenIds[containerId];
    if (!openId) return;
    var container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!container) return;
    var row = container.querySelector('.dpr-row[data-id="' + openId + '"]');
    if (row) dprOpen(row);
    return;
  }
  // Ohne Container-ID: alle Listen wiederherstellen
  Object.keys(_dprOpenIds).forEach(function(cid) {
    var openId = _dprOpenIds[cid];
    if (!openId) return;
    var container = document.getElementById(cid);
    if (!container) return;
    var row = container.querySelector('.dpr-row[data-id="' + openId + '"]');
    if (row) dprOpen(row);
  });
}

function dprCloseAll(container) {
  if (!container) return;
  container.querySelectorAll('.dpr-exp').forEach(function(e){ e.style.display = 'none'; });
  container.querySelectorAll('.dpr-row').forEach(function(r){
    r.style.background = '';
    r.style.borderColor = '';
    var c = r.querySelector('[class="ph-bold ph-caret-right"]');
    if (c) { c.style.transform = ''; c.style.color = ''; }
  });
}

function dprOpen(rowEl) {
  var card = rowEl.closest('.dpr-card');
  if (!card) return;
  var exp = card.querySelector('.dpr-exp');
  if (!exp) return;
  exp.style.display = 'block';
  var chev = rowEl.querySelector('[class="ph-bold ph-caret-right"]');
  if (chev) { chev.style.transform = 'rotate(90deg)'; chev.style.color = 'var(--blue)'; }
  rowEl.style.background = '#F7F9FF';
}

function dprToggle(rowEl) {
  var card = rowEl.closest('.dpr-card');
  if (!card) return;
  var exp = card.querySelector('.dpr-exp');
  if (!exp) return;
  var isOpen = exp.style.display !== 'none';

  // Alle anderen schliessen
  if (!isOpen) {
    var container = card.closest('#dash-priority-list, #anrufe-list, .call-list');
    if (container) {
      container.querySelectorAll('.dpr-exp').forEach(function(e) {
        e.style.display = 'none';
      });
      container.querySelectorAll('.dpr-row').forEach(function(r) {
        r.style.background = '';
        r.style.borderColor = '';
        var c = r.querySelector('[class="ph-bold ph-caret-right"]');
        if (c) { c.style.transform = ''; c.style.color = ''; }
      });
    }
  }

  exp.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';
  var chev = rowEl.querySelector('[class="ph-bold ph-caret-right"]');
  if (chev) {
    chev.style.transform = isOpen ? '' : 'rotate(90deg)';
    chev.style.color = isOpen ? 'var(--slate2)' : 'var(--blue)';
  }
  rowEl.style.background = isOpen ? '' : '#F7F9FF';
  rowEl.style.borderColor = isOpen ? '' : 'var(--blue-mid, #B9D4FF)';
}

function dprAction(action, recId, extra) {
  var sourceRec = (typeof vxResolveDprRecord === 'function') ? vxResolveDprRecord(recId) : ((typeof allRecords !== 'undefined' ? allRecords : []).find(function(r){ return r.id === recId; })
    || (typeof allManualTaskRecords !== 'undefined' ? allManualTaskRecords : []).find(function(r){ return r.id === recId; }));
  var isManualSource = !!(sourceRec && isManualTaskRecord(sourceRec));
  var actionLifecycle = (typeof vxRowActionLifecycle === 'function') ? vxRowActionLifecycle(sourceRec) : '';
  var actionIsDone = actionLifecycle === 'done' || actionLifecycle === 'archived';
  var actionIsArchived = actionLifecycle === 'archived';
  if (action === 'call') {
    var fCall = (sourceRec && sourceRec.fields) || {};
    var phoneForDial = extra || fCall.phone || fCall.caller_phone || fCall.tel_link || '';
    if (typeof vxOpenTelHref === 'function') {
      if (!vxOpenTelHref(phoneForDial, 'Keine gültige Telefonnummer vorhanden')) {
        if (isManualSource && typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') showTaskDetail(recId);
        else if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') showCallDetail(recId);
      }
    } else {
      var dialPhone = String(phoneForDial || '').replace(/[^+0-9]/g, '');
      if (dialPhone) window.location.href = 'tel:' + dialPhone;
      else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('⚠️ Keine gültige Telefonnummer vorhanden');
    }
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'done') {
    if (actionIsDone) {
      if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Dieser Eintrag ist bereits erledigt.', 'info');
      else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Dieser Eintrag ist bereits erledigt.');
      return;
    }
    if (typeof vxGuardDoneAction === 'function' && vxGuardDoneAction(recId, 'dprAction.done')) return;
    var row = document.querySelector('.dpr-card[data-id="'+recId+'"]');
    if (typeof confirmTaskDone === 'function') {
      confirmTaskDone(recId, row, 'list-quick-action');
    } else if (typeof markTaskDoneDirectly === 'function') {
      markTaskDoneDirectly(recId, '');
    }
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'archive') {
    if (actionIsArchived) {
      if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Dieser Eintrag ist bereits archiviert.', 'info');
      else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Dieser Eintrag ist bereits archiviert.');
      return;
    }
    var archiveRow = document.querySelector('.dpr-card[data-id="'+recId+'"]');
    if (isManualSource) {
      openConfirmModal({
        title: 'Aufgabe archivieren?',
        text: 'Diese Aufgabe wird aus der aktiven Ansicht entfernt und bleibt im Verlauf nachvollziehbar.',
        confirmLabel: 'Archivieren',
        loadingLabel: 'Archiviere...',
        tone: 'primary',
        onConfirm: async function(){ return await doStatusChange(recId, CALL_STATUS.ARCHIVED, archiveRow || null); }
      });
    } else if (typeof confirmArchiveInquiry === 'function') {
      confirmArchiveInquiry(recId, archiveRow);
    } else if (typeof doStatusChange === 'function') {
      doStatusChange(recId, CALL_STATUS.ARCHIVED, archiveRow || null);
    }
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'reopen') {
    var reopenRow = document.querySelector('.dpr-card[data-id="'+recId+'"]');
    if (typeof doStatusChange === 'function') doStatusChange(recId, CALL_STATUS.NEW, reopenRow || null);
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'mark-read') {
    vxMarkRequestAsRead(recId);
    renderAnrufe();
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'mark-unread') {
    if (typeof vxIsUnreadEligibleRecord === 'function' && !vxIsUnreadEligibleRecord(sourceRec)) {
      if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Ungelesen ist nur für neue eingehende Anrufe relevant.', 'info');
      return;
    }
    vxMarkRequestAsUnread(recId);
    renderAnrufe();
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'copy-phone') {
    var fPhone = (sourceRec && sourceRec.fields) || {};
    var phoneToCopy = extra || fPhone.caller_phone || fPhone.phone_number || fPhone.phone || '';
    if (navigator.clipboard && phoneToCopy) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(phoneToCopy)).then(function(){
        if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Telefonnummer kopiert', 'success');
      }).catch(function(){
        if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Telefonnummer konnte nicht kopiert werden', 'warning');
      });
    } else if (typeof toast === 'function') {
      toast('Keine Telefonnummer vorhanden', 'warning');
    }
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'copy-details') {
    var src = (sourceRec && sourceRec.fields) || {};
    var txt = [src.caller_name || src.name || '', src.caller_phone || src.phone || '', src.call_summary || src.summary || src.note || ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    if (navigator.clipboard && txt) navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).catch(function(){});
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'create-task') {
    if (typeof openManualTaskFromCall === 'function') { openManualTaskFromCall(recId); return; }
    if (typeof openManualTaskModal === 'function') { openManualTaskModal(); return; }
    if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recId); return; }
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'schedule-callback') {
    if (typeof openFollowupDirect === 'function') { openFollowupDirect(recId); return; }
    if (isManualSource && typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') { showTaskDetail(recId); return; }
    if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recId); return; }
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'followup') {
    if (isManualSource) {
      if (typeof openManualTaskEditModal === 'function') openManualTaskEditModal(recId);
      else if (typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') showTaskDetail(recId);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof openFollowupDirect === 'function') { openFollowupDirect(recId); return; }
    if (typeof openFollowup === 'function') { openFollowup(recId); return; }
    if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recId); }
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'open') {
    if (isManualSource) { if (typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') showTaskDetail(recId); return; }
    if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recId); return; }
    if (typeof vxOpenDetailV2 === 'function') vxOpenDetailV2(recId);
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'fulldetail') {
    // [v2.56] Vollansicht aus Split-Panel: immer showCallDetail, nie recursive
    if (isManualSource) { if (typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') showTaskDetail(recId); return; }
    if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recId); return; }
    if (typeof vxOpenDetailV2 === 'function') vxOpenDetailV2(recId);
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'detail' || action === 'edit') {
    // Aufgaben: Bearbeiten öffnet direkt das Aufgaben-Modal; Details bleiben Vollansicht.
    if (isManualSource) {
      if (action === 'edit' && typeof openManualTaskEditModal === 'function') openManualTaskEditModal(recId);
      else if (typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') showTaskDetail(recId);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recId); return; }
    if (typeof vxOpenDetailV2 === 'function') vxOpenDetailV2(recId);
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'followup') {
    if (typeof openFollowupDirect === 'function') { openFollowupDirect(recId); return; }
    if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recId); return; }
    return;
  }
  if (action === 'note') {
    if (typeof vxOpenDetailV2 === 'function') { vxOpenDetailV2(recId); return; }
    var rec = (typeof allRecords !== 'undefined' ? allRecords : []).find(function(r){ return r.id === recId; });
    var f = rec ? (rec.fields || {}) : {};
    if (typeof openNotiz === 'function') {
      openNotiz(recId, encodeURIComponent(f.notes_customer_voxera||''), encodeURIComponent(f.caller_name||''));
    }
    return;
  }
}

function normalizeContractStatus(status) {
  return String(status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
}

function contractRecencyScore(row) {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return 0;
  var updatedAt = new Date(row.updated_at || 0).getTime();
  var createdAt = new Date(row.created_at || 0).getTime();
  var startDate = new Date(row.start_date || 0).getTime();
  var maxTs = Math.max(
    Number.isFinite(updatedAt) ? updatedAt : 0,
    Number.isFinite(createdAt) ? createdAt : 0,
    Number.isFinite(startDate) ? startDate : 0
  );
  return Number.isFinite(maxTs) ? maxTs : 0;
}

function deriveContractState(contractRows) {
  const rows = Array.isArray(contractRows) ? [...contractRows] : [];
  rows.sort(function(a, b) {
    return contractRecencyScore(b) - contractRecencyScore(a);
  });
  const latest = rows.length ? rows[0] : null;
  const activeContract = rows.find(function(row) {
    return ACTIVE_CONTRACT_STATUSES.has(normalizeContractStatus((row && (row.status != null ? row.status : row.contract_status)) || ''));
  }) || null;
  const effectiveContract = activeContract || latest || null;
  const effectiveStatus = normalizeContractStatus((effectiveContract && (effectiveContract.status != null ? effectiveContract.status : effectiveContract.contract_status)) || '') || 'none';
  return {
    status: effectiveStatus,
    hasContract: rows.length > 0,
    hasActiveContract: !!activeContract,
    latestContract: latest,
    effectiveContract: effectiveContract
  };
}

function resolveHasActiveContractFromState(stateLike) {
  const state = stateLike && typeof stateLike === 'object' ? stateLike : {};
  if (state.hasActiveContract === true) return true;
  const status = normalizeContractStatus(state.status);
  if (ACTIVE_CONTRACT_STATUSES.has(status)) return true;
  const effective = state.effectiveContract || state.latestContract || null;
  const effectiveStatus = normalizeContractStatus((effective && (effective.status != null ? effective.status : effective.contract_status)) || '');
  return ACTIVE_CONTRACT_STATUSES.has(effectiveStatus);
}

function hasActiveContractAccess() {
  return !!(customerContractState && customerContractState.hasActiveContract);
}

function hasResolvedContractState() {
  return !!(customerContractState && customerContractState.resolution === 'resolved');
}

function hasKnownInactiveContract() {
  return !!(
    hasResolvedContractState()
    && customerContractState
    && customerContractState.hasContract === true
    && customerContractState.hasActiveContract !== true
  );
}

function isContractRestrictedState() {
  return hasKnownInactiveContract();
}

function hasActivationStateToResume() {
  // [legacy] Always returns false in simplified flow
  return false;
}

function scheduleRealtimeLoad(reason) {
  if (realtimeSuppressUntil > 0 && Date.now() < realtimeSuppressUntil) return;
  if (realtimeLoadDebounceTimer) clearTimeout(realtimeLoadDebounceTimer);
  realtimeLoadDebounceTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    realtimeLoadDebounceTimer = null;
    loadData().catch(function(err) {
      console.error('[realtime-sync] loadData failed', { reason: reason || 'unknown', error: err && err.message ? err.message : err });
    });
  }, 250);
}

function teardownDashboardRealtime() {
  if (!_sb || !dashboardRealtimeChannel) return;
  try {
    _sb.removeChannel(dashboardRealtimeChannel);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[realtime-sync] removeChannel failed', err);
  }
  dashboardRealtimeChannel = null;
  dashboardRealtimeKey = '';
}

function setupDashboardRealtime(customerIdRaw) {
  if (!_sb || typeof _sb.channel !== 'function') return;
  const customerId = String(customerIdRaw || '').trim();
  if (!customerId) {
    teardownDashboardRealtime();
    return;
  }
  const nextKey = `dashboard:${customerId}`;
  if (dashboardRealtimeChannel && dashboardRealtimeKey === nextKey) return;
  teardownDashboardRealtime();
  const channelName = `customer-dashboard-${customerId}`;
  const channel = _sb
    .channel(channelName)
    .on('postgres_changes', {
      event: '*',
      schema: 'public',
      table: 'calls',
      filter: `customer_id=eq.${customerId}`
    }, function(payload) {
      var next = (payload && payload.new) || null;
      var nextId = next && next.id != null ? String(next.id) : '';
      var nextLiveStatus = String((next && next.live_status) || '').toLowerCase();
      var isTerminalLiveStatus = CALL_LIVE_TERMINAL_STATES.has(nextLiveStatus);
      if (nextId && isTerminalLiveStatus && Array.isArray(allRecords) && allRecords.length) {
        var idx = allRecords.findIndex(function(r) { return String((r && r.id) || '') === nextId; });
        if (idx >= 0 && allRecords[idx] && allRecords[idx].fields) {
          allRecords[idx].fields.live_status = next.live_status;
          if (next.updated_at) allRecords[idx].fields.updated_at = next.updated_at;
          if (next.completed_at) allRecords[idx].fields.completed_at = next.completed_at;
          if (next.duration_seconds !== undefined) allRecords[idx].fields.duration_seconds = next.duration_seconds;
        }
      }
      if (isTerminalLiveStatus) {
        // Terminal-Callbacks müssen LIVE sofort ausblenden (keine künstliche Nachlaufzeit).
        renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
        renderAnrufe();
      }
      scheduleRealtimeLoad(isTerminalLiveStatus ? 'calls-terminal-change' : 'calls-change');
    })
    .on('postgres_changes', {
      event: '*',
      schema: 'public',
      table: 'customer_tasks',
      filter: `customer_id=eq.${customerId}`
    }, function() {
      scheduleRealtimeLoad('cases-change');
    })
    .on('postgres_changes', {
      event: '*',
      schema: 'public',
      table: 'customers',
      filter: `id=eq.${customerId}`
    }, function() {
      scheduleRealtimeLoad('customer-change');
    })
    .subscribe(function(status) {
      if (status === 'CHANNEL_ERROR' || status === 'TIMED_OUT') {
        console.warn('[realtime-sync] channel degraded, polling fallback remains active', { status: status, customerId: customerId });
      }
    });
  dashboardRealtimeChannel = channel;
  dashboardRealtimeKey = nextKey;
}

function getContractStatusLabel(status) {
  const normalized = normalizeContractStatus(status);
  if (normalized === 'active') return 'Aktiv';
  if (normalized === 'signed') return 'Unterzeichnet';
  if (normalized === 'expired') return 'Abgelaufen';
  if (normalized === 'cancelled') return 'Gekündigt';
  if (normalized === 'pending' || normalized === 'pending_review') return 'Ausstehend';
  if (normalized === 'draft') return 'Entwurf';
  return normalized ? normalized.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + normalized.slice(1) : 'Nicht vorhanden';
}

function getRestrictedContractMessage(scopeLabel) {
  var scope = scopeLabel ? String(scopeLabel).trim() : 'Dieser Bereich';
  return scope + ' ist ohne aktiven Vertrag nicht verfügbar.';
}

  try {
    vxDebugInfo('[manual-task-done-flow]', stage, payload || {});
  } catch (_e) {}
}

function applyContractAccessStateToUI() {
  var restricted = isContractRestrictedState();
  var contractStatusLabel = getContractStatusLabel(customerContractState && customerContractState.status);
  var banner = document.getElementById('contract-access-banner');
  if (banner) {
    if (restricted) {
      banner.style.display = 'block';
      banner.textContent = 'Ihr Vertrag ist derzeit nicht aktiv (' + contractStatusLabel + '). Einstellungen und Erreichbarkeitsänderungen sind vorübergehend gesperrt.';
    } else {
      banner.style.display = 'none';
      banner.textContent = '';
    }
  }

  var wizardBtn = document.getElementById('settings-wizard-btn');
  if (wizardBtn) {
    wizardBtn.disabled = restricted;
    wizardBtn.textContent = restricted ? 'Erreichbarkeit nicht verfügbar' : (isSetupComplete() ? 'Erneut öffnen' : 'Einrichtungsassistent öffnen');
    wizardBtn.title = restricted ? 'Ohne aktiven Vertrag sind Erreichbarkeitsänderungen gesperrt.' : '';
  }

  ['notif-card-none', 'notif-card-callback', 'notif-card-all'].forEach(function(id) {
    var card = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!card) return;
    card.style.pointerEvents = restricted ? 'none' : 'auto';
    card.style.opacity = restricted ? '0.58' : '1';
    card.setAttribute('aria-disabled', restricted ? 'true' : 'false');
  });

  // [v2.55] taskBtn war im gelöschten tab-rueckrufe — zeigt jetzt auf Anfragen-Tab
  var taskBtn = document.querySelector('#tab-anrufe button[onclick*="openManualTaskModal"]');
  if (taskBtn) {
    taskBtn.disabled = restricted;
    taskBtn.style.opacity = restricted ? '.55' : '1';
    taskBtn.style.pointerEvents = restricted ? 'none' : 'auto';
    taskBtn.title = restricted ? 'Ohne aktiven Vertrag können keine neuen Aufgaben erstellt werden.' : '';
  }
}

function toDashboardRecord(row) {
  return { id: String(row.id), fields: row };
}

// Canonical timestamp helper: returns the Supabase insertion time (created_at).
/**
 * Returns the best available timestamp for a dashboard record.
 * @param {Object} record - Dashboard record ({ id, fields })
 * @returns {string|null} ISO-8601 string from created_at, or null if absent.
 */
function getRecordTimestamp(record) {
  const f = (record && record.fields) || {};
  return f.created_at || null;
}

function resolveFollowUpAt(fields) {
  if (!fields) return '';
  return fields.follow_up_at || fields.followup_at || fields.followUpAt || fields.follow_up || '';
}

function normalizeTaskStatus(rawStatus) {
  const raw = String(rawStatus || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (raw === 'closed' || raw === 'done' || raw === 'abgeschlossen' || raw === 'resolved' || raw === 'erledigt') return 'done';
  if (raw === 'waiting_external' || raw === 'waiting') return 'in_progress';
  if (raw === 'planned' || raw === 'scheduled' || raw === 'geplant' || raw === 'follow_up_scheduled') return 'planned';
  if (raw === 'in_progress' || raw === 'follow_up_scheduled' || raw === 'in bearbeitung') return 'in_progress';
  if (raw === 'archived' || raw === 'archiviert' || raw === 'deleted' || raw === 'cancelled') return 'archived';
  return 'open';
}

/* PR-M — Entry lifecycle source of truth.
   One operational status only: archived → done → planned → open.
   Important: callback_requested alone is NOT planned. */
function vxNormalizeStatusToken(value) {
  var raw = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!raw) return '';
  raw = raw.replace(/[\u2010-\u2015]/g, '-').replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  var archivedAliases = ['archived','archive','archiv','archiviert','deleted','gelöscht','geloescht','cancelled','canceled','storniert'];
  var doneAliases = ['done','closed','resolved','erledigt','abgeschlossen','geschlossen','fertig'];
  var plannedAliases = ['planned','geplant','scheduled','followup','follow up','follow up scheduled','follow up geplant','callback planned','callback geplant','rückruf geplant','rueckruf geplant'];
  var openAliases = ['new','neu','open','offen','pending','in progress','in bearbeitung','processing','triaged','waiting external','waiting'];
  if (archivedAliases.indexOf(raw) !== -1) return 'archived';
  if (doneAliases.indexOf(raw) !== -1) return 'done';
  if (plannedAliases.indexOf(raw) !== -1) return 'planned';
  if (openAliases.indexOf(raw) !== -1) return 'open';
  return raw;
}

function vxNormalizeDashboardStatus(value) {
  return vxNormalizeStatusToken(value);
}

function vxRecordField(record, key) {
  var f = (record && record.fields) || {};
  if (record && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record, key)) return record[key];
  return f[key];
}

function vxHasFilledField(record, keys) {
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var val = vxRecordField(record, keys[i]);
    if (val != null && String(val).trim() !== '') return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function vxGetEntryLifecycleStatus(record) {
  if (!record) return 'open';

  var archivedDateFields = ['archived_at','deleted_at'];
  var doneDateFields = ['completed_at','closed_at','done_at','resolved_at'];
  var plannedDateFields = ['callback_at','follow_up_at','followup_at','followUpAt','due_at','due_date','reminder_at','planned_at','task_due_at'];
  var statusFields = ['dashboard_status','status','state','case_status','call_status','live_status'];

  // 1. Archived wins over everything.
  if (vxHasFilledField(record, archivedDateFields)) return 'archived';
  for (var a = 0; a < statusFields.length; a++) {
    if (vxNormalizeStatusToken(vxRecordField(record, statusFields[a])) === 'archived') return 'archived';
  }

  // 2. Done wins over planned/open, even if legacy status still says new.
  if (vxHasFilledField(record, doneDateFields)) return 'done';
  for (var d = 0; d < statusFields.length; d++) {
    if (vxNormalizeStatusToken(vxRecordField(record, statusFields[d])) === 'done') return 'done';
  }

  // 3. Planned only means a real due/follow-up timestamp or explicit planned status.
  if (vxHasFilledField(record, plannedDateFields)) return 'planned';
  for (var p = 0; p < statusFields.length; p++) {
    if (vxNormalizeStatusToken(vxRecordField(record, statusFields[p])) === 'planned') return 'planned';
  }

  // callback_requested alone remains an open request, not a planned one.
  return 'open';
}

function vxIsDoneRecord(record) {
  var lifecycle = vxGetEntryLifecycleStatus(record);
  return lifecycle === 'done' || lifecycle === 'archived';
}

function vxHasPlannedNextAction(record) {
  return vxGetEntryLifecycleStatus(record) === 'planned';
}

function vxIsUnreadEligibleRecord(record) {
  var f = (record && record.fields) || {};
  try { if (typeof isManualTaskRecord === 'function' && isManualTaskRecord(record)) return false; } catch(e) {}
  try { if (typeof vxIsDoneRecord === 'function' && vxIsDoneRecord(record)) return false; } catch(e) {}
  try { if (typeof vxHasPlannedNextAction === 'function' && vxHasPlannedNextAction(record)) return false; } catch(e) {}
  var statusCandidates = [
    record && record.dashboard_status, record && record.status, record && record.live_status,
    f.dashboard_status, f.status, f.live_status
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < statusCandidates.length; i++) {
    var normalized = (typeof vxNormalizeDashboardStatus === 'function') ? vxNormalizeDashboardStatus(statusCandidates[i]) : String(statusCandidates[i] || '').toLowerCase();
    if (normalized === 'done' || normalized === 'planned') return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function vxIsUnreadRecord(record) {
  // [PR-I 2026-05-23] Apple-like unread logic.
  // Ungelesen ist ein eigener Inbox-State, kein Ableitung aus "Offen", "new" oder fehlenden Legacy-Feldern.
  if (!vxIsUnreadEligibleRecord(record)) return false;
  var f = (record && record.fields) || {};
  var id = String((record && record.id) || f.id || record && record.call_id || f.call_id || '').trim();

  function hasOwn(obj, key) {
    return !!obj && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, key);
  }
  function parseBoolFlag(value) {
    if (value === true || value === 1) return true;
    if (value === false || value === 0) return false;
    if (value == null) return null;
    var s = String(value).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (['true','1','yes','ja','y'].indexOf(s) !== -1) return true;
    if (['false','0','no','nein','n',''].indexOf(s) !== -1) return false;
    return null;
  }

  // Manual override aus der aktuellen Session hat Priorität.
  try {
    if (id && typeof vxGetManualUnreadIdSet === 'function' && vxGetManualUnreadIdSet().has(id)) return true;
  } catch(e) {}

  // Explizite Flags korrekt parsen. Wichtig: String "false" darf NICHT truthy als ungelesen zählen.
  var explicitCandidates = [];
  if (hasOwn(record, 'is_unread')) explicitCandidates.push(record.is_unread);
  if (hasOwn(f, 'is_unread')) explicitCandidates.push(f.is_unread);
  if (hasOwn(record, 'unread')) explicitCandidates.push(record.unread);
  if (hasOwn(f, 'unread')) explicitCandidates.push(f.unread);
  for (var i = 0; i < explicitCandidates.length; i++) {
    var parsed = parseBoolFlag(explicitCandidates[i]);
    if (parsed === true) return true;
    if (parsed === false) return false;
  }

  // read_at ist nur aussagekräftig, wenn das Feld wirklich vorhanden ist.
  // Fehlendes read_at bei Legacy-Daten bedeutet NICHT automatisch ungelesen.
  var hasReadAt = hasOwn(record, 'read_at') || hasOwn(f, 'read_at');
  if (hasReadAt) {
    var readAt = hasOwn(record, 'read_at') ? record.read_at : f.read_at;
    if (readAt != null && String(readAt).trim() !== '') return false;
    // Wenn read_at explizit null ist, gilt der Eintrag als ungelesen – ausser er ist lokal bereits gesehen.
    try {
      if (id && typeof getSeenCallIdsFromStorage === 'function' && getSeenCallIdsFromStorage().has(id)) return false;
    } catch(e) {}
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

function vxClassifyRequestRecord(record) {
  var f = (record && record.fields) || {};
  var isDone = vxIsDoneRecord(record);
  var isPlanned = !isDone && vxHasPlannedNextAction(record);
  var isUnread = vxIsUnreadRecord(record);
  var bucket = isDone ? 'done' : (isPlanned ? 'planned' : 'inbox');
  var statusLabel = bucket === 'done' ? 'Erledigt' : (bucket === 'planned' ? 'Geplant' : 'Inbox');
  var statusTone = bucket === 'done' ? 'done' : (bucket === 'planned' ? 'planned' : (isUnread ? 'new' : 'neutral'));
  var reason = isDone
    ? 'status_done_or_closed'
    : (isPlanned ? 'planned_next_action_present' : 'active_without_plan');
  return { bucket: bucket, isUnread: isUnread, statusLabel: statusLabel, statusTone: statusTone, reason: reason };
}

function vxGetRequestCounts(records) {
  var list = Array.isArray(records) ? records.filter(Boolean) : [];
  var counts = { inbox: 0, planned: 0, done: 0, doneToday: 0, unread: 0, read: 0, all: list.length };
  var todayYmd = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  list.forEach(function(rec) {
    var c = vxClassifyRequestRecord(rec);
    counts[c.bucket] += 1;
    if (c.isUnread) counts.unread += 1;
    else counts.read += 1;
    if (c.bucket === 'done') {
      var f = (rec && rec.fields) || {};
      var doneTs = String(
        (rec && (rec.completed_at || rec.updated_at)) ||
        f.completed_at || f.updated_at || ''
      ).trim();
      if (doneTs && doneTs.slice(0, 10) === todayYmd) counts.doneToday += 1;
    }
  });
  // Fallback: If no reliable done timestamp exists in data, doneToday mirrors done for KPI continuity.
  if (counts.done > 0 && counts.doneToday === 0) counts.doneToday = counts.done;
  return counts;
}

function mapCaseStatusToDashboardStatus(caseStatus) {
  const normalized = normalizeTaskStatus(caseStatus);
  if (normalized === 'done') return CALL_STATUS.CLOSED;
  if (normalized === 'in_progress') return CALL_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS;
  return CALL_STATUS.NEW;
}

function taskTypeLabel(rawType) {
  const key = String(rawType || '').trim();
  return MANUAL_TASK_TYPE_OPTIONS[key] || key || 'Allgemeine Aufgabe';
}

function resolveTaskDueAt(fields) {
  if (!fields) return '';
  if (fields.due_at) {
    const dueDate = String(fields.due_at).trim();
    const dueTime = String(fields.due_time || '').trim();
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dueDate) && /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(dueTime)) {
      return `${dueDate}T${dueTime}`;
    }
    return dueDate;
  }
  return resolveFollowUpAt(fields) || '';
}

function getTaskDueRaw(taskOrFields) {
  var fields = (taskOrFields && taskOrFields.fields) ? taskOrFields.fields : (taskOrFields || {});
  var dueAt = String(fields.due_at || '').trim();
  if (dueAt) {
    var dueTime = String(fields.due_time || '').trim();
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dueAt) && /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(dueTime)) return dueAt + 'T' + dueTime;
    return dueAt;
  }
  return String(fields.follow_up_at || fields.followup_at || fields.followUpAt || fields.follow_up || '').trim();
}

function parseTaskDueAt(taskOrFields) {
  var raw = getTaskDueRaw(taskOrFields);
  if (!raw) return null;
  var d = parseFollowUpDate(raw);
  return (d && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) ? d : null;
}

// PATCH v2.63 — Heute Due Sorting & Time Requirement
// Source of truth: customer_tasks.due_at + customer_tasks.due_time, calls.follow_up_at.
// No synthetic DB values are created here; missing due_time is treated as a data issue and sorted after timed items on the same date.
function vxIsManualTaskDueRecord(recordOrFields) {
  var f = (recordOrFields && recordOrFields.fields) ? recordOrFields.fields : (recordOrFields || {});
  return !!(f && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(f, 'due_at'));
}

function vxParseDueDateOnly(dueDate) {
  var m = String(dueDate || '').trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
  if (!m) return null;
  return new Date(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), 0, 0, 0, 0);
}

function vxGetDueSortMeta(recordOrFields) {
  var f = (recordOrFields && recordOrFields.fields) ? recordOrFields.fields : (recordOrFields || {});
  var dueAt = String(f.due_at || '').trim();
  var dueTime = String(f.due_time || '').trim();
  var validDueTime = normalizeManualTaskDueTime(dueTime);

  if (dueAt) {
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dueAt)) {
      var dateOnly = vxParseDueDateOnly(dueAt);
      if (!dateOnly || Number.isNaN(dateOnly.getTime())) {
        return { hasDue:false, hasTime:false, missingTime:false, raw:'', date:null, sortMs:Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, source:'manual_due_invalid' };
      }
      if (validDueTime) {
        var timedRaw = dueAt + 'T' + validDueTime;
        var timedDate = parseFollowUpDate(timedRaw);
        return {
          hasDue: !!(timedDate && !Number.isNaN(timedDate.getTime())),
          hasTime: true,
          missingTime: false,
          raw: timedRaw,
          date: timedDate,
          sortMs: timedDate && !Number.isNaN(timedDate.getTime()) ? timedDate.getTime() : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
          source: 'manual_due'
        };
      }
      var endOfDay = new Date(dateOnly.getFullYear(), dateOnly.getMonth(), dateOnly.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999);
      return {
        hasDue: true,
        hasTime: false,
        missingTime: true,
        raw: dueAt,
        date: dateOnly,
        sortMs: endOfDay.getTime(),
        source: 'manual_due_missing_time'
      };
    }
    var parsedDueAt = parseFollowUpDate(dueAt);
    if (parsedDueAt && !Number.isNaN(parsedDueAt.getTime())) {
      return {
        hasDue: true,
        hasTime: hasMeaningfulDueTime({ due_at: dueAt }),
        missingTime: !hasMeaningfulDueTime({ due_at: dueAt }),
        raw: dueAt,
        date: parsedDueAt,
        sortMs: parsedDueAt.getTime(),
        source: 'manual_due_legacy'
      };
    }
  }

  var followUp = resolveFollowUpAt(f);
  if (followUp) {
    var followDate = parseFollowUpDate(followUp);
    if (followDate && !Number.isNaN(followDate.getTime())) {
      return {
        hasDue: true,
        hasTime: hasMeaningfulDueTime({ follow_up_at: followUp }),
        missingTime: !hasMeaningfulDueTime({ follow_up_at: followUp }),
        raw: followUp,
        date: followDate,
        sortMs: followDate.getTime(),
        source: 'call_follow_up'
      };
    }
  }

  return { hasDue:false, hasTime:false, missingTime:false, raw:'', date:null, sortMs:Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, source:'none' };
}

function vxDashboardDueRank(record, now) {
  var meta = vxGetDueSortMeta(record);
  if (!meta.hasDue) return 3;
  var currentNow = now instanceof Date ? now : new Date();
  var todayStart = new Date(currentNow.getFullYear(), currentNow.getMonth(), currentNow.getDate());
  var tomorrowStart = new Date(todayStart.getTime() + 86400000);
  var nowMs = currentNow.getTime();
  if (meta.sortMs < nowMs) return 0;
  if (meta.sortMs < tomorrowStart.getTime()) return 1;
  return 2;
}

function vxCompareDashboardPriorityRecords(a, b, now) {
  var ar = vxDashboardDueRank(a, now);
  var br = vxDashboardDueRank(b, now);
  if (ar !== br) return ar - br;

  var am = vxGetDueSortMeta(a);
  var bm = vxGetDueSortMeta(b);
  if (am.hasDue || bm.hasDue) {
    if (am.sortMs !== bm.sortMs) return am.sortMs - bm.sortMs;
    if (am.hasTime !== bm.hasTime) return am.hasTime ? -1 : 1;
    var aCreatedAsc = new Date(getRecordTimestamp(a) || 0).getTime();
    var bCreatedAsc = new Date(getRecordTimestamp(b) || 0).getTime();
    if (aCreatedAsc !== bCreatedAsc) return aCreatedAsc - bCreatedAsc;
  }

  var aPriority = getPriority(a).key === 'urgent' ? 0 : 1;
  var bPriority = getPriority(b).key === 'urgent' ? 0 : 1;
  if (aPriority !== bPriority) return aPriority - bPriority;

  var aCallback = (((a && a.fields) || {}).callback_requested === true || ((a && a.fields) || {}).callback_requested === 'true') ? 0 : 1;
  var bCallback = (((b && b.fields) || {}).callback_requested === true || ((b && b.fields) || {}).callback_requested === 'true') ? 0 : 1;
  if (aCallback !== bCallback) return aCallback - bCallback;

  return new Date(getRecordTimestamp(b) || 0).getTime() - new Date(getRecordTimestamp(a) || 0).getTime();
}

// [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2.3 — 00:00-Bug Fix]
// Erkennt ob das Datum eine "bedeutsame" Uhrzeit hat (vom Nutzer gesetzt),
// im Unterschied zu reinem Datum ohne Zeit (das als 00:00 geparsed wird).
// Beispiele:
//   "2026-05-15"              → false (nur Datum, keine Uhrzeit gesetzt)
//   "2026-05-15T00:00"        → false (Zeit war "00:00", vermutlich Default)
//   "2026-05-15T14:30"        → true (echte Uhrzeit)
//   "2026-05-15T14:30:00+02"  → true (timestamptz mit Zeit)
//   ""                        → false (leer)
function hasMeaningfulDueTime(taskOrFields) {
  if (!taskOrFields) return false;
  var raw = getTaskDueRaw(taskOrFields);
  if (!raw) return false;
  raw = String(raw).trim();
  // Format-Check: enthält ein "T" oder eine Leerstelle gefolgt von Uhrzeit-Muster?
  // Wenn nur "YYYY-MM-DD" → keine Zeit-Info
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(raw)) return false;
  // Wenn die Zeit explizit "00:00" oder "00:00:00" ist → behandeln wir als nicht bedeutsam
  // (kommt von Default-Werten bei Datumseingabe ohne Uhrzeit)
  if (/T00:00(?::00)?(\.\d+)?(Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})?$/.test(raw)) return false;
  if (/[ T]00:00(:00)?\s*$/.test(raw)) return false;
  // Sonst: vermutlich gesetzte Uhrzeit
  return /T\d{2}:\d{2}/.test(raw) || /\d{2}:\d{2}/.test(raw);
}

function formatTaskDueLabel(taskOrFields, options) {
  var opts = options || {};
  var due = parseTaskDueAt(taskOrFields);
  if (!due) return opts.emptyLabel || 'Ohne Fälligkeit';
  var now = opts.now instanceof Date ? opts.now : new Date();
  var todayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  var tomorrowStart = new Date(todayStart.getTime() + 86400000);
  var dayAfterTomorrowStart = new Date(todayStart.getTime() + 172800000);
  // [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2.3 — 00:00-Bug Fix]
  // Nur Uhrzeit anzeigen, wenn sie vom Nutzer gesetzt wurde (nicht Default-00:00)
  var withTime = hasMeaningfulDueTime(taskOrFields);
  var timeLabel = withTime ? formatTimeCH(due) : '';
  var timeSuffix = withTime ? (', ' + timeLabel) : '';
  if (due.getTime() < now.getTime()) {
    if (due >= todayStart && due < tomorrowStart) {
      return withTime ? ('Überfällig seit ' + timeLabel) : 'Heute überfällig';
    }
    return 'Überfällig seit ' + formatDateShortCH(due) + timeSuffix;
  }
  if (due >= todayStart && due < tomorrowStart) {
    return withTime ? ('Heute, ' + timeLabel) : 'Heute';
  }
  if (due >= tomorrowStart && due < dayAfterTomorrowStart) {
    return withTime ? ('Morgen, ' + timeLabel) : 'Morgen';
  }
  return formatDateShortCH(due) + timeSuffix;
}

function getOpenTaskCount() {
  // [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2.7 — Schema-konforme Aufgaben-Zählung]
  // Aufgaben offen = offene customer_tasks. Calls mit follow_up_at/callback_requested
  // sind Call-Signale, aber keine zusätzliche Aufgabe, solange kein customer_task existiert.
  var closed = new Set(['closed','resolved','completed','done','cancelled','archived','deleted']);
  return (allManualTaskRecords || []).filter(function(rec) {
    var f = (rec && rec.fields) || {};
    var status = String(f.status || f.dashboard_status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return !closed.has(status);
  }).length;
}


// PATCH v2.11 — KPI-/Inbox-Definitionen zentralisiert
function vxIsClosedManualTaskStatus(status) {
  var closed = new Set(['closed','resolved','completed','done','cancelled','archived','deleted']);
  return closed.has(String(status || '').trim().toLowerCase());
}

function vxGetOpenManualTasks() {
  var tasks = (typeof allManualTaskRecords !== 'undefined' && allManualTaskRecords) ? allManualTaskRecords : [];
  return tasks.filter(function(rec) {
    var f = (rec && rec.fields) || {};
    return !vxIsClosedManualTaskStatus(f.status || f.dashboard_status);
  });
}

function vxGetNewRequestCalls(records) {
  return (records || []).filter(function(rec) {
    var f = (rec && rec.fields) || {};
    if (!isCustomerVisibleCall(rec)) return false;
    return String(f.live_status || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'completed' && !f.read_at;
  });
}


// PATCH v2.61B — Same-day caller consolidation (UI only)
// Raw calls remain untouched. This only creates temporary display units for operational lists.
function vxIsOpenCallForConsolidation(record) {
  if (!record || isManualTaskRecord(record)) return false;
  var f = record.fields || {};
  if (isActivationCallCategory(f.category)) return false;
  var phone = normalizePhoneForMatch(f.caller_phone || f.phone_number || f.phone || '');
  if (!phone) return false;
  var status = normalizeStatus(f.dashboard_status);
  return status === CALL_STATUS.NEW || status === CALL_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS || status === CALL_STATUS.FOLLOW_UP_SCHEDULED;
}

function vxGetLocalCallDateKey(record) {
  var ts = getRecordTimestamp(record);
  if (!ts) return '';
  var d = parseCallTimestamp(ts);
  if (!d || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
}

function vxGetCallConsolidationKey(record) {
  if (!vxIsOpenCallForConsolidation(record)) return '';
  var f = record.fields || {};
  var phone = normalizePhoneForMatch(f.caller_phone || f.phone_number || f.phone || '');
  var dateKey = vxGetLocalCallDateKey(record);
  if (!phone || !dateKey) return '';
  return phone + '|' + dateKey;
}

function vxAttachCallGroupMeta(primary, group) {
  var list = (group || []).filter(Boolean);
  if (!primary || list.length <= 1) return primary;
  var sorted = list.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    return new Date(getRecordTimestamp(b) || 0).getTime() - new Date(getRecordTimestamp(a) || 0).getTime();
  });
  var f = (primary.fields || {});
  var phone = normalizePhoneForMatch(f.caller_phone || f.phone_number || f.phone || '');
  var latestAt = getRecordTimestamp(sorted[0]) || getRecordTimestamp(primary) || '';
  var clone = Object.assign({}, primary);
  clone.fields = Object.assign({}, primary.fields || {});
  clone._vxGroup = {
    kind: 'same_day_caller',
    count: sorted.length,
    callIds: sorted.map(function(r){ return String(r && r.id || ''); }).filter(Boolean),
    latestAt: latestAt,
    dateKey: vxGetLocalCallDateKey(primary),
    phone: phone
  };
  return clone;
}

function vxConsolidateSameDayCallerRecords(records, options) {
  var source = Array.isArray(records) ? records : [];
  return source.slice();
}

function vxFormatCallGroupMeta(record) {
  var g = record && record._vxGroup;
  if (!g || g.kind !== 'same_day_caller' || !g.count || g.count <= 1) return '';
  var latest = g.latestAt ? fmtTime(g.latestAt) : '';
  return String(g.count) + '× heute' + (latest ? ' · zuletzt ' + latest : '');
}

function vxGetTaskDueBucketCounts(tasks) {
  var now = new Date();
  var todayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  var tomorrowStart = new Date(todayStart.getTime() + 86400000);
  var overdue = 0, today = 0, planned = 0, noDue = 0;
  (tasks || []).forEach(function(task) {
    var due = (typeof parseTaskDueAt === 'function') ? parseTaskDueAt((task && task.fields) || {}) : null;
    if (!due || Number.isNaN(due.getTime())) { noDue++; return; }
    var dueDay = new Date(due.getFullYear(), due.getMonth(), due.getDate());
    if (dueDay.getTime() < todayStart.getTime()) overdue++;
    else if (dueDay.getTime() < tomorrowStart.getTime()) today++;
    else planned++;
  });
  return { overdue: overdue, today: today, planned: planned, noDue: noDue };
}

function vxGetTaskTypeCounts(tasks) {
  var counts = { callback: 0, information: 0, appointment: 0, follow_up: 0, general: 0 };
  (tasks || []).forEach(function(task) {
    var type = String(((task && task.fields) || {}).type || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (type === 'callback' || type === 'rueckruf' || type === 'rückruf') counts.callback++;
    else if (type === 'information' || type === 'offerte' || type === 'offer') counts.information++;
    else if (type === 'appointment' || type === 'termin') counts.appointment++;
    else if (type === 'follow_up' || type === 'nachfassen') counts.follow_up++;
    else counts.general++;
  });
  return counts;
}

function vxBuildDailyReportText(records, manualTasks) {
  // Tagesfokus nutzt dieselbe operative Logik wie die Heute-KPIs.
  // Keine freie KI-Zählung: Calls, Follow-ups, Wichtig und Erledigt bleiben konsistent.
  var counts = (typeof vxGetHeuteKpiCounts === 'function')
    ? vxGetHeuteKpiCounts(records || [], manualTasks || allManualTaskRecords || [])
    : { callsToday: 0, callbacksOpen: 0, importantNow: 0, doneToday: 0 };
  var callsToday = Number(counts.callsToday || 0);
  var followupsOpen = Number(counts.callbacksOpen || 0);
  var importantNow = Number(counts.importantNow || 0);
  var doneToday = Number(counts.doneToday || 0);
  var parts = [];

  if (callsToday > 0) {
    parts.push('Heute ' + (callsToday === 1 ? 'ist 1 Anruf eingegangen' : 'sind ' + callsToday + ' Anrufe eingegangen') + '.');
  } else {
    parts.push('Heute ist bisher kein Anruf eingegangen.');
  }

  if (followupsOpen > 0 && importantNow > 0) {
    parts.push('Es gibt ' + followupsOpen + ' offene Follow-up' + (followupsOpen === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' und ' + importantNow + ' wichtige' + (importantNow === 1 ? 'n' : '') + ' Eintrag' + (importantNow === 1 ? '' : 'e') + '.');
    parts.push('Fokus: zuerst die priorisierten oder fälligen Vorgänge bearbeiten.');
  } else if (followupsOpen > 0) {
    parts.push('Es gibt ' + followupsOpen + ' offene Follow-up' + (followupsOpen === 1 ? '' : 's') + '.');
    parts.push('Fokus: geplante Rückrufe und Aufgaben der Reihe nach abschliessen.');
  } else if (importantNow > 0) {
    parts.push('Es gibt ' + importantNow + ' wichtige' + (importantNow === 1 ? 'n' : '') + ' Eintrag' + (importantNow === 1 ? '' : 'e') + '.');
    parts.push('Fokus: diese Vorgänge zuerst prüfen.');
  } else {
    parts.push('Aktuell sind keine offenen Follow-ups oder priorisierten Vorgänge sichtbar.');
  }

  if (doneToday > 0) {
    parts.push(doneToday + ' Vorg' + (doneToday === 1 ? 'ang wurde' : 'änge wurden') + ' heute abgeschlossen.');
  }
  return parts.join(' ');
}

function vxGetAnfragenOperationalCounts(records, manualTasks) {
  var source = [];
  try {
    source = (typeof vxGetAnfragenSourceRecords === 'function')
      ? vxGetAnfragenSourceRecords()
      : [].concat(records || [], manualTasks || allManualTaskRecords || []).filter(Boolean).filter(function(r){
          return (typeof isManualTaskRecord === 'function' && isManualTaskRecord(r)) || (typeof isCustomerVisibleCall !== 'function' || isCustomerVisibleCall(r));
        });
  } catch(e) {
    source = [].concat(records || [], manualTasks || allManualTaskRecords || []).filter(Boolean);
  }
  var match = (typeof vxInquiryMatchesFilter === 'function') ? vxInquiryMatchesFilter : function(r, filter) {
    var done = (typeof vxHeuteIsDoneRecord === 'function') ? vxHeuteIsDoneRecord(r) : false;
    var planned = !done && (typeof vxHeuteIsCallbackOpen === 'function') ? vxHeuteIsCallbackOpen(r) : false;
    if (filter === 'abgeschlossen') return done;
    if (filter === 'geplant') return planned;
    if (filter === 'offen') return !done && !planned;
    return true;
  };
  var inbox = source.filter(function(r){ return match(r, 'offen'); });
  var planned = source.filter(function(r){ return match(r, 'geplant'); });
  var done = source.filter(function(r){ return match(r, 'abgeschlossen'); });
  var doneToday = done.filter(function(r){ return (typeof vxHeuteRecordCompletedToday === 'function') ? vxHeuteRecordCompletedToday(r) : false; });
  return { inbox: inbox.length, planned: planned.length, done: done.length, doneToday: doneToday.length };
}

function vxResolveDprRecord(recId) {
  var id = String(recId || '');
  var raw = id.indexOf('case:') === 0 ? id.slice(5) : id;
  var manual = (typeof allManualTaskRecords !== 'undefined' && allManualTaskRecords) ? allManualTaskRecords : [];
  var calls = (typeof allRecords !== 'undefined' && allRecords) ? allRecords : [];
  return calls.find(function(r){ return String(r.id) === id || String(r.id) === raw; })
    || manual.find(function(r){
      var f = (r && r.fields) || {};
      return String(r.id) === id || String(r.id) === raw || String(f.task_entity_id || '') === raw || String(f.task_entity_id || '') === id;
    })
    || null;
}

function normalizePhoneForMatch(phone) {
  var raw = String(phone || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return '';
  var digits = raw.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
  if (!digits) return '';
  if (digits.startsWith('0041')) digits = '41' + digits.slice(4);
  if (digits.startsWith('41') && digits.length > 9) digits = '0' + digits.slice(2);
  return digits;
}

function isOpenWorkItem(item) {
  var status = String((item && item.status) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!status) return true;
  return !['closed', 'resolved', 'completed', 'done', 'archived', 'deleted', 'cancelled'].includes(status);
}

function mapCallsToWorkItems(calls) {
  return (calls || []).map(function(rec) {
    var f = (rec && rec.fields) || {};
    return { id: 'call:' + rec.id, source: 'call', entityType: 'call', entityId: rec.id, relatedCallId: null, record: rec, phone: normalizePhoneForMatch(f.caller_phone || f.phone_number || ''), dueAt: resolveTaskDueAt(f), createdAt: getRecordTimestamp(rec) || '', status: String(f.dashboard_status || ''), type: getFollowUpTaskType(rec) };
  });
}

function mapManualTasksToWorkItems(manualTasks) {
  return (manualTasks || []).map(function(task) {
    var f = (task && task.fields) || {};
    var sourceCallId = String(f.source_call_id || f.related_call_id || f.call_id || f.origin_call_id || '').trim() || null;
    return { id: 'manual:' + task.id, source: 'manual_task', entityType: 'manual_task', entityId: task.id, relatedCallId: sourceCallId, record: task, phone: normalizePhoneForMatch(f.phone || f.caller_phone || f.phone_number || ''), dueAt: resolveTaskDueAt(f), createdAt: getRecordTimestamp(task) || '', status: String(f.status || f.dashboard_status || ''), type: String(f.type || '').toLowerCase() || 'task' };
  });
}

function sortWorkItemsByOperationalPriority(items) {
  var now = new Date();
  return [...(items || [])].sort(function(a, b) {
    function rank(it) {
      var d = parseFollowUpDate(it.dueAt || '');
      if (!d || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return 4;
      var ts = d.getTime();
      var dayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).getTime();
      var nextDay = dayStart + 86400000;
      if (ts < now.getTime()) return 0;
      if (ts < nextDay) return 1;
      return 2;
    }
    var ar = rank(a), br = rank(b);
    if (ar !== br) return ar - br;
    var ad = parseFollowUpDate(a.dueAt || ''); var bd = parseFollowUpDate(b.dueAt || '');
    var at = ad && !Number.isNaN(ad.getTime()) ? ad.getTime() : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    var bt = bd && !Number.isNaN(bd.getTime()) ? bd.getTime() : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    if (at !== bt) return at - bt;
    return new Date(b.createdAt || 0).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt || 0).getTime();
  });
}

function buildDashboardWorkItems(calls, manualTasks) {
  return sortWorkItemsByOperationalPriority([].concat(mapCallsToWorkItems(calls), mapManualTasksToWorkItems(manualTasks)).filter(isOpenWorkItem));
}

function vxTodayNormText(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[ä]/g, 'a').replace(/[ö]/g, 'o').replace(/[ü]/g, 'u')
    .replace(/[\s_-]+/g, ' ');
}
function vxTodayIsNoActionText(value) {

  if (!raw) return false;
  return raw === 'keine aktion notig' || raw === 'keine aktion' || raw === 'kein bedarf' || raw === 'nichts notwendig' || raw === 'no action' || raw === 'not required';
}
function vxTodayHasMeaningfulNextAction(value) {
  var raw = vxTodayNormText(value);

}

function vxTodayIsIgnorableCall(record) {
  var f = (record && record.fields) || {};

  var lead = vxTodayNormText(f.lead_quality || '');
  var urgency = vxTodayNormText(f.urgency || '');
  var nextAction = f.next_action;
  var summary = vxTodayNormText([f.call_summary, f.call_summary_short, f.notes_customer_voxera, f.notes].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
  var callback = f.callback_requested === true || String(f.callback_requested).toLowerCase() === 'true';
  if (category === 'activation test outbound' || category === 'activation test inbound') return true;
  if (summary.indexOf('testanruf') >= 0 || summary.indexOf('test call') >= 0) return true;
  if (summary.indexOf('falsch verbunden') >= 0 || summary.indexOf('wrong number') >= 0) return true;
  if (vxTodayIsNoActionText(nextAction) && !callback) return true;
  if ((category === 'sonstiges' || category === 'general' || category === '') && (lead === 'cold' || lead === 'kalt' || lead === '') && !callback && !vxTodayHasMeaningfulNextAction(nextAction) && !['sofort','heute','hoch','mittel','high','medium','urgent'].includes(urgency)) return true;
  return false;

function vxTodayCallRelevanceReasons(record) {
  var f = (record && record.fields) || {};
  var reasons = [];
  var category = vxTodayNormText(f.category || f.subcategory || '');
  var lead = vxTodayNormText(f.lead_quality || '');
  var urgency = vxTodayNormText(f.urgency || '');
  var priority = vxTodayNormText(f.priority || '');
  var nextAction = String(f.next_action || '').trim();
  var hasFollowUp = !!resolveFollowUpAt(f);
  var callback = f.callback_requested === true || String(f.callback_requested).toLowerCase() === 'true';
  if (callback) reasons.push('callback_requested');
  if (hasFollowUp) reasons.push('follow_up_at');
  if (['high','medium','urgent','critical','hoch','mittel','dringend'].includes(priority)) reasons.push('priority');
  if (['sofort','heute','hoch','mittel','urgent','high','medium'].includes(urgency)) reasons.push('urgency');
  if (lead === 'hot' || lead === 'warm') reasons.push('lead_quality');
  if (['offertenanfrage','terminanfrage','ruckrufanfrage','rueckrufanfrage','notfall','termin','appointment'].includes(category)) reasons.push('category');
  if (vxTodayHasMeaningfulNextAction(nextAction)) reasons.push('next_action');
  return reasons;
}

function vxBuildOperationalRowActions(record, context) {
  context = context || {};
  var id = vxRowActionLabelEscape(String((record && record.id) || ''));
  var safePhone = vxRowActionLabelEscape(vxRowActionPhone(record, context.phone));
  var isManual = typeof isManualTaskRecord === 'function' && isManualTaskRecord(record);
  var lifecycle = vxRowActionLifecycle(record);
  var isDone = lifecycle === 'done';
  var isArchived = lifecycle === 'archived';
  var isPlanned = lifecycle === 'planned';
  var hasPhone = !!vxRowActionPhone(record, context.phone);
  var primaryAction = isDone || isArchived
    ? { action:'fulldetail', title:'Details', icon:'sidebar-simple' }
    : { action:'done', title:'Erledigen', icon:'check' };
  var menuActions = [];

  if (hasPhone) menuActions.push({ action:'call', title:'Anrufen', attrs:' data-phone="'+safePhone+'"' });

  if (isManual) {
    if (isDone || isArchived) {
      menuActions.push({ action:'schedule-callback', title:'Rückruf planen' });
      if (!isArchived) menuActions.push({ action:'archive', title:'Archivieren' });
    } else {
      menuActions.push({ action:'done', title:'Erledigen' });
      menuActions.push({ action:'followup', title:'Fälligkeit ändern' });
      menuActions.push({ action:'edit', title:'Bearbeiten' });
      menuActions.push({ action:'archive', title:'Archivieren' });
    }
    return { primaryAction: primaryAction, menuActions: menuActions };
  }

  if (isDone || isArchived) {
    menuActions.push({ action:'followup', title:'Rückruf planen' });
    if (!isArchived) menuActions.push({ action:'archive', title:'Archivieren' });
    return { primaryAction: primaryAction, menuActions: menuActions };
  }

  menuActions.push({ action:'followup', title:'Rückruf planen' });
  if (isPlanned) menuActions.push({ action:'followup', title:'Fälligkeit ändern' });
  menuActions.push({ action:'fulldetail', title:'Details öffnen' });
  menuActions.push({ action:'archive', title:'Archivieren' });
  return { primaryAction: primaryAction, menuActions: menuActions };
}

function vxRowActionLifecycle(record) {
  if (record && typeof vxGetEntryLifecycleStatus === 'function') return vxGetEntryLifecycleStatus(record);
  var f = (record && record.fields) || {};
  var status = String(f.dashboard_status || f.status || '').toLowerCase();
  if (f.archived_at || ['archived','archive','archiviert','deleted','cancelled','canceled'].includes(status)) return 'archived';
  if (f.completed_at || f.done_at || f.closed_at || ['closed','done','completed','resolved','erledigt','abgeschlossen'].includes(status)) return 'done';
  if (f.follow_up_at || f.due_at || ['planned','scheduled','geplant','follow_up_scheduled'].includes(status)) return 'planned';
  return 'open';
}
function vxRowActionIsDone(record) {
  var lifecycle = vxRowActionLifecycle(record);
  return lifecycle === 'done' || lifecycle === 'archived';
}
function vxRowActionIsArchived(record) {
  return vxRowActionLifecycle(record) === 'archived';
}

}

function dprToggleClick(e, rowEl) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  if (window._vxInboxSelectionMode && rowEl && rowEl.closest && rowEl.closest('#anrufe-list, #anrufe-split-left')) {
    return;
  }
  // Touch-Geräte: click nach touchend ignorieren
  if (e.type === 'click' && (Date.now() - _dprLastTouch) < 800) return;
  if (e.target.closest('.dpr-btn, .dpr-quick-btn, .vx-ibtn, button')) return;
  var _clickedCard = rowEl && rowEl.closest ? rowEl.closest('.dpr-card') : null;
  var _clickedId = (rowEl && rowEl.dataset && (rowEl.dataset.id || rowEl.dataset.recordId)) || (_clickedCard && _clickedCard.dataset ? _clickedCard.dataset.id : '');
  if (_clickedId && typeof vxSetActiveRequestRow === 'function') vxSetActiveRequestRow(_clickedId);
  if (_dprToggleLock) return;
  _dprToggleLock = true;
  setTimeout(function(){ _dprToggleLock = false; }, 400);
  // Als gelesen markieren — Punkt entfernen
  vxMarkRowAsRead(rowEl);
  // Anfragen Split: Klick → direkt Detail-Seite
  if (dprOpenAnfragenDetailFromRow(rowEl)) return;
  // [v3.0] Heute-Tab → immer Detail-Seite (kein Expand)
  var inHeuteList = rowEl.closest('#dash-priority-list');
  if (inHeuteList) {
    var recId = rowEl.dataset.id || rowEl.getAttribute('data-record-id');
    if (recId && vxOpenPriorityRecord(recId)) return;
  }
  _dprToggleExec(rowEl);
}

function _dprToggleExec(rowEl) {
  var id = rowEl.dataset.id;
  var container = rowEl.closest('#dash-priority-list, #anrufe-list, .call-list');
  var containerId = container ? (container.id || 'default') : 'default';
  var currentOpen = _dprOpenIds[containerId];
  if (currentOpen === id) {
    dprCloseAll(container);
    _dprOpenIds[containerId] = null;
    _dprOpenId = null;
  } else {
    dprCloseAll(container);
    dprOpen(rowEl);
    _dprOpenIds[containerId] = id;
    _dprOpenId = id;
  }
}

function dprToggle(rowEl) {
  var card = rowEl.closest('.dpr-card');
  if (!card) return;
  var exp = card.querySelector('.dpr-exp');
  if (!exp) return;
  var isOpen = exp.style.display !== 'none';

  // Alle anderen schliessen
  if (!isOpen) {
    var container = card.closest('#dash-priority-list, #anrufe-list, .call-list');
    if (container) {
      container.querySelectorAll('.dpr-exp').forEach(function(e) {
        e.style.display = 'none';
      });
      container.querySelectorAll('.dpr-row').forEach(function(r) {
        r.style.background = '';
        r.style.borderColor = '';
        var c = r.querySelector('[class="ph-bold ph-caret-right"]');
        if (c) { c.style.transform = ''; c.style.color = ''; }
      });
    }
  }

  exp.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';
  var chev = rowEl.querySelector('[class="ph-bold ph-caret-right"]');
  if (chev) {
    chev.style.transform = isOpen ? '' : 'rotate(90deg)';
    chev.style.color = isOpen ? 'var(--slate2)' : 'var(--blue)';
  }
  rowEl.style.background = isOpen ? '' : '#F7F9FF';
  rowEl.style.borderColor = isOpen ? '' : 'var(--blue-mid, #B9D4FF)';
}

  if (!customerId) {
    teardownDashboardRealtime();
    return;
  }
  const nextKey = `dashboard:${customerId}`;
  if (dashboardRealtimeChannel && dashboardRealtimeKey === nextKey) return;
  teardownDashboardRealtime();
  const channelName = `customer-dashboard-${customerId}`;
  const channel = _sb
    .channel(channelName)
    .on('postgres_changes', {
      event: '*',
      schema: 'public',
      table: 'calls',
      filter: `customer_id=eq.${customerId}`
    }, function(payload) {
      var next = (payload && payload.new) || null;
      var nextId = next && next.id != null ? String(next.id) : '';
      var nextLiveStatus = String((next && next.live_status) || '').toLowerCase();
      var isTerminalLiveStatus = CALL_LIVE_TERMINAL_STATES.has(nextLiveStatus);
      if (nextId && isTerminalLiveStatus && Array.isArray(allRecords) && allRecords.length) {
        var idx = allRecords.findIndex(function(r) { return String((r && r.id) || '') === nextId; });
        if (idx >= 0 && allRecords[idx] && allRecords[idx].fields) {
          allRecords[idx].fields.live_status = next.live_status;
          if (next.updated_at) allRecords[idx].fields.updated_at = next.updated_at;
          if (next.completed_at) allRecords[idx].fields.completed_at = next.completed_at;
          if (next.duration_seconds !== undefined) allRecords[idx].fields.duration_seconds = next.duration_seconds;
        }
      }
      if (isTerminalLiveStatus) {
        // Terminal-Callbacks müssen LIVE sofort ausblenden (keine künstliche Nachlaufzeit).
        renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
        renderAnrufe();
      }
      scheduleRealtimeLoad(isTerminalLiveStatus ? 'calls-terminal-change' : 'calls-change');
    })
    .on('postgres_changes', {
      event: '*',
      schema: 'public',
      table: 'customer_tasks',
      filter: `customer_id=eq.${customerId}`
    }, function() {
      scheduleRealtimeLoad('cases-change');
    })
    .on('postgres_changes', {
      event: '*',
      schema: 'public',
      table: 'customers',
      filter: `id=eq.${customerId}`
    }, function() {
      scheduleRealtimeLoad('customer-change');
    })
    .subscribe(function(status) {
      if (status === 'CHANNEL_ERROR' || status === 'TIMED_OUT') {
        console.warn('[realtime-sync] channel degraded, polling fallback remains active', { status: status, customerId: customerId });
      }
    });
  dashboardRealtimeChannel = channel;
  dashboardRealtimeKey = nextKey;
}
