    description: 'Zusammenfassung und Details sind verfügbar.',
    isTemporary: false
  };
}
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.vxGetDefaultCallDisplayState = vxGetDefaultCallDisplayState;

function vxGetCallDisplayState(callOrFields) {
  var fallback = vxGetDefaultCallDisplayState();
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window._vxCallDisplayStateCache = window._vxCallDisplayStateCache || {};
    }
    var cache = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window._vxCallDisplayStateCache) ? window._vxCallDisplayStateCache : {};
    var now = Date.now();
    Object.keys(cache).forEach(function(key) {
      var entry = cache[key];
      if (!entry) return;
      if ((now - Number(entry.lastSeenAt || 0)) > CALL_DISPLAY_CACHE_TTL_MS) delete cache[key];
    });

    if (!callOrFields) return fallback;
    var src = (callOrFields && callOrFields.fields) ? callOrFields.fields : callOrFields;
    if (!src || typeof src !== 'object') return fallback;

    // Manual tasks may pass through generic render paths. They are not live-call records.
    if (typeof isManualTaskRecord === 'function' && isManualTaskRecord(callOrFields)) return fallback;
    var liveStatus = String(src.live_status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    var summary = (typeof vxGetCallSummary === 'function') ? vxGetCallSummary(src) : String(src.call_summary || src.summary || src.call_summary_short || src.ai_summary || src.analysis_summary || '').trim();
    var transcript = (typeof vxGetCallTranscript === 'function') ? vxGetCallTranscript(src) : String(src.transcript || src.transcription || '').trim();
    var hasSummary = !!summary;
    var hasTranscript = !!transcript;
    var hasDuration = src.duration_seconds !== null && src.duration_seconds !== undefined && !Number.isNaN(Number(src.duration_seconds));
    var hasReadySignals = hasSummary || (hasTranscript && hasDuration);
    var hasCompletedLikeState = ['completed', 'archived'].includes(liveStatus);
    var isLiveStatus = ['incoming','active','live','ringing'].includes(liveStatus);
    var hasDurationReadySignal = hasDuration && !isLiveStatus;
    var hasStrongReadySignals = hasReadySignals || hasCompletedLikeState || hasDurationReadySignal;
    var tsRaw = src.updated_at || src.created_at;
    var ts = (tsRaw && typeof parseCallTimestamp === 'function') ? parseCallTimestamp(tsRaw) : (tsRaw ? new Date(tsRaw) : null);
    var ageMs = ts && !Number.isNaN(ts.getTime()) ? (Date.now() - ts.getTime()) : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    var isProcessingStatus = ['analyzing','processing'].includes(liveStatus);
    var callId = String((callOrFields && (callOrFields.id || callOrFields.call_id)) || src.id || src.call_id || '').trim();
    var cacheEntry = callId ? (cache[callId] || {}) : null;

    // Hard ready lock: completed or final duration outside explicit live states must never render as temporary.
    if (hasStrongReadySignals) {
      if (cacheEntry) {
        cacheEntry.state = 'ready';
        cacheEntry.readyLocked = true;
        cacheEntry.firstSeenAt = cacheEntry.firstSeenAt || now;
        cacheEntry.lastSeenAt = now;
        cacheEntry.stableUntil = now;
        cache[callId] = cacheEntry;
      }
      return fallback;
    }

    if (cacheEntry && cacheEntry.readyLocked) return fallback;

    if (isLiveStatus) {
      if (cacheEntry) {
        cacheEntry.state = 'live';
        cacheEntry.firstSeenAt = cacheEntry.firstSeenAt || now;
        cacheEntry.lastSeenAt = now;
        cacheEntry.stableUntil = now + CALL_DISPLAY_LIVE_STABLE_MS;
        cache[callId] = cacheEntry;
      }
      return { state:'live', label:'LIVE', tone:'danger', title:'Live-Anruf', description:'Lara nimmt den Anruf gerade entgegen. Die Zusammenfassung erscheint nach Gesprächsende.', isTemporary:true };
    }

    if (cacheEntry && cacheEntry.state === 'live' && Number(cacheEntry.stableUntil || 0) > now) {
      cacheEntry.lastSeenAt = now;
      cache[callId] = cacheEntry;
      return { state:'live', label:'LIVE', tone:'danger', title:'Live-Anruf', description:'Lara nimmt den Anruf gerade entgegen. Die Zusammenfassung erscheint nach Gesprächsende.', isTemporary:true };
    }

    if (!hasCompletedLikeState && !hasDuration && ageMs > CALL_DISPLAY_TEMP_STALE_MS && !hasSummary && !hasTranscript) {
      if (cacheEntry) {
        cacheEntry.state = 'checking';
        cacheEntry.firstSeenAt = cacheEntry.firstSeenAt || now;
        cacheEntry.lastSeenAt = now;
        cache[callId] = cacheEntry;
      }
      return { state:'checking', label:'Wird geprüft', tone:'neutral', title:'Anrufdaten werden geprüft', description:'Die Zusammenfassung erscheint, sobald die Verarbeitung abgeschlossen ist.', isTemporary:true };
    }

    if (!hasCompletedLikeState && !hasDuration && (isProcessingStatus || (cacheEntry && cacheEntry.state === 'live') || ageMs <= CALL_DISPLAY_TEMP_STALE_MS)) {
      if (cacheEntry) {
        cacheEntry.state = 'processing';
        cacheEntry.firstSeenAt = cacheEntry.firstSeenAt || now;
        cacheEntry.lastSeenAt = now;
        cache[callId] = cacheEntry;
      }
      return { state:'processing', label:'Wird verarbeitet', tone:'blue', title:'Anruf wird verarbeitet', description:'Zusammenfassung und Transkript werden vorbereitet.', isTemporary:true };
    }
    return fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
}
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.vxGetCallDisplayState = vxGetCallDisplayState;

function getCallDisplayState(record) {

  var f = (record && record.fields) || {};
  var liveStatus = String(f.live_status || '').toLowerCase();
  var hasCallSummary = !!String(f.call_summary || '').trim();
  var hasCallSummaryShort = !!String(f.call_summary_short || '').trim();
  var hasTranscript = !!String(f.transcript || '').trim();
  var hasDuration = f.duration_seconds !== null && f.duration_seconds !== undefined;
  var hasFinalContent = hasCallSummary || hasCallSummaryShort || hasTranscript || hasDuration;
  var isCompleted = liveStatus === 'completed' || hasFinalContent;
  var isFailed = liveStatus === 'failed';
  var durationValue = Number(f.duration_seconds);
  var isShortDuration = !hasDuration || Number.isNaN(durationValue) || durationValue < 8;
  var isShortAbandoned = isFailed && !hasCallSummary && !hasCallSummaryShort && !hasTranscript && isShortDuration;
  var isLiveStatus = liveStatus === 'incoming' || liveStatus === 'active';
  var isAnalyzing = liveStatus === 'analyzing';
  var isTerminalStatus = CALL_LIVE_TERMINAL_STATES.has(liveStatus);
  var ts = getRecordTimestamp(record);
  var parsed = ts ? parseCallTimestamp(ts) : null;
  var updatedAtMs = parsed && !Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? parsed.getTime() : 0;
  var nowMs = Date.now();
  var liveThresholdMs = liveStatus === 'incoming' ? CALL_LIVE_INCOMING_FRESHNESS_MS : CALL_LIVE_ACTIVE_FRESHNESS_MS;
  var recordId = String((record && record.id) || '').trim();
  var isFresh = updatedAtMs > 0 && (nowMs - updatedAtMs) <= liveThresholdMs;

  var uiState = (typeof vxGetCallDisplayState === 'function' ? vxGetCallDisplayState(record) : null) || vxGetDefaultCallDisplayState();
  if (uiState.state === 'checking') return 'checking';
  if (uiState.state === 'ready') return 'final';

  if (isLiveStatus && !isFresh && recordId) {
    _staleLiveRecordIds.add(recordId);
    _staleLiveRecordUpdatedAtMs.set(recordId, updatedAtMs);
  }

  if (isTerminalStatus) return 'final';
  if (isShortAbandoned) return 'short_abandoned';
  if (isCompleted) {
    if (recordId) {
      _staleLiveRecordIds.delete(recordId);
      _staleLiveRecordUpdatedAtMs.delete(recordId);
    }
    return 'final';
  }
  if (isAnalyzing) {
    if (recordId) {
      _staleLiveRecordIds.delete(recordId);
      _staleLiveRecordUpdatedAtMs.delete(recordId);
    }
    return 'processing';
  }
  if (isLiveStatus && isFresh && recordId && _staleLiveRecordIds.has(recordId)) {
    var staleTs = Number(_staleLiveRecordUpdatedAtMs.get(recordId) || 0);
    if (updatedAtMs > staleTs) {
      _staleLiveRecordIds.delete(recordId);
      _staleLiveRecordUpdatedAtMs.delete(recordId);
      return 'live';
    }
    return 'processing';
  }
  if (isLiveStatus && isFresh) return 'live';
  if (isLiveStatus && !isFresh) return 'processing';
  if (isFailed && !hasFinalContent) return 'short_abandoned';
  if (!hasFinalContent) return 'processing';
  return 'final';
}

function pickLiveCall(records) {
  if (!Array.isArray(records) || !records.length) return null;
  var live = records.filter(function(r) {
    var f = r.fields || {};
    if (isActivationCallCategory(f.category)) return false;
    return getCallDisplayState(r) === 'live';
  });
  if (!live.length) return null;
  // Newest first
  live.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pa = (typeof parseCallTimestamp === 'function') ? parseCallTimestamp((a.fields || {}).created_at) : null;
    var pb = (typeof parseCallTimestamp === 'function') ? parseCallTimestamp((b.fields || {}).created_at) : null;
    var ta = pa ? pa.getTime() : 0;
    var tb = pb ? pb.getTime() : 0;
    return tb - ta;
  });
  return live[0];
}

function buildLiveCallMatcher(liveRecord) {
  if (!liveRecord || !liveRecord.fields) return null;
  var liveFields = liveRecord.fields || {};
  var liveId = String(liveRecord.id || '').trim();
  var livePhone = String(liveFields.caller_phone || liveFields.phone_number || '').trim();
  var liveCreated = parseCallTimestamp(liveFields.created_at);
  var liveCreatedMs = liveCreated && !Number.isNaN(liveCreated.getTime()) ? liveCreated.getTime() : null;
  return function(record) {
    if (!record || !record.fields) return false;
    if (liveId && String(record.id || '').trim() === liveId) return true;
    var f = record.fields || {};
    if (getCallDisplayState(record) !== 'live') return false;
    var recordPhone = String(f.caller_phone || f.phone_number || '').trim();
    var phoneMatch = !!(livePhone && recordPhone && livePhone === recordPhone);
    if (!phoneMatch) return false;
    var recordCreated = parseCallTimestamp(f.created_at);
    var recordCreatedMs = recordCreated && !Number.isNaN(recordCreated.getTime()) ? recordCreated.getTime() : null;
    if (liveCreatedMs === null || recordCreatedMs === null) return false;
    return Math.abs(recordCreatedMs - liveCreatedMs) <= 2 * 60 * 1000;
  };
}

function updateLiveHero(records) {
  var source = Array.isArray(records) ? records : (allRecords || []);
  var rec = source
    .filter(function(r) {
      if (!r || !r.fields) return false;
      var f = r.fields || {};
      if (isActivationCallCategory(f.category)) return false;
      var liveStatus = String(f.live_status || '').toLowerCase();
      var isLiveCandidate = liveStatus === 'incoming' || liveStatus === 'active';
      return isLiveCandidate && !CALL_LIVE_TERMINAL_STATES.has(liveStatus);
    })
    .sort(function(a, b) {
      var pa = (typeof parseCallTimestamp === 'function') ? parseCallTimestamp((a.fields || {}).created_at) : null;
      var pb = (typeof parseCallTimestamp === 'function') ? parseCallTimestamp((b.fields || {}).created_at) : null;
      var ta = pa ? pa.getTime() : 0;
      var tb = pb ? pb.getTime() : 0;
      return tb - ta;
    })[0] || null;
  var priorityList = document.getElementById('dash-priority-list');

  // Alten Live-Row entfernen
  var existing = document.getElementById('live-call-row');
  if (existing) existing.remove();

  if (!rec) {
    if (_liveHeroTimer) { clearInterval(_liveHeroTimer); _liveHeroTimer = null; }
    _liveHeroCurrentId = null;
    return;
  }

  var f = rec.fields || {};
  var caller = (typeof getCallDisplayName === 'function' ? getCallDisplayName(f) : null)
               || f.caller_name || f.phone_number || f.caller_phone || 'Unbekannte Nummer';
  var company = f.company_name || '';

  // Live-Row erstellen — v3.0 Design
  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.id = 'live-call-row';
  row.dataset.recordId = rec.id;
  row.innerHTML = [
    '<div class="vx-live-avatar-wrap">',
      '<div class="vx-live-pulse"></div>',
      '<div class="vx-live-avatar">' + (caller.split(' ').map(function(w){return w[0]||'';}).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase()||'?') + '</div>',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="vx-live-body">',
      '<div class="vx-live-name">' + (company ? _esc(company) : _esc(caller)) + '</div>',
      '<div class="vx-live-sub">',
        '<span class="vx-live-sub-dot"></span>',
        'Anruf läuft gerade · wird verarbeitet',
      '</div>',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="vx-live-badge">LIVE</div>'
  ].join('');
  row.onclick = function(e) {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();
    // Live calls are intentionally excluded from the Anfragen worklist until the call is finalized.
    // Keep the user on Heute and avoid navigating to an empty filtered/detail state.
    if (typeof vxToast === 'function') {
      vxToast({ type:'call', title:'Live-Anruf läuft', sub:'Details erscheinen nach Gesprächsende automatisch in den Anfragen.' });
    } else if (typeof toast === 'function') {
      toast('Live-Anruf läuft. Details erscheinen nach Gesprächsende.', 'info');
    }
  };

  if (_liveHeroTimer) { clearInterval(_liveHeroTimer); _liveHeroTimer = null; }

  var recStableId = vxGetCallStableId(rec);
  if (recStableId && !_liveHeroNotified.has(recStableId)) {
    _liveHeroNotified.add(recStableId);
    notifyLiveCall(caller, company, rec.id);
    vxToast({ type: 'call', title: 'Eingehender Anruf', sub: company ? company + ' · ' + caller : caller });
    vxBellAdd({ type: 'call', title: 'Eingehender Anruf', sub: company ? company + ' · ' + caller : caller, recId: rec.id });
    vxMaybePlayLiveCallSound(rec, 'live-hero');
  }

  // Live-Call nur auf Heute-Tab zeigen (Jetzt wichtig)
  // Anfragen-Liste zeigt nur abgeschlossene Anrufe
  if (priorityList) {
    priorityList.insertBefore(row, priorityList.firstChild);
  }

  _liveHeroCurrentId = rec.id;
}

function handleLiveHeroClick() {}

// Browser Notification API — sendet OS-Notification wenn Tab nicht im Fokus
function ensureNotificationPermission() {
  if (!('Notification' in window)) return Promise.resolve('unsupported');
  if (Notification.permission === 'granted') return Promise.resolve('granted');
  if (Notification.permission === 'denied') return Promise.resolve('denied');
  try {
    return Notification.requestPermission().then(function(p) { return p; });
  } catch (e) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve) {
      Notification.requestPermission(function(p) { resolve(p); });
    });
  }
}

function notifyLiveCall(caller, company, recordId) {
  if (localStorage.getItem('voxera_browser_notif_off') === '1') return;
  if (!('Notification' in window)) return;
  if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') return;
  if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') return; // Tab sichtbar → Hero reicht
  try {
    var title = 'Voxera · Eingehender Anruf';
    var body = company ? (caller + ' (' + company + ')') : caller;
    var n = new Notification(title, {
      body: body,
      icon: '/brand/05-app-icon-512px.svg',
      tag: 'voxera-live-call',
      requireInteraction: false
    });
    n.onclick = function() {
      window.focus();
      try { n.close(); } catch (e) {}
      if (recordId) {
        var navEl = document.getElementById('nav-anrufe');
        if (typeof showTab === 'function') showTab('anrufe', navEl);
        setTimeout(function() {
          if (typeof vxOpenDetailV2 === 'function') vxOpenDetailV2(recordId); else if (typeof openDetail === 'function') openDetail(recordId);
        }, 120);
      }
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[live-hero] notification failed', err);
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
//  AUFGABEN-GRUPPEN-HEADER (Phase G)
//  Wird nach renderList für rueckrufe-list aufgerufen.
//  Fügt Sektionstrenner ein ohne renderList anzufassen.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
function injectTaskGroupHeaders(listId) {
  var el = document.getElementById(listId);
  if (!el) return;
  // Alte Header entfernen
  el.querySelectorAll('.task-section-header').forEach(function(h) { h.remove(); });
  var rows = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('.call-row:not(.hidden):not(.done)'));
  if (rows.length < 2) return; // Kein Header nötig wenn nur eine Row

  var getBucket = function(row) {
    if (row.querySelector('.task-due-pill.overdue')) return {key:'overdue', label:'Überfällig', cls:'sgh--red'};
    if (row.querySelector('.task-due-pill.today'))   return {key:'today',   label:'Heute fällig', cls:'sgh--blue'};
    if (row.querySelector('.task-due-pill.planned')) return {key:'planned', label:'Geplant', cls:'sgh--gray'};
    return {key:'open', label:'Ohne Termin', cls:'sgh--gray'};
  };

  // Anzahl pro Bucket vorberechnen
  var counts = {};
  rows.forEach(function(row) { var k = getBucket(row).key; counts[k] = (counts[k] || 0) + 1; });

  var lastKey = null;
  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var bucket = getBucket(row);
    if (bucket.key !== lastKey) {
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'task-section-header ' + bucket.cls;
      div.innerHTML = '<span class="tsh-label">' + bucket.label + '</span>'
                    + '<span class="tsh-count">' + (counts[bucket.key] || '') + '</span>';
      row.parentNode.insertBefore(div, row);
      lastKey = bucket.key;
    }
  });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
//  ANALYSE 2.0
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════

var _auPeriod = 'week';
var _auPeriodRecords = null;

function auSetPeriod(period, btn) {
  _auPeriod = period;
  document.querySelectorAll('.au-period-btn').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('au-period-active'); });
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('au-period-active');
  renderAuswertung();
}

function _auFilterRecords(records) {
  var now = new Date();
  var start;
  if (_auPeriod === 'today') {
    start = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  } else if (_auPeriod === 'week') {
    start = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400000);
  } else if (_auPeriod === 'month') {
    start = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
  } else {
    return records;
  }
  return records.filter(function(r) {
    var ts = getRecordTimestamp(r);
    if (!ts) return false;
    var d = parseCallTimestamp(ts);
    return d && d >= start;
  });
}

function renderAuswertung() {
  var all = allRecords || [];
  var records = _auFilterRecords(all);
  var total = records.length;

  // KPIs
  var closed = records.filter(function(r){ return isClosedStatus((r.fields||{}).dashboard_status); }).length;
  var totalDur = records.reduce(function(s,r){ return s+Number((r.fields||{}).duration_seconds||0); }, 0);
  var avgDur = total ? Math.round(totalDur/total) : 0;
  var avgDurLabel = !total ? '–' : avgDur < 60 ? avgDur+'s' : Math.floor(avgDur/60)+':'+(String(avgDur%60).padStart(2,'0'));
  var hotCount = records.filter(function(r){ return qualKey((r.fields||{}).lead_quality)==='hot'; }).length;
  var warmCount = records.filter(function(r){ return qualKey((r.fields||{}).lead_quality)==='warm'; }).length;
  var kaltCount = records.filter(function(r){ return qualKey((r.fields||{}).lead_quality)==='kalt'; }).length;
  var unknownCount = total - hotCount - warmCount - kaltCount;
  var rate = total ? Math.round(closed/total*100) : 0;

  // Set KPI values
  _auEl('au2-calls', total || '–');
  _auEl('au2-dur', avgDurLabel);
  _auEl('au2-hot', hotCount || '–');
  _auEl('au2-rate', total ? rate+'%' : '–');

  // Trends (compare to previous period)
  var prev = _auPrevPeriodRecords(all);
  var prevTotal = prev.length;
  var prevHot = prev.filter(function(r){ return qualKey((r.fields||{}).lead_quality)==='hot'; }).length;
  var prevRate = prevTotal ? Math.round(prev.filter(function(r){ return isClosedStatus((r.fields||{}).dashboard_status); }).length/prevTotal*100) : 0;
  _auTrend('au2-calls-trend', total - prevTotal, prevTotal ? 'vs. Vorperiode' : '');
  _auTrend('au2-hot-trend', hotCount - prevHot, prevTotal ? 'vs. Vorperiode' : '');
  var rateDiff = rate - prevRate;
  _auTrend('au2-rate-trend', rateDiff, prevTotal ? '% vs. Vorperiode' : '');

  // Sparklines
  _auBuildSparkCalls(all);

  // AI Summary
  _auAiSummary(records, total, hotCount, closed);

  // Insights
  _auInsights(all, records);

  // Week chart
  _auWeekChart2(records);

  // Categories
  _auCategories2(records, total);

  // Call times
  _auCallTimes2(records, total);

  // Lead quality
  _auLeadQuality(total, hotCount, warmCount, kaltCount, unknownCount);
}


function _auEl(id, val) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = val; }

function _auTrend(id, diff, suffix) {
  var el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!el) return;
  if (!diff && diff !== 0) { el.textContent = ''; el.className = 'au2-kpi-trend'; return; }
  el.className = 'au2-kpi-trend ' + (diff > 0 ? 'up' : diff < 0 ? 'down' : '');
  el.textContent = (diff > 0 ? '↑ +' : diff < 0 ? '↓ ' : '→ ') + (diff !== 0 ? Math.abs(diff) : '') + ' ' + (suffix||'');
}

function _auPrevPeriodRecords(all) {
  var now = new Date();
  var start, end;
  if (_auPeriod === 'today') {
    end = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    start = new Date(end.getTime() - 86400000);
  } else if (_auPeriod === 'week') {
    end = new Date(now.getTime() - 7*86400000);
    start = new Date(end.getTime() - 7*86400000);
  } else if (_auPeriod === 'month') {
    end = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
    start = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth()-1, 1);
  } else { return []; }
  return all.filter(function(r) {
    var ts = getRecordTimestamp(r); if (!ts) return false;
    var d = parseCallTimestamp(ts); return d && d >= start && d < end;
  });
}

function _auBuildSparkCalls(all) {
  var el = document.getElementById('au2-spark-calls');
  if (!el) return;
  var days = 7, now = new Date();
  var counts = [];
  for (var i = days-1; i >= 0; i--) {
    var d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()-i);
    var nd = new Date(d.getTime()+86400000);
    counts.push(all.filter(function(r){ var ts=getRecordTimestamp(r); if(!ts) return false; var rd=parseCallTimestamp(ts); return rd&&rd>=d&&rd<nd; }).length);
  }
  var max = Math.max.apply(null, counts) || 1;
  el.innerHTML = counts.map(function(c, i) {
    var h = Math.max(3, Math.round(c/max*22));
    var isToday = (i === counts.length-1);
    return '<div class="au2-spark-bar" style="height:'+h+'px;background:'+(isToday?'#4B9FFF':'rgba(96,165,250,'+(0.2+i*0.05)+')')+';"></div>';
  }).join('');
}

function _auAiSummary(records, total, hotCount, closed) {
  var el = document.getElementById('au2-ai-text');
  if (!el) return;
  var periodLabel = {today:'heute', week:'diese Woche', month:'diesen Monat', all:'insgesamt'}[_auPeriod] || '';
  if (!total) {
    el.innerHTML = 'Noch keine Anrufe ' + periodLabel + '.';
    _auEl('au2-top-cat', '–'); _auEl('au2-top-cat-sub', '–');
    _auEl('au2-best-time', '–'); _auEl('au2-best-time-sub', '–');
    return;
  }
  // Top category
  var cats = {};
  records.forEach(function(r){ var c=(r.fields||{}).category||'Sonstiges'; cats[c]=(cats[c]||0)+1; });
  var topCatRaw = Object.keys(cats).sort(function(a,b){ return cats[b]-cats[a]; })[0] || '–';
  var topCat = (typeof getCallCategoryDisplayLabel === 'function' && topCatRaw !== '–')
    ? (getCallCategoryDisplayLabel({fields:{category:topCatRaw}}) || topCatRaw)
    : topCatRaw;
  var topCatCount = cats[topCatRaw] || 0;
  // Best time
  var timeBuckets = [{label:'6–9',r:[6,9],c:0},{label:'9–12',r:[9,12],c:0},{label:'12–14',r:[12,14],c:0},{label:'14–18',r:[14,18],c:0},{label:'18+',r:[18,30],c:0}];
  records.forEach(function(r){ var ts=getRecordTimestamp(r); if(!ts) return; var d=parseCallTimestamp(ts); if(!d) return; var h=d.getHours(); var ah=h<6?h+24:h; for(var i=0;i<timeBuckets.length;i++){ if(ah>=timeBuckets[i].r[0]&&ah<timeBuckets[i].r[1]){timeBuckets[i].c++;break;} } });
  var bestBucket = timeBuckets.reduce(function(best,b){ return b.c>best.c?b:best; }, timeBuckets[0]);
  var bestTimePct = total ? Math.round(bestBucket.c/total*100) : 0;
  _auEl('au2-top-cat', topCat);
  _auEl('au2-top-cat-sub', topCatCount+' von '+total+' Anrufen');
  _auEl('au2-best-time', bestBucket.label+' Uhr');
  _auEl('au2-best-time-sub', bestTimePct+'% aller Anrufe');
  var openHot = hotCount;
  el.innerHTML = 'Lara hat '+periodLabel+' <strong style="color:var(--ink);">'+total+' Anruf'+(total!==1?'e':'')+
    '</strong> entgegengenommen'+(hotCount?' — <strong style="color:#DC2626;">'+hotCount+' Hot Lead'+(hotCount!==1?'s':'')+
    '</strong>':'')+(closed?' — '+closed+' erledigt':'')+
    '. Top-Kategorie: <strong style="color:#1A6FE8;">'+topCat+'</strong>. Stosszeit: <strong style="color:var(--ink);">'+bestBucket.label+' Uhr</strong>.';
}

function _auInsights(all, filtered) {
  var list = document.getElementById('au2-insights-list');
  var badge = document.getElementById('au2-insight-badge');
  if (!list) return;
  var insights = [];
  // Open callbacks
  var openCallbacks = all.filter(function(r){ var f=r.fields||{}; return (f.callback_requested===true||f.callback_requested==='true') && !isClosedStatus(f.dashboard_status); });
  if (openCallbacks.length > 0) {
    var oldest = openCallbacks.reduce(function(oldest, r){ var ts=getRecordTimestamp(r); return (!oldest||ts<getRecordTimestamp(oldest))?r:oldest; }, null);
    var daysOld = oldest ? Math.floor((Date.now()-parseCallTimestamp(getRecordTimestamp(oldest)).getTime())/86400000) : 0;
    insights.push({bg:'#FFF7ED', iconBg:'#D97706', icon:'phone-call', textColor:'#92400E', text:'<strong>'+openCallbacks.length+' offene Rückruf-Anfrage'+(openCallbacks.length!==1?'n':'')+' </strong> — älteste ist '+daysOld+' Tag'+(daysOld!==1?'e':'')+' alt.'});
  }
  // Peak time
  var timeBuckets = [{label:'6–9',r:[6,9],c:0},{label:'9–12',r:[9,12],c:0},{label:'12–14',r:[12,14],c:0},{label:'14–18',r:[14,18],c:0},{label:'18+',r:[18,30],c:0}];
  filtered.forEach(function(r){ var ts=getRecordTimestamp(r); if(!ts) return; var d=parseCallTimestamp(ts); if(!d) return; var h=d.getHours(); var ah=h<6?h+24:h; for(var i=0;i<timeBuckets.length;i++){ if(ah>=timeBuckets[i].r[0]&&ah<timeBuckets[i].r[1]){timeBuckets[i].c++;break;} } });
  var best = timeBuckets.reduce(function(b,x){ return x.c>b.c?x:b; }, timeBuckets[0]);
  var pct = filtered.length ? Math.round(best.c/filtered.length*100) : 0;
  if (pct >= 30) insights.push({bg:'#EEF4FF', iconBg:'#1A6FE8', icon:'clock', textColor:'#1a6fe8', text:'<strong>Stosszeit '+best.label+' Uhr</strong> — '+pct+'% aller Anrufe kommen dann. Sicher erreichbar?'});
  // Hot leads trend
  var hotCount = filtered.filter(function(r){ return qualKey((r.fields||{}).lead_quality)==='hot'; }).length;
  if (hotCount > 0) insights.push({bg:'#ECFDF5', iconBg:'#059669', icon:'trending-up', textColor:'#065f46', text:'<strong>'+hotCount+' Hot Lead'+(hotCount!==1?'s':'')+'</strong> identifiziert — '+Math.round(hotCount/Math.max(filtered.length,1)*100)+'% aller Anrufe.'});

  if (badge) badge.textContent = insights.length + ' Hinweis' + (insights.length!==1?'e':'');
  if (!insights.length) {
    list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate2);text-align:center;padding:10px 0;">Keine offenen Hinweise.</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = insights.map(function(ins) {
    return '<div class="au2-insight" style="background:'+ins.bg+';margin-bottom:6px;">'+
      '<div class="au2-insight-icon" style="background:'+ins.iconBg+';"><i class="ph-bold ph-'+ins.icon+'" style="color:#fff;" style="font-size:13px;" aria-hidden="true"></i></div>'+
      '<div class="au2-insight-text" style="color:'+ins.textColor+';">'+ins.text+'</div>'+
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
  if (typeof refreshLucideIcons === 'function') refreshLucideIcons();
}

function _auWeekChart2(records) {
  var el = document.getElementById('au2-week-chart');
  var footL = document.getElementById('au2-chart-foot-l');
  var footR = document.getElementById('au2-chart-foot-r');
  if (!el) return;
  var now = new Date();
  var dayNames = ['So','Mo','Di','Mi','Do','Fr','Sa'];
  var days = [];
  for (var i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
    var d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()-i);
    var nd = new Date(d.getTime()+86400000);
    var count = records.filter(function(r){ var ts=getRecordTimestamp(r); if(!ts) return false; var rd=parseCallTimestamp(ts); return rd&&rd>=d&&rd<nd; }).length;
    days.push({label:dayNames[d.getDay()], count:count, today:i===0});
  }
  var maxC = Math.max.apply(null, days.map(function(d){ return d.count; })) || 1;
  var total = days.reduce(function(s,d){ return s+d.count; }, 0);
  var avg = total ? (total/7).toFixed(1) : '0';
  el.innerHTML = days.map(function(day) {
    var h = Math.max(4, Math.round(day.count/maxC*60));
    return '<div class="au2-wk-col">'+
      '<div class="au2-wk-count">'+(day.count||'')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="au2-wk-bar'+(day.today?' today':'')+'" style="height:'+h+'px;"></div>'+
      '<div class="au2-wk-label'+(day.today?' today':'')+'">'+day.label+'</div>'+
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
  if (footL) footL.textContent = 'Total: '+total+' Anrufe';
  if (footR) footR.textContent = 'Ø '+avg+' / Tag';
}

function _auCategories2(records, total) {
  var el = document.getElementById('au2-categories');
  if (!el) return;
  var colors = {Termin:'#1A6FE8',Anfrage:'#1A6FE8',Offerte:'#E8C547',Notfall:'#DC2626',Rückruf:'#DC2626',Sonstiges:'#94A3B8'};
  var counts = {};
  records.forEach(function(r){ var c=(r.fields||{}).category||'Sonstiges'; counts[c]=(counts[c]||0)+1; });
  var sorted = Object.keys(counts).sort(function(a,b){ return counts[b]-counts[a]; }).slice(0,5);
  var maxC = sorted.length ? counts[sorted[0]] : 1;
  if (!sorted.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate2);">Keine Daten.</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML = sorted.map(function(cat) {
    var n = counts[cat], pct = Math.round(n/maxC*100);
    return '<div class="au2-bar-row"><div class="au2-bar-label">'+cat+'</div>'+
      '<div class="au2-bar-track"><div class="au2-bar-fill" style="width:'+pct+'%;background:'+(colors[cat]||'#94A3B8')+';"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="au2-bar-count">'+n+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}

function _auCallTimes2(records, total) {
  var el = document.getElementById('au2-call-times');
  if (!el) return;
  var buckets = [{label:'6–9',r:[6,9],c:0},{label:'9–12',r:[9,12],c:0},{label:'12–14',r:[12,14],c:0},{label:'14–18',r:[14,18],c:0},{label:'18+',r:[18,30],c:0}];
  records.forEach(function(r){ var ts=getRecordTimestamp(r); if(!ts) return; var d=parseCallTimestamp(ts); if(!d) return; var h=d.getHours(); var ah=h<6?h+24:h; for(var i=0;i<buckets.length;i++){ if(ah>=buckets[i].r[0]&&ah<buckets[i].r[1]){buckets[i].c++;break;} } });
  var maxC = Math.max.apply(null, buckets.map(function(b){ return b.c; })) || 1;
  el.innerHTML = buckets.map(function(b) {
    var pct = Math.round(b.c/maxC*100);
    var color = pct>=80?'#1A6FE8':pct>=50?'#93C5FD':'#BFDBFE';
    return '<div class="au2-bar-row"><div class="au2-bar-label">'+b.label+'</div>'+
      '<div class="au2-bar-track"><div class="au2-bar-fill" style="width:'+pct+'%;background:'+color+';"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="au2-bar-count">'+b.c+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}

function _auLeadQuality(total, hot, warm, kalt, unknown) {
  var el = document.getElementById('au2-lead-quality');
  if (!el) return;
  var t = total || 1;
  var rows = [
    {label:'Hot', count:hot, color:'#DC2626'},
    {label:'Warm', count:warm, color:'#E8C547'},
    {label:'Kalt', count:kalt, color:'#94A3B8'},
    {label:'Unbekannt', count:unknown, color:'#E3EAF4'},
  ];
  var maxC = Math.max.apply(null, rows.map(function(r){ return r.count; })) || 1;
  el.innerHTML = rows.map(function(row) {
    var pct = Math.round(row.count/t*100);
    var barW = Math.round(row.count/maxC*100);
    return '<div class="au2-lead-row">'+
      '<div class="au2-lead-dot" style="background:'+row.color+';"></div>'+
      '<div class="au2-lead-label">'+row.label+'</div>'+
      '<div class="au2-lead-track"><div style="height:100%;width:'+barW+'%;background:'+row.color+';border-radius:999px;"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="au2-lead-count">'+row.count+'</div>'+
      '<div class="au2-lead-pct">'+pct+'%</div>'+
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
//  VERLAUF DATUM-GRUPPEN-HEADER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
//  VERLAUF DATUM-GRUPPEN-HEADER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
function injectArchivDateHeaders(listId, records) {
  var el = document.getElementById(listId);
  if (!el) return;
  el.querySelectorAll('.archiv-date-header').forEach(function(h) { h.remove(); });
  var rows = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('.call-row:not(.hidden)'));
  if (rows.length < 2) return;

  var now = new Date();
  var todayStart     = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  var yesterdayStart = new Date(todayStart.getTime() - 86400000);
  var weekStart      = new Date(todayStart.getTime() - 6 * 86400000);
  var monthStart     = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);

  // Record-Lookup für Timestamps
  var recordMap = {};
  (records || _archivAllDone || allRecords || []).forEach(function(r) {
    if (r && r.id) recordMap[String(r.id)] = r;
  });

  var getBucket = function(id) {
    var rec = recordMap[String(id)];
    var ts = rec ? getRecordTimestamp(rec) : null;
    if (!ts) return {key:'older', label:'Älter'};
    var d = parseCallTimestamp(ts);
    if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return {key:'older', label:'Älter'};
    if (d >= todayStart)     return {key:'today',     label:'Heute'};
    if (d >= yesterdayStart) return {key:'yesterday', label:'Gestern'};
    if (d >= weekStart)      return {key:'week',      label:'Diese Woche'};
    if (d >= monthStart)     return {key:'month',     label:'Dieser Monat'};
    return {key:'older', label:'Älter'};
  };

  var lastKey = null;
  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var bucket = getBucket(row.dataset && row.dataset.id);
    if (bucket.key !== lastKey) {
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'archiv-date-header';
      div.innerHTML = '<span class="adh-label">' + bucket.label + '</span>';
      row.parentNode.insertBefore(div, row);
      lastKey = bucket.key;
    }
  });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
//  BROWSER-NOTIFICATION TOGGLE (Phase G)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
function updateBrowserNotifToggleUI() {
  var toggle = document.getElementById('browser-notif-toggle');
  var knob = document.getElementById('browser-notif-knob');
  var status = document.getElementById('browser-notif-status');
  var perm = ('Notification' in window) ? Notification.permission : 'unsupported';
  var off = localStorage.getItem('voxera_browser_notif_off') === '1';
  var active = perm === 'granted' && !off;
  if (toggle) toggle.style.background = active ? '#1A6FE8' : '#CBD5E1';
  if (knob) knob.style.left = active ? '22px' : '3px';
  if (status) {
    if (perm === 'unsupported') { status.textContent = '(nicht unterstützt)'; }
    else if (perm === 'denied') { status.textContent = '(im Browser blockiert)'; status.style.color = '#DC2626'; }
    else if (active) { status.textContent = '· Aktiv'; status.style.color = '#059669'; }
    else { status.textContent = ''; }
  }
}



function vxNormalizeTranscriptText(raw) {
  if (raw == null) return '';

  // ElevenLabs / webhook data may arrive as plain text, JSON string, array of turns,
  // or object-shaped transcript payload. Normalize all formats into readable text.
  try {
    if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
      return raw.map(function(item){
        if (item == null) return '';
        if (typeof item === 'string') return item;
        if (typeof item === 'object') {
          var speaker = item.speaker || item.role || item.type || item.author || '';
          var body = item.text || item.message || item.content || item.transcript || item.value || '';
          if (Array.isArray(body)) body = body.join(' ');
          if (body && typeof body === 'object') body = JSON.stringify(body);
          return (speaker ? String(speaker).trim() + ': ' : '') + String(body || '').trim();
        }
        return String(item || '');
      }).filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    }

    if (typeof raw === 'object') {
      if (Array.isArray(raw.turns)) return vxNormalizeTranscriptText(raw.turns);
      if (Array.isArray(raw.messages)) return vxNormalizeTranscriptText(raw.messages);
      if (Array.isArray(raw.transcript)) return vxNormalizeTranscriptText(raw.transcript);
      if (Array.isArray(raw.conversation)) return vxNormalizeTranscriptText(raw.conversation);
      if (raw.text || raw.content || raw.message) return vxNormalizeTranscriptText(raw.text || raw.content || raw.message);
      return JSON.stringify(raw);
    }

    var text = String(raw || '').trim();
    if (!text) return '';

    // Some rows store transcript JSON as string. Parse only when it is clearly JSON.
    var first = text.charAt(0);
    if (first === '[' || first === '{') {
      try {
        var parsed = JSON.parse(text);
        return vxNormalizeTranscriptText(parsed);
      } catch(parseErr) {}
    }

    return text
      .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
      .replace(/\r/g, '\n')
      .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
      .trim();
  } catch(e) {
    try { return String(raw || '').trim(); } catch(_e) { return ''; }
  }
}

function vxTranscriptAssistantName() {
  try {
    var name = '';
    if (typeof getAssistantName === 'function') name = getAssistantName();
    if (!name && typeof customerMeta !== 'undefined' && customerMeta) name = customerMeta.assistantName;
    name = String(name || 'Lara').trim();
    return name || 'Lara';
  } catch(e) {
    return 'Lara';
  }
}

function vxTranscriptSpeakerLabel(rawSpeaker) {
  var s = String(rawSpeaker || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!s) return 'Unbekannt';
  // Assistant turns should show the configured assistant name, not the brand name.
  if (s === 'agent' || s === 'assistant' || s === 'ai' || s === 'bot' || s === 'lara' || s === 'voxera') return vxTranscriptAssistantName();
  if (s === 'user' || s === 'caller' || s === 'kunde' || s === 'kundin' || s === 'anrufer' || s === 'anruferin') return 'Anrufer';
  return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
}

function vxParseTranscriptTurns(raw) {
  var text = vxNormalizeTranscriptText(raw);
  if (!text) return [];

  // Provider formats seen in Voxera data:
  // 1) "agent: ...\nuser: ..."
  // 2) "agent: ... user: ... agent: ..." (speaker labels in one long line)
  // 3) line based transcript without explicit speaker labels
  var turns = [];
  var speakerRe = /\b(agent|assistant|ai|bot|voxera|lara|user|caller|kunde|kundin|anrufer|anruferin)\s*:\s*/ig;
  var matches = [];
  var m;
  while ((m = speakerRe.exec(text)) !== null) {
    matches.push({
      speaker: vxTranscriptSpeakerLabel(m[1]),
      start: m.index,
      contentStart: speakerRe.lastIndex
    });
  }

  if (matches.length) {
    var prefix = text.slice(0, matches[0].start).trim();
    if (prefix) turns.push({ speaker:'Gesprächsverlauf', text: prefix });

    for (var i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
      var contentEnd = (i + 1 < matches.length) ? matches[i + 1].start : text.length;
      var part = text.slice(matches[i].contentStart, contentEnd).trim();
      if (!part) continue;
      // Keep the transcript readable without destroying intentional punctuation.
      part = part.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
      turns.push({ speaker: matches[i].speaker, text: part });
    }
    return turns.filter(function(t){ return t && String(t.text || '').trim(); });
  }

  // Fallback: one card per meaningful line. If there is only one line, keep it as one section.
  text.split('\n').map(function(line){ return line.trim(); }).filter(Boolean).forEach(function(line){
    turns.push({ speaker:'Gesprächsverlauf', text: line });
  });
  return turns.filter(function(t){ return t && String(t.text || '').trim(); });
}

function vxRenderTranscriptCardHtml(rawTranscript) {
  var normalized = vxNormalizeTranscriptText(rawTranscript);
  var turns = vxParseTranscriptTurns(normalized);
  var countLabel = turns.length ? (turns.length + ' Abschnitte') : 'Rohtext';
  var html = '';
  html += '<div class="vx-transcript-card" id="vx-call-transcript-card">';
  html +=   '<div class="vx-transcript-head" onclick="var c=this.closest(\'.vx-transcript-card\'); if(c)c.classList.toggle(\'is-open\');">';
  html +=     '<i class="ph-bold ph-file-text" aria-hidden="true"></i>';
  html +=     '<div class="vx-transcript-title">Gesprächsverlauf</div>';
  html +=     '<div class="vx-transcript-meta">' + escapeHtml(countLabel) + '</div>';
  html +=     '<i class="ph-light ph-caret-right vx-transcript-chev" aria-hidden="true"></i>';
  html +=   '</div>';
  html +=   '<div class="vx-transcript-panel">';
  if (turns.length) {
    html += '<div class="vx-transcript-list">';
    turns.forEach(function(turn){
      var speakerLabel = String(turn.speaker || '').trim();
      var assistantLabel = String(vxTranscriptAssistantName()).trim().toLowerCase();
      var isAgent = !!speakerLabel && speakerLabel.toLowerCase() === assistantLabel;
      html += '<div class="vx-transcript-turn' + (isAgent ? ' is-agent' : '') + '">';
      html +=   '<div class="vx-transcript-speaker">' + escapeHtml(turn.speaker || 'Unbekannt') + '</div>';
      html +=   '<div class="vx-transcript-text">' + escapeHtml(turn.text || '') + '</div>';
      html += '</div>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
  } else {
    html += '<div class="vx-transcript-empty">Kein lesbarer Gesprächsverlauf vorhanden.</div>';
  }
  html +=   '</div>';
  html += '</div>';
  return html;
}


function vxGetCallSummary(callOrFields) {
  var src = (callOrFields && callOrFields.fields) ? callOrFields.fields : (callOrFields || {});
  var summaryKeys = ['call_summary', 'summary', 'call_summary_short', 'ai_summary', 'analysis_summary'];
  for (var i = 0; i < summaryKeys.length; i++) {
    var val = src[summaryKeys[i]];
    if (val == null) continue;
    var text = String(val).trim();
    if (text) return text;
  }
  return '';
}

function vxGetCallTranscript(callOrFields) {
  var src = (callOrFields && callOrFields.fields) ? callOrFields.fields : (callOrFields || {});
  var transcriptKeys = ['transcription', 'transcript'];
  for (var i = 0; i < transcriptKeys.length; i++) {
    var val = src[transcriptKeys[i]];
    if (val == null) continue;
    var text = String(val).trim();
    if (text) return text;
  }
  return '';
}

function vxGetCallAudioUrl(callOrFields) {
  var src = (callOrFields && callOrFields.fields) ? callOrFields.fields : (callOrFields || {});
  var directKeys = [
    'recording_url','recordingUrl','recordingURL','call_recording_url','callRecordingUrl','callRecordingURL',
    'audio_url','audioUrl','audioURL','call_audio_url','callAudioUrl','conversation_audio_url','conversationAudioUrl',
    'elevenlabs_audio_url','elevenlabsAudioUrl','elevenlabs_recording_url','elevenlabsRecordingUrl',
    'twilio_recording_url','twilioRecordingUrl','voicemail_url','voicemailUrl','media_url','mediaUrl',
    'recording','audio','audio_file','audioFile','audio_download_url','download_url','signed_url','signedUrl'
  ];
  function validAudioUrl(text){
    text = String(text || '').trim();
    if (!text) return '';
    if (/^data:audio\//i.test(text)) return text;
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text) && (/audio|record|recording|voice|voicemail|media|download|signed|mp3|wav|m4a|ogg/i.test(text))) return text;
    return '';
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < directKeys.length; i++) {
    var val = src[directKeys[i]];
    var url = validAudioUrl(val);
    if (url) return url;
  }
  var seen = [];
  function scan(obj, depth){
    if (!obj || depth > 4) return '';
    if (typeof obj === 'string') {
      var direct = validAudioUrl(obj);
      if (direct) return direct;
      try {
        var parsed = JSON.parse(obj);
        return scan(parsed, depth + 1);
      } catch(e) { return ''; }
    }
    if (typeof obj !== 'object') return '';
    if (seen.indexOf(obj) >= 0) return '';
    seen.push(obj);
    var keys = Object.keys(obj);
    for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
      var key = keys[k];
      var value = obj[key];
      if (/audio|record|recording|voice|voicemail|media|download|signed/i.test(key)) {
        var byKey = validAudioUrl(value);
        if (byKey) return byKey;
      }
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
      var nested = scan(obj[keys[j]], depth + 1);
      if (nested) return nested;
    }
    return '';
  }
  return scan(src, 0);
}
function vxGetElevenLabsConversationId(callOrFields) {
  var src = (callOrFields && callOrFields.fields) ? callOrFields.fields : (callOrFields || {});
  var keys = ['elevenlabs_conversation_id','elevenlabsConversationId','conversation_id','conversationId','eleven_conversation_id','agent_conversation_id','call_conversation_id'];
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var val = src[keys[i]];
    if (val !== undefined && val !== null && String(val).trim()) return String(val).trim();
  }
  return '';
}
window.vxGetElevenLabsConversationId = vxGetElevenLabsConversationId;

function vxAudioEscapeAttr(value){
  return String(value || '').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/</g,'&lt;');
}
function vxAudioEscapeText(value){
  return String(value || '').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
}
function vxRenderModernAudioPlayerHtml(audioUrl, metaText){
  var safeUrl = vxAudioEscapeAttr(audioUrl);
  var safeMeta = vxAudioEscapeText(metaText || 'Bereit zum Abspielen');
  var bars = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
    var h = 18 + ((i * 7) % 28);
    if (i % 5 === 0) h += 12;
    if (i > 24) h = Math.max(12, h - 10);
    bars += '<span style="height:'+h+'%"></span>';
  }
  return '<div class="vx-audio-modern" data-vx-audio-player data-audio-url="'+safeUrl+'">'
    + '<div class="vx-audio-modern__top"><div class="vx-audio-modern__meta"><div class="vx-audio-modern__title">Audioaufnahme</div><div class="vx-audio-modern__sub"><span></span>'+safeMeta+'</div></div></div>'
    + '<div class="vx-audio-modern__surface">'
    + '<div class="vx-audio-modern__controls">'
    + '<button class="vx-audio-modern__btn" type="button" data-vx-audio-action="back" aria-label="10 Sekunden zurück">↺</button>'
    + '<button class="vx-audio-modern__btn vx-audio-modern__btn--primary" type="button" data-vx-audio-action="play" aria-label="Audio abspielen">▶</button>'
    + '<div class="vx-audio-modern__timeline"><div class="vx-audio-modern__wave" aria-hidden="true">'+bars+'</div><div class="vx-audio-modern__seek-feedback" data-vx-audio-seek-feedback aria-hidden="true"></div><input class="vx-audio-modern__range" data-vx-audio-range type="range" min="0" max="1000" value="0"><div class="vx-audio-modern__time"><span data-vx-audio-current>0:00</span><span data-vx-audio-duration>0:00</span></div></div>'
    + '<button class="vx-audio-modern__btn" type="button" data-vx-audio-action="forward" aria-label="10 Sekunden vor">↻</button>'
    + '</div><div class="vx-audio-modern__bottom"><div class="vx-audio-modern__volume"><span aria-hidden="true">⌁</span><input type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" value="1" data-vx-audio-volume aria-label="Lautstärke"></div><div class="vx-audio-modern__speed">'
    + '<button class="vx-audio-modern__speed-btn is-active" type="button" data-vx-audio-speed="1">1x</button>'
    + '<button class="vx-audio-modern__speed-btn" type="button" data-vx-audio-speed="1.25">1.25x</button>'
    + '<button class="vx-audio-modern__speed-btn" type="button" data-vx-audio-speed="1.5">1.5x</button>'
    + '</div><div class="vx-audio-modern__status" data-vx-audio-status>Bereit zum Abspielen</div></div>'
    + '</div><audio class="vx-audio-modern__audio" preload="metadata" playsinline src="'+safeUrl+'"></audio>'
    + '</div>';
}

function vxRenderAudioStateCardHtml(state, message, conversationId){
  var attr = conversationId ? ' data-conversation-id="'+vxAudioEscapeAttr(conversationId)+'" data-vx-audio-auto="1"' : '';
  var safeMessage = vxAudioEscapeText(message || '');
  var loading = state === 'loading' ? '<div class="vx-audio-state__spinner" aria-hidden="true"></div>' : '';
  var retry = state === 'error' && conversationId ? '<button type="button" class="vx-audio-state__retry" onclick="vxTryLoadElevenLabsAudioFromDashboard(this)">Erneut versuchen</button>' : '';
  return '<div class="vx-transcript-card vx-audio-state-card" id="vx-call-audio-card"'+attr+'><div class="vx-transcript-head"><i class="ph-bold ph-waveform" aria-hidden="true"></i><div class="vx-transcript-title">Audioaufnahme</div></div><div class="vx-audio-state vx-audio-state--'+state+'">'+loading+'<div>'+safeMessage+'</div>'+retry+'<div class="vx-audio-fetch-status" aria-live="polite"></div></div></div>';
}

function vxRenderCallAudioCardHtml(callOrFields) {
  var audioUrl = vxGetCallAudioUrl(callOrFields);
  var conversationId = (typeof vxGetElevenLabsConversationId === 'function') ? vxGetElevenLabsConversationId(callOrFields) : '';
  if (audioUrl) {
    return '<div class="vx-transcript-card" id="vx-call-audio-card"><div style="padding:12px 14px;border-top:0.5px solid var(--line);">' + vxRenderModernAudioPlayerHtml(audioUrl, 'Bereit zum Abspielen') + '</div></div>';
  }
  if (conversationId) {
    return vxRenderAudioStateCardHtml('loading', 'Aufnahme wird geladen …', conversationId);
  }
  return vxRenderAudioStateCardHtml('empty', 'Für diesen Eintrag ist keine Aufnahme verfügbar.', '');
}
async function vxTryLoadElevenLabsAudioFromDashboard(trigger) {
  var card = trigger && trigger.closest ? trigger.closest('#vx-call-audio-card') : (trigger && trigger.id === 'vx-call-audio-card' ? trigger : document.getElementById('vx-call-audio-card'));
  var status = card ? card.querySelector('.vx-audio-fetch-status') : null;
  var conversationId = card ? String(card.getAttribute('data-conversation-id') || '').trim() : '';
  if (!conversationId || !card) return false;
  if (card.getAttribute('data-vx-audio-loading') === '1') return false;
  card.setAttribute('data-vx-audio-loading','1');
  var btn = trigger && trigger.tagName === 'BUTTON' ? trigger : null;
  var endpoints = [
    '/.netlify/functions/elevenlabs-conversation-audio?conversation_id=' + encodeURIComponent(conversationId)
  ];
  if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
  if (status) status.textContent = '';
  try {
    for (var i = 0; i < endpoints.length; i++) {
      var res = await fetch(endpoints[i], { method:'GET' });
      if (!res.ok) continue;
      var ct = String(res.headers.get('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
      var url = '';
      if (ct.indexOf('application/json') >= 0) {
        var json = await res.json();
        url = json.audio_url || json.audioUrl || json.recording_url || json.url || '';
      } else if (ct.indexOf('audio/') >= 0 || ct.indexOf('application/octet-stream') >= 0) {
        var blob = await res.blob();
        url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      }
      if (url && card) {
        card.outerHTML = '<div class="vx-transcript-card" id="vx-call-audio-card"><div style="padding:12px 14px;border-top:0.5px solid var(--line);">' + vxRenderModernAudioPlayerHtml(url, 'Bereit zum Abspielen') + '</div></div>';
        if (window.vxHydrateModernAudioPlayers) window.vxHydrateModernAudioPlayers(document);
        return true;
      }
    }
    card.outerHTML = vxRenderAudioStateCardHtml('error', 'Aufnahme konnte nicht geladen werden.', conversationId);
    return false;
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn('[voxera-audio] loading failed', e);
    card.outerHTML = vxRenderAudioStateCardHtml('error', 'Aufnahme konnte nicht geladen werden.', conversationId);
    return false;
  } finally {
    if (card) card.removeAttribute('data-vx-audio-loading');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
  }
}
function vxAutoLoadAudioCards(root){
  (root || document).querySelectorAll('#vx-call-audio-card[data-vx-audio-auto="1"]').forEach(function(card){
    if (card.getAttribute('data-vx-audio-loading') === '1' || card.getAttribute('data-vx-audio-tried') === '1') return;
    card.setAttribute('data-vx-audio-tried','1');
    vxTryLoadElevenLabsAudioFromDashboard(card);
  });
}
window.vxTryLoadElevenLabsAudioFromDashboard = vxTryLoadElevenLabsAudioFromDashboard;
window.vxAutoLoadAudioCards = vxAutoLoadAudioCards;
window.vxGetCallAudioUrl = vxGetCallAudioUrl;
window.vxRenderCallAudioCardHtml = vxRenderCallAudioCardHtml;
window.vxRenderCallAudioCardHtml = vxRenderCallAudioCardHtml;

(function initVoxeraModernAudioPlayer(){
  if (window.__vxModernAudioPlayerInit) return;
  window.__vxModernAudioPlayerInit = true;
  var BOOST_GAIN = 1.7;
  function formatTime(seconds){
    if (!isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return '0:00';
    var mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    var secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return mins + ':' + String(secs).padStart(2,'0');
  }
  function setStatus(player, text){
    var el = player && player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-status]');
    if (el) el.textContent = text || '';
  }
  function updateProgressNow(player, audio){
    if (!player || !audio) return;
    var cur = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-current]');
    var range = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-range]');
    if (cur) cur.textContent = formatTime(audio.currentTime || 0);
    if (range && isFinite(audio.duration) && audio.duration > 0) {
      var progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1000, Math.round(((audio.currentTime || 0) / audio.duration) * 1000)));
      range.value = String(progress);
      range.style.setProperty('--vx-audio-progress', String(Math.round(progress / 10)) + '%');
    }
  }
  function showSeekFeedback(player, label, direction, button){
    if (!player) return;
    var el = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-seek-feedback]');
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = label;
      el.classList.remove('is-back','is-forward','is-visible');
      void el.offsetWidth;
      if (direction) el.classList.add(direction === 'back' ? 'is-back' : 'is-forward');
      el.classList.add('is-visible');
      clearTimeout(el.__vxSeekTimer);
      el.__vxSeekTimer = setTimeout(function(){ el.classList.remove('is-visible'); }, 720);
    }
    if (button) {
      button.classList.add('is-tap-feedback');
      clearTimeout(button.__vxTapTimer);
      button.__vxTapTimer = setTimeout(function(){ button.classList.remove('is-tap-feedback'); }, 260);
    }
  }
  function hydratePlayer(player){
    if (!player || player.__vxAudioHydrated) return player && player.__vxAudioState;
    var audio = player.querySelector('audio');
    if (!audio) return null;
    player.__vxAudioHydrated = true;
    player.__vxAudioState = { audio: audio, audioContext: null, source: null, gain: null };
    audio.playsInline = true;
    audio.preload = 'metadata';
    audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function(){
      var dur = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-duration]');
      if (dur) dur.textContent = formatTime(audio.duration);
      setStatus(player, 'Bereit zum Abspielen');
    });
    audio.addEventListener('timeupdate', function(){
      var cur = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-current]');
      var range = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-range]');
      if (cur) cur.textContent = formatTime(audio.currentTime);
      if (range && isFinite(audio.duration) && audio.duration > 0) {
        range.value = String(Math.round((audio.currentTime / audio.duration) * 1000));
        range.style.setProperty('--vx-audio-progress', String(Math.round((audio.currentTime / audio.duration) * 100)) + '%');
      }
    });
    audio.addEventListener('play', function(){
      var btn = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-action="play"]');
      if (btn) btn.textContent = 'Ⅱ';
      setStatus(player, 'Wird abgespielt');
    });
    audio.addEventListener('pause', function(){
      var btn = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-action="play"]');
      if (btn) btn.textContent = '▶';
      if (!audio.ended) setStatus(player, 'Pausiert');
    });
    audio.addEventListener('ended', function(){
      var btn = player.querySelector('[data-vx-audio-action="play"]');
      if (btn) btn.textContent = '▶';
      setStatus(player, 'Abgeschlossen');
    });
    audio.addEventListener('error', function(){ setStatus(player, 'Audio konnte nicht geladen werden'); });
    return player.__vxAudioState;
  }
  function ensureBoost(player){
    var state = hydratePlayer(player);
    if (!state || state.gain) return state;
    var AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) { setStatus(player, 'Bereit'); return state; }
    try {
      state.audioContext = new AudioContextClass();
      state.source = state.audioContext.createMediaElementSource(state.audio);
      state.gain = state.audioContext.createGain();
      state.gain.gain.value = BOOST_GAIN;
      state.source.connect(state.gain);
      state.gain.connect(state.audioContext.destination);
      setStatus(player, 'Bereit zum Abspielen');
    } catch(e) {
      setStatus(player, 'Bereit');
    }
    return state;
  }
  function closestPlayer(el){ return el && el.closest ? el.closest('[data-vx-audio-player]') : null; }
  document.addEventListener('click', async function(ev){
    var actionBtn = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('[data-vx-audio-action]') : null;
    var speedBtn = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('[data-vx-audio-speed]') : null;
    if (!actionBtn && !speedBtn) return;
    var player = closestPlayer(actionBtn || speedBtn);
    if (!player) return;
    var state = ensureBoost(player);
    if (!state || !state.audio) return;
    var audio = state.audio;
    if (actionBtn) {
      var action = actionBtn.getAttribute('data-vx-audio-action');
      if (action === 'play') {
        try {
          if (state.audioContext && state.audioContext.state === 'suspended') await state.audioContext.resume();
          if (audio.paused) await audio.play(); else audio.pause();
        } catch(e) { setStatus(player, 'Wiedergabe blockiert · erneut tippen'); }
      } else if (action === 'back') {
        audio.currentTime = Math.max(0, (audio.currentTime || 0) - 10);
        updateProgressNow(player, audio);
        showSeekFeedback(player, '−10s', 'back', actionBtn);
      } else if (action === 'forward') {
        var dur = isFinite(audio.duration) ? audio.duration : (audio.currentTime || 0) + 10;
        audio.currentTime = Math.min(dur, (audio.currentTime || 0) + 10);
        updateProgressNow(player, audio);
        showSeekFeedback(player, '+10s', 'forward', actionBtn);
      }
    }
    if (speedBtn) {
      var speed = Number(speedBtn.getAttribute('data-vx-audio-speed') || '1') || 1;
      audio.playbackRate = speed;
      player.querySelectorAll('[data-vx-audio-speed]').forEach(function(btn){ btn.classList.remove('is-active'); });
      speedBtn.classList.add('is-active');
      setStatus(player, speed + 'x');
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener('input', function(ev){
    var range = ev.target && ev.target.matches && ev.target.matches('[data-vx-audio-range]') ? ev.target : null;
    var volume = ev.target && ev.target.matches && ev.target.matches('[data-vx-audio-volume]') ? ev.target : null;
    if (!range && !volume) return;
    var player = closestPlayer(range || volume);
    var state = hydratePlayer(player);
    if (!state || !state.audio) return;
    if (volume) {
      state.audio.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(volume.value) || 0));
      return;
    }
    if (!isFinite(state.audio.duration) || state.audio.duration <= 0) return;
    state.audio.currentTime = (Number(range.value) / 1000) * state.audio.duration;
    updateProgressNow(player, state.audio);
  });
  window.vxHydrateModernAudioPlayers = function(root){
    (root || document).querySelectorAll('[data-vx-audio-player]').forEach(hydratePlayer);
    if (window.vxAutoLoadAudioCards) window.vxAutoLoadAudioCards(root || document);
  };
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){ window.vxHydrateModernAudioPlayers(document); });
  if (window.MutationObserver) {
    new MutationObserver(function(){ window.vxHydrateModernAudioPlayers(document); }).observe(document.documentElement, { childList:true, subtree:true });
  }
})();


function vxGetDetailNavStack() {
  if (!Array.isArray(window.vxDetailNavStack)) window.vxDetailNavStack = [];
  return window.vxDetailNavStack;
}

function vxEnsureDetailRootListEntry() {
  var stack = vxGetDetailNavStack();
  if (stack.length) return stack;
  var activeTab = (typeof getCurrentTabName === 'function' && getCurrentTabName()) || window.__currentTab || 'requests';
  stack.push({ type: 'list', tab: String(activeTab || 'requests') });
  return stack;
}

function vxDetailPushCurrentContext() {
  var t = window._vxCurrentDetailType;
  var id = t === 'task' ? window._vxCurrentTaskId : window._vxCurrentCallId;
  if (!t || !id) return;
  var stack = vxEnsureDetailRootListEntry();
  var top = stack.length ? stack[stack.length - 1] : null;
  if (top && top.type === t && String(top.id) === String(id)) return;
  stack.push({ type: t, id: String(id) });
}

function vxHandleDetailBack() {
  var stack = vxGetDetailNavStack();
  var prev = stack.length ? stack.pop() : null;
  if (!prev) {
    if (typeof hideCallDetail === 'function') hideCallDetail();
    else if (typeof vxForceCloseCallDetail === 'function') vxForceCloseCallDetail('empty-detail-nav-stack');
    return;
  }
  if (prev.type === 'call' && prev.id && typeof showCallDetail === 'function') {
    showCallDetail(String(prev.id), { fromBackStack: true });
    return;
  }
  if (prev.type === 'task' && prev.id && typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') {
    showTaskDetail(String(prev.id), { fromBackStack: true });
    return;
  }
  if (prev.type === 'list') {
    if (typeof hideCallDetail === 'function') hideCallDetail();
    if (typeof showTab === 'function') {
      var tab = String(prev.tab || 'requests');
      var navEl = (typeof findTabNavElement === 'function') ? findTabNavElement(tab) : null;
      showTab(tab, navEl, { historyMode: 'none' });
    }
    return;
  }
  if (typeof hideCallDetail === 'function') hideCallDetail();
}
window.vxHandleDetailBack = vxHandleDetailBack;

function vxRenderDetailBackLinkHtml() { return ''; }

// Öffnet einen Call aus der Kontakt-Historie heraus
function vxOpenCallFromHistory(callId) {
  if (!callId) return;
  vxDetailPushCurrentContext();
  // Record in allRecords suchen
  var rec = null;
  if (typeof allRecords !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(allRecords)) {
    rec = allRecords.find(function(r) { return String((r && r.id) || '') === String(callId); });
  }
  if (rec) {
    window._vxActiveRecordId = String(callId);
    if (typeof renderAnrufe === 'function') renderAnrufe();
    if (typeof renderDashPriorityList === 'function') renderDashPriorityList();
    // Record gefunden — direkt Detail öffnen
    if (typeof vxOpenDetailV2 === 'function') {
      vxOpenDetailV2(String(callId));
    } else if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') {
      showCallDetail(String(callId), { fromHistoryEntry: true });
    }
  } else {
    // Record nicht im Cache — Tab wechseln + öffnen
    var navEl = document.getElementById('nav-anrufe') || document.getElementById('mnav-anrufe');
    if (typeof showTab === 'function') showTab('anrufe', navEl);
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (typeof vxOpenDetailV2 === 'function') vxOpenDetailV2(String(callId));
    }, 200);
  }
}

// ── Als gelesen markieren: read_at setzen beim Öffnen ──────────────
// Nicht-blockierend, kein Toast, nur wenn read_at noch NULL ist
// ── Manual unread guard: verhindert, dass ein manuell als ungelesen markierter
// Eintrag durch eine noch offene Detailansicht sofort wieder als gelesen markiert wird.
function vxGetManualUnreadIdSet() {
  if (!window._vxManualUnreadIds || typeof window._vxManualUnreadIds.add !== 'function') {
    window._vxManualUnreadIds = new Set();
  }
  return window._vxManualUnreadIds;
}
function vxPatchLocalRecordReadState(recordId, isUnread, readAtIso) {
  var id = String(recordId || '');
  var lists = [];
  try { if (typeof allRecords !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(allRecords)) lists.push(allRecords); } catch(e) {}
  try { if (Array.isArray(window.allRecords)) lists.push(window.allRecords); } catch(e) {}
  lists.forEach(function(list) {
    list.forEach(function(rec) {
      if (!rec) return;
      var f = rec.fields || {};
      var recId = String(rec.id || rec.call_id || f.id || f.call_id || '');
      if (recId !== id) return;
      if (!rec.fields) rec.fields = f;
      if (isUnread) {
        rec.read_at = null;
        rec.fields.read_at = null;
        rec.is_unread = true;
        rec.unread = true;
        rec.fields.is_unread = true;
        rec.fields.unread = true;
      } else {
        rec.read_at = readAtIso;
        rec.fields.read_at = readAtIso;
        rec.is_unread = false;
        rec.unread = false;
        rec.fields.is_unread = false;
        rec.fields.unread = false;
      }
    });
  });
}
function vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange() {
  if (typeof renderDashboard === 'function') renderDashboard(allRecords || [], allManualTaskRecords || []);
  if (typeof renderAnrufe === 'function') renderAnrufe();
  if (typeof renderDashPriorityList === 'function') renderDashPriorityList();
}

function vxMarkCallAsRead(callId) {
  if (!callId) return;
  if (typeof vxGetManualUnreadIdSet === 'function') vxGetManualUnreadIdSet().delete(String(callId));
  // Record im Cache suchen
  var rec = null;
  if (typeof allRecords !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(allRecords)) {
    rec = allRecords.find(function(r) { return String((r && r.id) || '') === String(callId); });
  }
  if (!rec || !rec.fields) return;
  if (rec.fields.read_at) return;
  var readAtIso = new Date().toISOString();
  if (typeof vxPatchLocalRecordReadState === 'function') vxPatchLocalRecordReadState(callId, false, readAtIso);
  else rec.fields.read_at = readAtIso;
  if (typeof vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange === 'function') vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange();
  // DB async aktualisieren — non-blocking, kein Toast
  if (typeof _sb !== 'undefined' && _sb) {
    _sb.from('calls')
      .update({ read_at: readAtIso })
      .eq('id', callId)
      .is('read_at', null)
      .then(function(res) {
        if (res && res.error) {
          if (typeof vxPatchLocalRecordReadState === 'function') vxPatchLocalRecordReadState(callId, true, null);
          else rec.fields.read_at = null;
          if (typeof vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange === 'function') vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange();
        }
      })
      .catch(function() {
        if (typeof vxPatchLocalRecordReadState === 'function') vxPatchLocalRecordReadState(callId, true, null);
        else rec.fields.read_at = null;
        if (typeof vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange === 'function') vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange();
      });
  }
}

function vxMarkRequestAsRead(recordId) {
  if (!recordId) return Promise.resolve(false);
  var id = String(recordId);
  if (typeof vxGetManualUnreadIdSet === 'function') vxGetManualUnreadIdSet().delete(id);
  var readAtIso = new Date().toISOString();
  if (typeof vxPatchLocalRecordReadState === 'function') vxPatchLocalRecordReadState(id, false, readAtIso);
  if (typeof vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange === 'function') vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange();
  if (!(typeof _sb !== 'undefined' && _sb)) return Promise.resolve(true);
  return _sb.from('calls').update({ read_at: readAtIso }).eq('id', id).then(function(res){
    if (res && res.error) {
      console.warn('[vxRequestRead] read_at update failed.', res.error);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.warn('[vxRequestRead] read_at update failed.', err);
    return false;
  });
}

function vxMarkRequestAsUnread(recordId) {
  if (!recordId) return Promise.resolve(false);
  var id = String(recordId);
  if (typeof vxGetManualUnreadIdSet === 'function') vxGetManualUnreadIdSet().add(id);
  if (typeof vxPatchLocalRecordReadState === 'function') vxPatchLocalRecordReadState(id, true, null);
  if (typeof vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange === 'function') vxRefreshAfterReadStateChange();
  if (!(typeof _sb !== 'undefined' && _sb)) return Promise.resolve(true);
  return _sb.from('calls').update({ read_at: null }).eq('id', id).then(function(res){
    if (res && res.error) {
      console.warn('[vxRequestUnread] read_at NULL update failed.', res.error);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.warn('[vxRequestUnread] read_at NULL update failed.', err);
    return false;
  });
}



function vxIsDetailHash() {
  var h = String(window.location.hash || '');
  return /^#(?:call|task)\/.+/.test(h);
}

function vxForceCloseCallDetail(reason) {
  try {
    var page = document.getElementById('call-detail-page');
    var splitRight = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-right');
    var splitEmpty = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-empty');
    var bottomBar = document.getElementById('vx-cd-bottom-bar');
    if (bottomBar) bottomBar.style.display = 'none';
    if (page) {
      page.classList.remove('is-open');
      page.classList.remove('is-fullscreen');
      page.classList.remove('vx-detail-focus');
      document.body.classList.remove('vx-requests-focus-mode');
      page.removeAttribute('data-vx-detail-type');
      page.removeAttribute('data-vx-detail-id');
      page.style.display = 'none';
      page.style.position = 'fixed';
      page.style.top = '0';
      page.style.left = window.innerWidth < 768 ? '0' : '232px';
      page.style.right = '0';
      page.style.bottom = '0';
      page.style.zIndex = '9999';
      page.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      page.style.overflowY = '';
      page.style.overflowX = '';
      if (splitRight && splitRight.contains(page)) document.body.appendChild(page);
    }
    var wrap = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
    if (wrap) {
      wrap.scrollTop = 0;
      wrap.style.overflowY = '';
      wrap.style.overflowX = '';
      wrap.style.height = '';
      wrap.style.boxSizing = '';
      wrap.style.width = '';
      wrap.style.minHeight = '';
    }
    var contentEl = document.getElementById('call-detail-content');
    if (contentEl) contentEl.innerHTML = '';
    var avatarEl = document.getElementById('call-detail-avatar');
    if (avatarEl) avatarEl.textContent = '??';
    var titleEl = document.getElementById('call-detail-title');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = '';
    var subtitleEl = document.getElementById('call-detail-subtitle');
    if (subtitleEl) subtitleEl.textContent = '';
    var dateEl = document.getElementById('call-detail-banner-date');
    if (dateEl) dateEl.textContent = '';
    if (typeof vxClearActiveRequestRow === 'function') vxClearActiveRequestRow();
    if (splitEmpty) splitEmpty.style.display = '';
    var detailV2El = document.getElementById('requests-detail-v2');
    if (detailV2El) { detailV2El.style.display = 'none'; detailV2El.innerHTML = ''; }
    var bar = document.getElementById('split-action-bar');
    if (bar) bar.remove();
    window._vxCurrentCallId = null;
    window._vxCurrentTaskId = null;
    window._vxCurrentDetailType = null;
    window._vxActiveRecordId = null;
    if (typeof vxSetScrollLock === 'function') vxSetScrollLock('call-detail-page', false);
    if (typeof vxSyncScrollLock === 'function') vxSyncScrollLock();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[detail] force close failed', { reason: reason || 'unknown', error: err && err.message ? err.message : err });
  }
}

function vxEnsureNoOrphanDetailView(reason) {
  try {
    var page = document.getElementById('call-detail-page');
    if (!page) return false;
    var hasDetailHash = vxIsDetailHash();
    var visible = page.classList.contains('is-open') || page.style.display === 'block' || page.style.display === 'flex';
    var hasCurrentDetail = !!(String(window._vxCurrentCallId || '').trim() || String(window._vxCurrentTaskId || '').trim());
    // Root-tab URLs (?tab=...) must never show a stale/empty detail shell.
    if (!hasDetailHash && (visible || hasCurrentDetail)) {
      vxForceCloseCallDetail(reason || 'orphan-detail');
      return true;
    }
    // Defensive: if CSS/inline styles expose the shell without an explicit open class, close it.
    if (!hasDetailHash && !page.classList.contains('is-open') && (page.style.display === 'block' || page.style.display === 'flex')) {
      vxForceCloseCallDetail(reason || 'visible-without-open-class');
      return true;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[detail] orphan guard failed', { reason: reason || 'unknown', error: err && err.message ? err.message : err });
  }
  return false;
}
window.vxEnsureNoOrphanDetailView = vxEnsureNoOrphanDetailView;
window.vxForceCloseCallDetail = vxForceCloseCallDetail;

function showCallDetail(callId, options) {
  try {
    options = options || {};
    callId = String(callId || '').trim();
    if (!callId) {
      console.warn('[detail] blocked open without id', { source: 'showCallDetail' });
      if (typeof vxForceCloseCallDetail === 'function') vxForceCloseCallDetail('showCallDetail:missing-id');
      return;
    }
    var page = document.getElementById('call-detail-page');
    if (!page) return;

    // Als gelesen markieren: new → in_progress (non-blocking)
    vxMarkCallAsRead(callId);

    if (!options.fromBackStack) {
      var stack = vxGetDetailNavStack();
      var hasOpenDetail = !!(window._vxCurrentCallId || window._vxCurrentTaskId);
      if (!hasOpenDetail) {
        var activeTab = (typeof getCurrentTabName === 'function' && getCurrentTabName()) || window.__currentTab || 'requests';
        stack.length = 0;
        stack.push({ type: 'list', tab: String(activeTab || 'requests') });
      } else if (options.fromHistoryEntry) {
        vxDetailPushCurrentContext();
      }
    }

    window._vxCurrentDetailType = 'call';


    window._vxCurrentTaskId = null;


    window._vxCurrentCallId = callId;
    window._vxActiveRecordId = String(callId);
    window._vxLastAnfragenRecordId = String(callId);
    page.classList.add('is-open');
    page.dataset.vxDetailType = 'call';
    page.dataset.vxDetailId = String(callId);
    vxNotifMarkReadByRecord(callId);
    if (typeof vxSetActiveRequestRow === 'function') vxSetActiveRequestRow(callId);
    


    // [v2.56] Wenn Anfragen-Tab aktiv: Detail in rechter Spalte einbetten
    var splitRight = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-right');
    var splitEmpty = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-empty');
    var anrufeTabActive = document.getElementById('tab-anrufe') &&
      document.getElementById('tab-anrufe').classList.contains('active');
    var useDetailV2 = !options.forceFullscreen && anrufeTabActive && splitRight && window.innerWidth >= 1100;
    var useSplitDetail = !options.forceFullscreen && anrufeTabActive && splitRight && window.innerWidth >= 768 && !useDetailV2;
    if (useDetailV2) {
      page.classList.remove('is-open');
      page.style.display = 'none';
      // [v2-stable] Detail-V2: kein Reparenting, permanent host in split-right
      var detailV2El = document.getElementById('requests-detail-v2');
      if (splitEmpty) splitEmpty.style.display = 'none';
      if (detailV2El) detailV2El.style.display = 'block';
      var rec = (typeof vxResolveDprRecord === 'function') ? vxResolveDprRecord(callId) : null;
      if (!rec && Array.isArray(window.allRecords)) {
        rec = window.allRecords.find(function(r) { return String((r && r.id) || '') === String(callId); }) || null;
      }
      if (rec) {
        vxRenderRequestsDetailV2(rec, { hostEl: detailV2El });
      } else if (detailV2El) {
        detailV2El.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:2rem;color:#888;">Wird geladen...</div>';
      }
    } else if (useSplitDetail) {
      // Detail in anrufe-split-right einbetten
      if (!splitRight.contains(page)) {
        splitRight.appendChild(page);
      }
      // [v2.66 FIX] Fullscreen-Klasse entfernen beim Einbetten ins Split-Panel
      page.classList.remove('is-fullscreen');
      document.body.classList.remove('vx-requests-focus-mode');
      page.classList.remove('vx-detail-focus');
      if (splitEmpty) splitEmpty.style.display = 'none';
      page.style.position = 'absolute';
      page.style.top = '0';
      page.style.left = '0';
      page.style.right = '0';
      page.style.bottom = '0';
      page.style.zIndex = '10';
      page.style.display = 'block';
      page.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      var _exBtnSplit = document.getElementById('vx-cd-qa-expand');
      if (_exBtnSplit) { _exBtnSplit.setAttribute('aria-label','Fokusmodus öffnen'); _exBtnSplit.title='Fokusmodus öffnen'; var _exIconSplit=_exBtnSplit.querySelector('i'); if (_exIconSplit) _exIconSplit.className='ph-bold ph-corners-out'; }

      var _sw = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
      if (_sw) {
        _sw.style.overflowY = 'auto';
        _sw.style.overflowX = 'hidden';
        _sw.style.height = '100%';
        _sw.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
        _sw.style.width = '100%';
      }
    } else {
      // Standard: App-Shell Detailmodus (Header/Nav bleiben sichtbar)
      page.classList.add('is-fullscreen'); // [v2.66]
      page.style.position = 'fixed';
      if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
        page.style.top = '60px';
        page.style.left = '0';
        page.style.right = '0';
        page.style.bottom = 'calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))';
        page.style.zIndex = '44';
      } else {
        page.style.top = '0';
        page.style.left = '232px';
        page.style.right = '0';
        page.style.bottom = '0';
        page.style.zIndex = '39';
      }
      page.style.display = 'block';
      page.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      page.style.overflowY = 'hidden';
      var _swFull = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
      if (_swFull) {
        _swFull.style.minHeight = '';
        _swFull.style.overflowY = 'auto';
        _swFull.style.height = '100%';
        _swFull.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
        _swFull.style.width = '100%';
      }
      vxSetScrollLock('call-detail-page', true);
    }
    page.scrollTop = 0;
    var wrap = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
    if (wrap) wrap.scrollTop = 0;
    var bottomBar = document.getElementById('vx-cd-bottom-bar');
    if (bottomBar) bottomBar.style.display = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 'grid' : 'none';

    // Render
    loadAndRenderCallDetail(callId);
    // [v2.56] Action-Bar im Split nach Render aktualisieren
    if (useSplitDetail) {
      setTimeout(function() { vxSplitUpdateActionBar(callId); }, 200);
    }

    // Hash setzen
    try { window.location.hash = '#call/' + callId; } catch(e) {}

    // ESC-Taste registrieren (einmal)
    if (!window._vxCallDetailEscBound) {
      window._vxCallDetailEscBound = true;
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.keyCode === 27) {
          var pg = document.getElementById('call-detail-page');
          if (pg && pg.style.display === 'block') hideCallDetail();
        }
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[cd] error:', err);
  }
}
