function hideCallDetail() {
  var page = document.getElementById('call-detail-page');
  if (typeof vxResetCallDetailViewState === 'function') vxResetCallDetailViewState();
  if (page) {
    var wasFullscreen = page.classList.contains('is-fullscreen');
    page.classList.remove('is-fullscreen');
    page.classList.remove('vx-detail-focus');
    document.body.classList.remove('vx-requests-focus-mode');
    // [v2.67] Wenn von Fullscreen zurück UND Anfragen-Tab aktiv → Split wiederherstellen
    var anrufeTabActive = document.getElementById('tab-anrufe') &&
      document.getElementById('tab-anrufe').classList.contains('active');
    var splitRight = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-right');
    var currentId = window._vxCurrentCallId || window._vxCurrentTaskId;
    if (wasFullscreen && anrufeTabActive && splitRight && currentId && window.innerWidth >= 768) {
      // Split-View wieder öffnen statt schliessen
      page.classList.add('is-open');
      page.classList.remove('is-fullscreen');
      if (!splitRight.contains(page)) splitRight.appendChild(page);
      var splitEmpty = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-empty');
      if (splitEmpty) splitEmpty.style.display = 'none';
      page.style.position = 'absolute';
      page.style.top = '0'; page.style.left = '0'; page.style.right = '0'; page.style.bottom = '0';
      page.style.zIndex = '10'; page.style.display = 'block';
      page.style.overflow = 'hidden'; page.style.overflowY = '';
      var _swBack = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
      if (_swBack) {
        _swBack.style.overflowY = 'auto'; _swBack.style.overflowX = 'hidden';
        _swBack.style.height = '100%'; _swBack.style.boxSizing = 'border-box'; _swBack.style.width = '100%';
      }
      // Expand-Button wieder zeigen, Zurück verstecken
      var backBtn = page.querySelector('.vx-back-btn[aria-label="Zurück"]');
      if (backBtn) backBtn.style.display = 'none';
      var expandBtn = document.getElementById('vx-cd-qa-expand');
      if (expandBtn) expandBtn.style.removeProperty('display');
      setTimeout(function() { if (typeof vxSetupMorphingBanner === 'function') vxSetupMorphingBanner(); }, 50);
      vxSetScrollLock('call-detail-page', false);
      return; // nicht schliessen
    }
    page.classList.remove('is-open');
    page.removeAttribute('data-vx-detail-type');
    page.removeAttribute('data-vx-detail-id');
    page.style.display = 'none';
    var bottomBar = document.getElementById('vx-cd-bottom-bar');
    if (bottomBar) bottomBar.style.display = 'none';
    // Wenn noch in split-right (sollte nicht vorkommen): zurück ins body
    if (splitRight && splitRight.contains(page)) {
      document.body.appendChild(page);
      page.style.position = 'fixed';
      page.style.top = '0'; page.style.left = '232px'; page.style.right = '0'; page.style.bottom = '0';
      page.style.zIndex = '9999'; page.style.overflow = ''; page.style.overflowY = '';
    }
    // sp-active auf allen Rows entfernen
    if (typeof vxClearActiveRequestRow === 'function') vxClearActiveRequestRow();
    // [B3-FIX] scroll-wrap inline-styles zurücksetzen
    var _sw = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
    if (_sw) {
      _sw.style.overflowY = '';
      _sw.style.overflowX = '';
      _sw.style.height = '';
      _sw.style.boxSizing = '';
      _sw.style.width = '';
    }
    // Split empty state wieder zeigen
    var splitEmpty = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-empty');
    if (splitEmpty) splitEmpty.style.display = '';
    // [B1-FIX] Action-Bar entfernen
    var bar = document.getElementById('split-action-bar');
    if (bar) bar.remove();
  }
  vxSetScrollLock('call-detail-page', false);
  vxSyncScrollLock();
  window._vxCurrentCallId = null;
  window._vxCurrentTaskId = null;
  window._vxCurrentDetailType = null;
  window.vxDetailNavStack = [];
  // Clear hash but keep current tab
  if (window.location.hash.indexOf('#call/') === 0 || window.location.hash.indexOf('#task/') === 0) {
    try { history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.search); } catch(e) {}
  }
}

async function buildCallHistory(phoneNumber) {
  var sb = (typeof getSupabaseAuthClient === 'function') ? getSupabaseAuthClient() : null;
  if (!sb) { return []; }
  if (!phoneNumber || phoneNumber === 'undefined') { 
    console.warn('buildCallHistory: phoneNumber is empty');
    return []; 
  }
  try {
    // calls table only has 'caller_phone' field (no phone_number column)
    const { data: callsData, error: callsError } = await sb.from('calls').select('*').eq('caller_phone', phoneNumber).order('created_at', { ascending: true });
    if (callsError) throw callsError;
    const calls = callsData || [];
    
    // Tasks query - customer_tasks DB has 'phone' field (not phone_number/caller_phone)
    let tasks = [];
    try {
      const { data: tasksData, error: tasksError } = await sb.from('customer_tasks').select('*').eq('phone', phoneNumber).order('due_at', { ascending: true });
      if (tasksError) {
        console.warn('Tasks query failed (non-critical):', tasksError);
      } else {
        tasks = tasksData || [];
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Tasks query failed (non-critical):', e);
    }
    
    const history = [];
    calls.forEach(function(call) {
      history.push({
        type: 'call_inbound',
        timestamp: call.created_at,
        duration: call.duration_seconds || 0,
        summary: vxGetCallSummary(call),
        category: call.category || '',
        lead_quality: call.lead_quality || '',
        call_id: call.id,
        transcription: vxGetCallTranscript(call),
        notes: call.notes_customer_voxera || ''
      });
    });
    tasks.forEach(function(task) {
      // customer_tasks DB schema: type, title, note, phone, due_at, status, created_at
      const taskType = task.type || 'task';
      history.push({
        type: 'followup_created',
        timestamp: task.created_at,
        action: taskType,
        title: task.title || '',
        due_at: task.due_at,
        notes: task.note || task.notes || '',
        status: task.status || 'open',
        task_id: task.id
      });
    });
    history.sort(function(a, b) {
      var ta = (typeof parseCallTimestamp === 'function' ? parseCallTimestamp(b.timestamp) : new Date(b.timestamp)) || new Date(0);
      var tb = (typeof parseCallTimestamp === 'function' ? parseCallTimestamp(a.timestamp) : new Date(a.timestamp)) || new Date(0);
      return ta.getTime() - tb.getTime();
    });
    return history;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error building call history:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

async function loadAndRenderCallDetail(callId) {
  callId = String(callId || '').trim();
  if (!callId) {
    console.warn('[detail] blocked load without id', { source: 'loadAndRenderCallDetail' });
    if (typeof vxForceCloseCallDetail === 'function') vxForceCloseCallDetail('loadAndRenderCallDetail:missing-id');
    return;
  }
  var sb = (typeof getSupabaseAuthClient === 'function') ? getSupabaseAuthClient() : null;
  if (!sb) { 
    var el0 = document.getElementById('call-detail-content');
    if (el0) el0.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#dc2626;padding:16px;">⚠️ Authentifizierung erforderlich</p>';
    return;
  }
  
  // Show loading state
  var loadingEl = document.getElementById('call-detail-content');
  if (loadingEl) loadingEl.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--slate);">Lade…</div>';
  
  // Lokalen Record finden (schnell)
  var recordsSource = (typeof allRecords !== 'undefined' && allRecords) ? allRecords : (window.allRecords || []);
  var localRec = recordsSource.find(function(r) { return r.id === callId; });
  
  if (localRec && localRec.fields) {
    var f = localRec.fields;
    var localCall = {
      id: callId,
      caller_name: f.caller_name || '',
      caller_phone: f.caller_phone || f.phone_number || '',
      phone_number: f.phone_number || f.caller_phone || '',
      created_at: f.created_at || f.received_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      duration_seconds: f.duration_seconds || 0,
      dashboard_status: f.dashboard_status || '',
      status: f.status || '',
      follow_up_at: f.follow_up_at || '',
      call_summary: vxGetCallSummary(f),
      category: f.category || '',
      lead_quality: f.lead_quality || '',
      callback_requested: !!f.callback_requested,
      next_action: f.next_action || '',
      urgency: f.urgency || '',
      priority: f.priority || '',
      transcription: vxGetCallTranscript(f),
      notes_customer_voxera: f.notes_customer_voxera || '',
      customer_id: f.customer_id || ''
    };
    
    var phoneForHistory = localCall.caller_phone || '';

    // [v3.5 FIX] Detailseite sofort aus lokalem Record rendern.
    // Vorher wurde zuerst die Kontakt-Historie geladen. Wenn diese Abfrage langsam
    // war oder hing, blieb die Detailseite bei "Lade…" stehen. Die Detailakte
    // ist jetzt sofort sichtbar; die Historie wird danach best-effort nachgeladen.
    if (String(window._vxCurrentCallId || '') !== String(callId) || window._vxCurrentDetailType !== 'call') return;
    renderCallDetailPage(localCall, []);

    if (phoneForHistory) {
      try {
        var history = await buildCallHistory(phoneForHistory);
        if (String(window._vxCurrentCallId || '') !== String(callId) || window._vxCurrentDetailType !== 'call') return;
        renderCallDetailPage(localCall, history || []);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[call-detail] history error:', err);
        // Detail bleibt sichtbar; nur Historie fällt weg.
      }
    }
    return;
  }
  
  // Fallback: from Supabase
  try {
    const { data: call, error } = await sb.from('calls').select('*').eq('id', callId).single();
    if (error || !call) {
      var el = document.getElementById('call-detail-content');
      if (el) el.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#dc2626;padding:16px;">Anruf nicht gefunden.</p>';
      return;
    }
    const phoneNumber = call.caller_phone || call.phone_number || '';
    const history = phoneNumber ? await buildCallHistory(phoneNumber) : [];
    if (String(window._vxCurrentCallId || '') !== String(callId) || window._vxCurrentDetailType !== 'call') return;
    renderCallDetailPage(call, history);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[call-detail] load error:', error);
    var el = document.getElementById('call-detail-content');
    if (el) el.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#dc2626;padding:16px;">Fehler beim Laden.</p>';
  }
}


function vxMountCallDetailMetaIntoHeader() {
  try {
    var banner = document.getElementById('call-detail-banner');
    var content = document.getElementById('call-detail-content');
    if (!banner || !content) return;

    // Header-Meta muss immer den aktuell gerenderten Record zeigen.
    // Beim Re-Render wurde das bisherige Meta-Element in den Header verschoben
    // und blieb dort stehen; dadurch konnten alte Badges oben und neue Badges
    // darunter gleichzeitig sichtbar sein.
    Array.prototype.slice.call(banner.querySelectorAll('#vx-cd-meta-pills')).forEach(function(oldPills) {
      oldPills.remove();
    });

    var pills = content.querySelector('#vx-cd-meta-pills');
    if (!pills) return;
    pills.classList.add('vx-cd-meta-pills-in-header');
    pills.style.marginBottom = '0';
    pills.style.padding = '0';
    banner.appendChild(pills);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[voxera] detail header meta relocation skipped', err);
  }
}

function renderStep() {
    const subEl = document.getElementById('confirm-sub');
    if (!subEl) return;
    if (step === 1) {
      subEl.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:14px;">Warum möchten Sie kündigen?</div>'
        + '<div id="vx-cancel-reasons" style="display:grid;gap:8px;"></div>'
        + '<div id="vx-cancel-other-wrap" style="display:none;margin-top:10px;"><textarea id="vx-cancel-other" placeholder="Bitte Grund eingeben" style="width:100%;min-height:88px;border:0.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;resize:vertical;"></textarea></div>';
      const reasonsEl = subEl.querySelector('#vx-cancel-reasons');
      reasonsEl.innerHTML = reasons.map(function(reason) {
        const active = selectedReason === reason;
        return '<button data-reason="' + reason.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + '" style="text-align:left;background:' + (active ? '#EFF6FF' : '#fff') + ';border:0.5px solid ' + (active ? '#1A6FE8' : 'var(--line)') + ';color:var(--ink);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;">' + reason + '</button>';
      }).join('');
      reasonsEl.querySelectorAll('button[data-reason]').forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.onclick = function() {
          selectedReason = btn.getAttribute('data-reason') || '';
          renderStep();
        };
      });
      const isOther = selectedReason === 'Sonstiges';
      const otherWrap = subEl.querySelector('#vx-cancel-other-wrap');
      otherWrap.style.display = isOther ? 'block' : 'none';
      const otherInput = subEl.querySelector('#vx-cancel-other');
      otherInput.value = customReason;
      otherInput.oninput = function() { customReason = String(otherInput.value || ''); refreshButtons(); };
    } else {
      const reasonText = selectedReason === 'Sonstiges' ? customReason.trim() : selectedReason;
      subEl.innerHTML = ''
        + '<div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px;">Kündigung bestätigen</div>'
        + '<div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:8px;">Ausgewählter Grund: <strong>' + (reasonText || '–') + '</strong></div>'
        + '<div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:8px;">Vertragsende: <strong>' + vxFmtDate(cancellationDate.toISOString()) + '</strong></div>'
        + '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#B45309;background:#FFFBEB;border:0.5px solid #FDE68A;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;">Nach Ablauf der Kündigungsfrist wird Ihr Zugang deaktiviert.</div>';
    }
    refreshButtons();
  }
  function refreshButtons() {
    const okBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-ok-btn');
    const cancelBtn = document.querySelector('#confirm-overlay .modal-btn-s');
    if (!okBtn || !cancelBtn) return;
    const canContinue = !!selectedReason && (selectedReason !== 'Sonstiges' || !!customReason.trim());
    if (step === 1) {
      cancelBtn.style.display = 'none';
      okBtn.textContent = 'Weiter →';
      okBtn.style.background = '#0D1F3C';
      okBtn.disabled = !canContinue;
      okBtn.style.opacity = canContinue ? '1' : '.45';
      okBtn.style.cursor = canContinue ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed';
    } else {
      cancelBtn.style.display = '';
      cancelBtn.textContent = 'Abbrechen';
      okBtn.textContent = 'Ja, Kündigung einreichen';
      okBtn.style.background = '#DC2626';
      okBtn.disabled = false;
      okBtn.style.opacity = '1';
      okBtn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    }
  }

        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          mail_type: 'cancellation_request',
          customer_id: customerMeta.customerId || null,
          customer_name: customerMeta.customerName || null,
          plan: customerMeta.plan || null,
          cancellation_notice: ct.cancellation_notice || '30 Tage'
        })
      });
      ct.cancellation_date = cancellationDate.toISOString();
      ct.termination_reason = reasonText;
      ct.termination_type = 'customer_request';
      if (customerContractMeta) {
        customerContractMeta.cancellation_date = ct.cancellation_date;
        customerContractMeta.termination_reason = ct.termination_reason;
        customerContractMeta.termination_type = ct.termination_type;
      }
      vxRenderContractDetails();
      vxRenderCancellationSection();
      toast('Kündigung eingereicht.');
      return true;
    }
  });
  renderStep();
}

async function vxSubmitReactivationRequest() {
  openConfirmModal({
    title: 'Möchten Sie Ihre Kündigung wirklich zurückziehen?',
    text: '',
    confirmLabel: 'Ja, zurückziehen',
    onConfirm: async function() {
      const res = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/customer-cancel-contract', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'reactivate' })
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Kündigung konnte nicht zurückgezogen werden.');
      const ct = customerContractMeta || (customerContractState && (customerContractState.effectiveContract || customerContractState.latestContract)) || {};
      ct.cancellation_date = null;
      ct.termination_reason = null;
      ct.termination_type = null;
      if (customerContractMeta) {
        customerContractMeta.cancellation_date = null;
        customerContractMeta.termination_reason = null;
        customerContractMeta.termination_type = null;
      }
      vxRenderContractDetails();
      vxRenderCancellationSection();
      toast('Kündigung zurückgezogen. Ihr Abonnement läuft weiter.');
      return true;
    }
  });
}

function vxAboUpgrade() {
  const plan = String(customerMeta.plan || '').toLowerCase();
  // Aktuellen Plan als disabled markieren, Upgrade-Optionen anzeigen
  _vxSelectedPlan = null;
  _vxSelectedBilling = 'monthly';

  // Plan-Karten anpassen je nach aktuellem Plan
  const planOrder = ['starter', 'business', 'professional'];
  const currentIdx = planOrder.indexOf(plan);

  planOrder.forEach(function(p, i) {
    const el = document.getElementById('vx-plan-' + p);
    if (!el) return;
    if (i <= currentIdx) {
      el.style.opacity = '.45';
      el.style.cursor = 'default';
      el.onclick = null;
      const note = el.querySelector('[data-plan-note]');
      if (!note) {
        const n = document.createElement('div');
        n.setAttribute('data-plan-note', '1');
        n.style.cssText = 'margin-top:10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--slate2);';
        n.textContent = i === currentIdx ? 'Ihr aktueller Plan' : 'Nicht verfügbar';
        el.appendChild(n);
      }
    } else {
      el.style.opacity = '1';
      el.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      el.onclick = function() { vxSelectUpgradePlan(p); };
    }
  });

  vxSetBilling('monthly');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('vx-upgrade-overlay');
  if (overlay) { overlay.style.display = 'flex'; /* phosphor: no init needed */ }
}

function vxCloseUpgradeModal() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('vx-upgrade-overlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
  _vxSelectedPlan = null;
}

function vxSetBilling(cycle) {
  _vxSelectedBilling = cycle;
  const mBtn = document.getElementById('vx-billing-monthly');
  const yBtn = document.getElementById('vx-billing-yearly');
  if (mBtn) { mBtn.style.background = cycle === 'monthly' ? '#1A6FE8' : 'transparent'; mBtn.style.color = cycle === 'monthly' ? '#fff' : 'var(--slate2)'; }
  if (yBtn) { yBtn.style.background = cycle === 'yearly' ? '#1A6FE8' : 'transparent'; yBtn.style.color = cycle === 'yearly' ? '#fff' : 'var(--slate2)'; }

  // Preise aktualisieren
  var prices = {
    starter:      { monthly: 149, yearly: 134 },
    business:     { monthly: 249, yearly: 224 },
    professional: { monthly: 399, yearly: 359 }
  };
  Object.keys(prices).forEach(function(p) {
    var el = document.getElementById('vx-' + p + '-price');
    if (el) el.textContent = 'CHF ' + prices[p][cycle];
  });
}

function vxSelectUpgradePlan(plan) {
  _vxSelectedPlan = plan;
  ['starter','business','professional'].forEach(function(p) {
    var el = document.getElementById('vx-plan-' + p);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('selected');
    if (p !== plan) {
      el.style.borderColor = p === 'professional' ? '#E8C547' : 'var(--line)';
      el.style.background = p === 'professional' ? 'rgba(232,197,71,.04)' : '';
    }
  });
  var sel = document.getElementById('vx-plan-' + plan);
  if (sel) { sel.style.borderColor = '#1A6FE8'; sel.style.background = 'var(--blue-subtle)'; sel.classList.add('selected'); }

  var cta = document.getElementById('vx-upgrade-cta');
  if (cta) {
    cta.disabled = false;
    var prices = { starter: {monthly:149,yearly:134}, business: {monthly:249,yearly:224}, professional: {monthly:399,yearly:359} };
    var price = prices[plan] ? prices[plan][_vxSelectedBilling] : '';
    var names = { starter:'Starter', business:'Business', professional:'Professional' };
    cta.textContent = 'Zu ' + (names[plan]||plan) + ' upgraden — CHF ' + price + '/Mt →';
  }
}

function vxConfirmUpgrade() {
  if (!_vxSelectedPlan) return;
  var links = VX_PLAN_LINKS[_vxSelectedPlan];
  var link = links ? links[_vxSelectedBilling] : null;
  if (link) {
    window.open(link, '_blank');
    vxCloseUpgradeModal();
  } else {
    alert('Link nicht verfügbar. Bitte kontaktieren Sie info@voxera.ch.');
  }
}

function vxSelectMinutesPkg(pkg) {

  ['50','100','200'].forEach(function(p) {
    var el = document.getElementById('vx-min-' + p);
    if (!el) return;
    if (p === pkg) {
      el.style.borderColor = '#1A6FE8';
      el.style.background = 'var(--blue-subtle)';
    } else {
      el.style.borderColor = p === '100' ? '#E8C547' : 'var(--line)';

  var cta = document.getElementById('vx-minutes-cta');

function vxConfirmMinutes() {
  if (!_vxSelectedMinutes) return;
  var link = VX_MINUTES_LINKS[_vxSelectedMinutes];
  if (link) {
    window.open(link, '_blank');
    vxCloseMinutesModal();
  } else {
    // Noch kein Stripe-Link — Anfrage per E-Mail
    var prices = { '50':'CHF 15', '100':'CHF 25', '200':'CHF 45' };
    var note = document.getElementById('vx-minutes-stripe-note');
    if (note) note.style.display = 'block';
    var cta = document.getElementById('vx-minutes-cta');
    // Fallback: E-Mail-Anfrage senden
    vxRequestAddon('extra_minutes_' + _vxSelectedMinutes);
  }
}

async function vxRequestAddon(addonCode) {
  const addonNames = {
    sms_notify_kunde: 'SMS Benachrichtigungen (CHF 9/Mt)',
    sms_confirm_caller: 'SMS Bestätigung an Anrufer (CHF 19/Mt)',
    extra_minutes_50: 'Zusatzminuten kaufen — 50 Min. für CHF 15.00 einmalig',
    plan_upgrade: 'Plan-Upgrade anfragen — aktueller Plan: ' + (customerMeta.plan || 'unbekannt')
  };
  const name = addonNames[addonCode] || addonCode;
  try {
    const _sb = getSupabaseAuthClient();
    const { data: { session } } = await _sb.auth.getSession();
    await fetch('/.netlify/functions/customer-change-request', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${session?.access_token || ''}` },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        mail_type: 'addon_request',
        addon_code: addonCode,
        message: `Add-on Anfrage: ${name}`
      })
    });
    alert('✓ Anfrage gesendet. Wir aktivieren das Add-on und informieren Sie per E-Mail.');
  } catch(e) {
    alert('Fehler beim Senden der Anfrage.');
  }
}

function vxInitRufumleitung_old() {
  const source = document.getElementById('tab-einrichtung');
  const shell = document.getElementById('rufumleitung-shell');
  if (!source || !shell) return;

  // Klonen
  shell.innerHTML = source.innerHTML;

  // Voxera-Nummer setzen
  const nr = (customerMeta && customerMeta.voxeraNumber) ? String(customerMeta.voxeraNumber) : '–';
  const nrEl = shell.querySelector('#einrichtung-voxera-nr');
  if (nrEl) nrEl.textContent = nr;

  // Forwarding code templates
  shell.querySelectorAll('[data-code-template]').forEach(function(el) {
    const tmpl = el.getAttribute('data-code-template') || '';
    el.textContent = tmpl.replace('{voxera_number}', nr || '…');
  });

  // Provider-Buttons neu verdrahten
  shell.querySelectorAll('.provider-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
    const origOnclick = btn.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
    const match = origOnclick.match(/selectProvider\s*\(\s*'([^']+)'/);
    if (match) {
      const key = match[1];
      btn.setAttribute('onclick', "vxShellSelectProvider('" + key + "',this)");
    }
  });

  /* phosphor: no init needed */

  // Swisscom als Default anzeigen
  vxShellSelectProvider('swisscom', shell.querySelector('.provider-btn'));
}

function vxShellSelectProvider(key, btn) {
  var shell = document.getElementById(window._vxRufumleitungShellId || 'rufumleitung-shell');
  if (!shell) return;

  shell.querySelectorAll('.provider-btn').forEach(function(b) {
    b.classList.remove('provider-btn-active');
  });
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('provider-btn-active');

  selectedProvider = key;
  if (typeof PROVIDERS === 'undefined') return;
  var provider = PROVIDERS[key] || PROVIDERS['swisscom'];
  var nr = (customerMeta && customerMeta.voxeraNumber) ? String(customerMeta.voxeraNumber) : '-';

  function encodeAttr(value) {
    return String(value || '').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
  }
  function makeTelHref(value) {
    return 'tel:' + String(value || '').replace(/\*/g, '%2A').replace(/#/g, '%23').replace(/\s+/g, '');
  }
  function codeButtonRow(filled) {
    var safe = encodeAttr(filled);
    return '<div class="vx-forwarding-code-actions">'
      + '<button type="button" class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" onclick="vxCopyCode(this)" data-code="' + safe + '">Kopieren</button>'
      + '<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="' + makeTelHref(filled) + '">Anwählen</a>'
    + '</div>';
  }
  function makeRecommendedCode(code, label) {
    var filled = String(code || '').replace('{NR}', nr);
    return '<div class="vx-forwarding-code-primary">'
      + '<div class="vx-forwarding-code-head"><div class="vx-forwarding-code-label">' + label.replace(/\s*\(empfohlen\)/i,'') + '</div><span class="vx-forwarding-code-chip">Empfohlen</span></div>'
      + '<div class="vx-forwarding-code-value">' + filled + '</div>'
      + codeButtonRow(filled)
    + '</div>';
  }
  function makeSecondaryCode(code, label) {
    var filled = String(code || '').replace('{NR}', nr);
    return '<div class="vx-forwarding-code-secondary">'
      + '<div><div class="vx-forwarding-code-secondary-label">' + label.replace(/\s*\(empfohlen\)/i,'') + '</div><div class="vx-forwarding-code-secondary-value">' + filled + '</div></div>'
      + '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;"><button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" onclick="vxCopyCode(this)" data-code="' + encodeAttr(filled) + '">Kopieren</button><a class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" href="' + makeTelHref(filled) + '">Anwählen</a></div>'
    + '</div>';
  }

  var instrHtml = '';
  if (provider.steps && provider.steps.length) {
    instrHtml += '<div class="vx-forwarding-steps">';
    provider.steps.forEach(function(s, i) {
      instrHtml += '<div class="vx-forwarding-step">'
        + '<div class="vx-forwarding-step-num">' + (i+1) + '</div>'
        + '<div><div class="vx-forwarding-step-text">' + s.text + '</div>'
        + (s.sub ? '<div class="vx-forwarding-step-sub">' + s.sub + '</div>' : '')
        + '</div></div>';
    });
    instrHtml += '</div>';
  }

  if (provider.codes) {
    var recommended = provider.codes.miss || null;
    if (recommended) instrHtml += makeRecommendedCode(recommended.code, recommended.label || 'Bei Nichtannahme');

    var secondaryKeys = Object.keys(provider.codes).filter(function(k){ return k !== 'off' && k !== 'miss'; });
    if (secondaryKeys.length) {
      instrHtml += '<div class="vx-forwarding-secondary"><details class="vx-forwarding-details"><summary><span>Weitere Optionen</span><i class="ph-bold ph-caret-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary><div class="vx-forwarding-details-body">';
      secondaryKeys.forEach(function(k) {
        var item = provider.codes[k];
        instrHtml += makeSecondaryCode(item.code, item.label);
      });
      instrHtml += '</div></details></div>';
    }
  }

  var instrTitle = shell.querySelector('#shell-instr-title');
  var instrBody = shell.querySelector('#shell-instr-body');
  if (instrTitle) instrTitle.textContent = provider.name || 'Anleitung';
  if (instrBody) instrBody.innerHTML = instrHtml;

  var deactCard = shell.querySelector('#shell-deactivation-card');
  var deactCodes = shell.querySelector('#shell-deactivation-codes');
  if (provider.codes && provider.codes.off && deactCard && deactCodes) {
    deactCodes.innerHTML = makeSecondaryCode(provider.codes.off.code, provider.codes.off.label || 'Weiterleitung aus');
    deactCard.style.display = 'block';
  } else if (deactCard) {
    deactCard.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function vxCopyCode(btn) {
  var code = btn ? btn.getAttribute('data-code') : '';
  if (!code) return;
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(function() {
      if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('✓ Code kopiert.');
    });
  }
}


// ── Onboarding Modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function vxOnboardingInit() {
  // Nicht zeigen wenn bereits abgeschlossen
  if (customerMeta.onboardingCompleted) return;

  // Schritt-Status bestimmen
  vxOnboardingUpdateSteps();

  // Modal zeigen
  const overlay = document.getElementById('vx-onboarding-overlay');
  if (overlay) {
    overlay.style.display = 'flex';
    /* phosphor: no init needed */
  }
}

function vxOnboardingUpdateSteps() {
  const steps = {
    1: customerMeta.forwardingSetupCompleted === true,
    2: true, // Assistent intern verwaltet — immer als erledigt
    3: customerMeta.notificationMode !== 'none' && customerMeta.notificationMode !== undefined
  };

  let doneCount = 0;
  Object.entries(steps).forEach(function([num, done]) {
    const step = document.getElementById('vx-ob-step-' + num);
    const check = document.getElementById('vx-ob-check-' + num);
    const icon = document.getElementById('vx-ob-icon-' + num);
    if (done) {
      doneCount++;
      if (step) { step.style.borderColor = '#059669'; step.style.background = 'rgba(5,150,105,.04)'; }
      if (check) { check.style.background = '#059669'; check.style.borderColor = '#059669'; check.innerHTML = '<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none"><path d="M2 6l3 3 5-5" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>'; }
      if (icon) icon.style.background = 'rgba(5,150,105,.1)';
    } else {
      if (step) { step.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)'; step.style.background = ''; }
      if (check) { check.style.background = ''; check.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)'; check.innerHTML = ''; }
      if (icon) icon.style.background = 'var(--blue-subtle)';
    }
  });

  // Progressbar: 2 sichtbare Schritte (Step 1 + Step 3)
  const visibleDone = (steps[1] ? 1 : 0) + (steps[3] ? 1 : 0);
  const bar = document.getElementById('vx-onboarding-progress');
  if (bar) bar.style.width = Math.round(visibleDone / 2 * 100) + '%';

  // Fertig wenn Steps 1 + 3 erledigt
  const complete = document.getElementById('vx-ob-complete');
  const finishBtn = document.getElementById('vx-ob-finish-btn');
  const allDone = steps[1] && steps[3];
  if (allDone) {
    if (complete) complete.style.display = 'block';
    if (finishBtn) finishBtn.textContent = 'Fertig ✓';
  } else {
    if (complete) complete.style.display = 'none';
    if (finishBtn) finishBtn.textContent = 'Los geht\'s →';
  }
}

function vxOnboardingOpenStep(num) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('vx-onboarding-overlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';

  if (num === 1) {
    const mehrNav = findTabNavElement('mehr');
    if (mehrNav) showTab('mehr', mehrNav);
    setTimeout(function() { if (typeof vxMehrShow === 'function') vxMehrShow('rufumleitung'); }, 100);
  } else if (num === 2) {
    // Assistent intern verwaltet — kein Tab-Wechsel nötig
  } else if (num === 3) {
    const mehrNav = findTabNavElement('mehr');
    if (mehrNav) showTab('mehr', mehrNav);
    setTimeout(function() { if (typeof vxMehrShow === 'function') vxMehrShow('benachrichtigungen'); }, 100);
  }

  // Beim Zurückkommen Modal wieder zeigen (nach 8s — genug Zeit für Rufumleitung)
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (!customerMeta.onboardingCompleted) {
      vxOnboardingUpdateSteps();
      const overlay = document.getElementById('vx-onboarding-overlay');
      if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'flex';
    }
  }, 8000);
}

function vxOnboardingSkip() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('vx-onboarding-overlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
  // Beim nächsten Login nicht mehr zeigen
  vxOnboardingMarkComplete();
}

async function vxOnboardingFinish() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('vx-onboarding-overlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
  await vxOnboardingMarkComplete();
}

async function vxOnboardingMarkComplete() {
  try {
    const _sb = getSupabaseAuthClient();
    await _sb.from('customers')
      .update({ onboarding_completed: true })
      .eq('id', customerMeta.customerId);
    customerMeta.onboardingCompleted = true;
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn('[onboarding] mark complete failed', e.message);
  }
}

// Manuell starten (z.B. von Hilfe-Seite)
function vxOnboardingRestart() {
  customerMeta.onboardingCompleted = false;
  vxOnboardingUpdateSteps();
  const overlay = document.getElementById('vx-onboarding-overlay');
  if (overlay) {
    overlay.style.display = 'flex';
    /* phosphor: no init needed */
  }
}

function vxUpdateMehrPlanLabel() {
  const el = document.getElementById('mehr-plan-label');
  if (!el) return;
  const plan = customerMeta.plan || '';
  const prices = { starter: 'CHF 149/Mt', business: 'CHF 249/Mt', professional: 'CHF 399/Mt' };
  const labels = { starter: 'Starter', business: 'Business', professional: 'Professional' };
  const code = String(plan).toLowerCase();
  const label = labels[code] || plan || '';
  const price = prices[code] || '';
  el.textContent = label ? (label + (price ? ' · ' + price : '')) : 'Ihr aktueller Plan';
}

async function saveAssistantName() {
  const input = document.getElementById('assistent-name-input');
  const btn = document.getElementById('assistent-name-save-btn');
  const fb = document.getElementById('assistent-name-feedback');
  if (!input || !btn || !fb) return;
  const newName = input.value.trim();
  if (!newName) { fb.style.color = 'var(--red,#DC2626)'; fb.textContent = 'Bitte einen Namen eingeben.'; return; }
  if (newName.length > 30) { fb.style.color = 'var(--red,#DC2626)'; fb.textContent = 'Name darf max. 30 Zeichen haben.'; return; }

  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Speichern…'; fb.textContent = '';
  try {
    const _nSb = getSupabaseAuthClient();
    const { data: { session: _nSession } } = await _nSb.auth.getSession();
    const res = await fetch('/.netlify/functions/customer-update-assistant', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${_nSession?.access_token || ''}`
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ assistant_name: newName })
    });
    const json = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json?.error || 'save_failed');
    customerMeta.assistantName = newName;
    document.getElementById('assistent-name-display').textContent = newName;
    document.getElementById('assistent-avatar').textContent = newName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    const ux = vxBuildAssistantSaveFeedback(json);
    fb.style.color = ux.color;
    fb.textContent = ux.text;
  } catch (e) {
    fb.style.color = 'var(--red,#DC2626)';
    fb.textContent = 'Speichern fehlgeschlagen: ' + (e.message || '');
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Speichern';
  }
}

function selectVoice(vid) {
  const planCode = String(customerMeta.plan || '').toLowerCase();
  if (planCode === 'starter') return; // Starter kann keine Stimme wählen
  window.assistantSelectedVoiceId = vid;
  renderVoiceCards();
  vxStimmePending();
}

function renderVoiceCards() {
  const listEl = document.getElementById('assistant-voice-list');
  if (!listEl) return;
  if (!Array.isArray(window.assistantVoiceOptions) || !window.assistantVoiceOptions.length) {
    listEl.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--slate2);">Keine Stimmen verfügbar.</div>';
    return;
  }
  const planCode = String(customerMeta.plan || '').toLowerCase();
  const canSelect = planCode === 'business' || planCode === 'professional';
  listEl.innerHTML = window.assistantVoiceOptions.map((v) => {
    const vid = String(v.voice_id || '');
    const active = vid === window.assistantSelectedVoiceId;
    const isFemale = v.gender === 'female';
    const isMale = v.gender === 'male';
    const genderLabel = isFemale ? 'Weiblich' : isMale ? 'Männlich' : 'Neutral';
    const badgeStyle = isFemale
      ? 'color:#94A3B8;background:#F5F3FF;'
      : isMale
        ? 'color:#0E7490;background:#ECFEFF;'
        : 'color:#7A8599;background:#F3F4F6;';
    const cardBorder = active ? '1.5px solid #1A6FE8' : '1.5px solid #E5E7EB';
    const cardBg = active ? '#F0F6FF' : '#fff';
    const radioDot = active
      ? `<div style="width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #1A6FE8;background:#1A6FE8;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;"><div style="width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);"></div></div><span style="font-size:12px;color:#1A6FE8;font-weight:600;">Aktiv</span>`
      : `<div style="width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #D1D5DB;background:var(--surface);flex-shrink:0;"></div><span style="font-size:12px;color:#94A3B8;">Wählen</span>`;
    return `<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px;border:${cardBorder};border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:${cardBg};transition:border-color .15s,background .15s;">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;">
        <div>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">
            <span style="font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#1A1A2E;">${escHtml(v.display_name || vid)}</span>
            <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;border-radius:20px;padding:2px 8px;${badgeStyle}">${genderLabel}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:12px;color:#7A8599;line-height:1.4;">${escHtml(v.description || '')}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;">
        ${canSelect ? `<button type="button" onclick="selectVoice('${escHtml(vid)}')" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;">${radioDot}</button>` : `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">${radioDot}</div>`}
        <button type="button" onclick="previewVoice('${escHtml(vid)}',this)" aria-label="Stimme anhören"
          style="width:32px;height:32px;min-width:32px;min-height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #1A6FE8;background:var(--surface);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0;overflow:hidden;">
          <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#1A6FE8" style="display:block;flex-shrink:0;"><path d="M6 4.75a.75.75 0 0 0-1.22.585v13.33a.75.75 0 0 0 1.22.585l10.5-6.665a.75.75 0 0 0 0-1.17L6 4.75z"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function prefillAssistentChange(text) {
  const el = document.getElementById('assistent-change-msg');
  if (!el) return;
  el.value = text;
  el.focus();
  el.setSelectionRange(text.length, text.length);
}

async function submitAssistentChange() {
  const msg = (document.getElementById('assistent-change-msg')?.value || '').trim();
  const btn = document.getElementById('assistent-change-btn');
  const fb  = document.getElementById('assistent-change-feedback');
  if (!msg) {
    fb.style.display = '';
    fb.style.color = 'var(--red,#DC2626)';
    fb.textContent = 'Bitte zuerst eine Beschreibung eingeben.';
    return;
  }
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Wird gesendet…';
  fb.style.display = 'none';
  try {
    const custId = customerMeta.customerId || customerContext?.customerId || '';
    if (!custId) throw new Error('Kunden-ID nicht gefunden.');
    const { error } = await _sb
      .from('ai_change_requests')
      .insert({
        customer_id: custId,
        message: msg,
        status: 'open'
      });
    if (error) throw error;

    // Trigger Make notification webhook
    const NOTIFY_URL = '/.netlify/functions/ai-change-notify';
    try {
      await fetch(NOTIFY_URL, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          customer_id: customerMeta.customerId,
          customer_name: customerMeta.customerName || '',
          message: msg
        })
      });
    } catch(e) { /* notification failure is non-critical */ }

    document.getElementById('assistent-change-msg').value = '';
    fb.style.display = '';
    fb.style.color = 'var(--green-dark,#059669)';
    fb.textContent = '✓ Anfrage gesendet — wir melden uns bei Ihnen.';
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Anfrage senden';
    loadAssistentRequests();
  } catch(e) {
    fb.style.display = '';
    fb.style.color = 'var(--red,#DC2626)';
    fb.textContent = 'Fehler: ' + (e.message || 'Unbekannt');
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Anfrage senden';
  }
}
// ── End Mein Assistent ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getAssistantName() {
  return customerMeta.assistantName || 'Lara';
}

function getTimeBasedGreeting() {
  var hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 5 && hour < 12) return 'Guten Morgen';
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 14) return 'Guten Mittag';
  if (hour >= 14 && hour < 18) return 'Guten Nachmittag';
  return 'Guten Abend';
}

function buildDailyReport(records, manualTasks) {
  var name = getAssistantName();
  var hour = new Date().getHours();
  var isNightTime = hour >= 0 && hour < 6; // 00:00-05:59 — zeige gestrigen Tag
  var todayFilter = function(r) {
    var ts = getRecordTimestamp(r);
    if (!ts) return false;
    if (isActivationCallCategory((r.fields||{}).category)) return false;
    if (isNightTime) {
      // Zeige gestrigen Kalendertag
      var d = new Date(ts);
      var yesterday = new Date(); yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);
      var fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: DISPLAY_TIMEZONE, year:'numeric', month:'2-digit', day:'2-digit' });
      return fmt.format(d) === fmt.format(yesterday);
    }
    return isToday(ts);
  };
  var today = (records || []).filter(todayFilter);
  var totalToday = today.length;
  var dayLabel = isNightTime ? 'Gestern' : 'Heute';
  var callbacks = (records || []).filter(function(r) {
    var f = r.fields || {};
    return !isClosedStatus(f.dashboard_status) && (f.callback_requested === true || f.callback_requested === 'true');
  });
  var hotLeads = today.filter(function(r) {
    return String((r.fields||{}).lead_quality||'').toLowerCase() === 'hot';
  });
  // [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2.7]
  // Aufgaben offen = offene customer_tasks; Call-Signale nicht doppelt zählen.
  var totalOpen = (typeof getOpenTaskCount === 'function') ? getOpenTaskCount() : 0;

  if (typeof vxBuildDailyReportText === 'function') return vxBuildDailyReportText(records || [], manualTasks || []);

  if (totalToday === 0 && totalOpen === 0) {
    if (isNightTime) return 'Gute Nacht. ' + name + ' ist bereit für morgen.';
    return name + ' ist bereit und wartet auf den ersten Anruf. Alle Systeme laufen.';
  }
  var parts = [];
  if (totalToday === 1) parts.push(dayLabel + ' hat ' + name + ' 1 Anruf entgegengenommen.');
  else if (totalToday > 1) parts.push(dayLabel + ' hat ' + name + ' ' + totalToday + ' Anrufe entgegengenommen.');
  if (hotLeads.length > 0) {
    var topLead = hotLeads[0];
    var leadName = (topLead.fields||{}).caller_name || (topLead.fields||{}).company_name || '';
    if (leadName) parts.push(leadName + ' ist ein Hot Lead — nicht vergessen.');
    else parts.push(hotLeads.length + ' Hot Lead' + (hotLeads.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' heute.');
  }
  if (callbacks.length > 0) parts.push(callbacks.length + ' offene' + (callbacks.length === 1 ? 'r' : '') + ' Rückruf' + (callbacks.length === 1 ? '' : 'e') + '.');
  else if (totalOpen > 0) parts.push(totalOpen + ' offene Aufgabe' + (totalOpen === 1 ? '' : 'n') + '.');
  if (parts.length === 0) parts.push(name + ' hat alles im Griff.');
  return parts.join(' ');
}

// ── KI Tagesbericht ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2.2 — Tagesbericht stabil 1x täglich]
// Vorher: sessionStorage Cache (verlor bei Tab-Schließen, lief in jeder Session neu)
//         Plus _aiReportGenerated als Session-Flag → bei Reload neu generiert
// Jetzt: localStorage mit Datum als Key → 1x pro Kalendertag generiert, bleibt stabil
//        Zeitstempel zeigt: "Stand: HH:MM"
//        Refresh-Button rechts oben für manuelle Neugenerierung
var _aiReportGenerated = false;
var _aiReportForceRefresh = false; // Wird auf true gesetzt wenn manuell neu generiert wird

async function generateAiDailyReport(records, manualTasks, lastSignInAt) {
  // Wenn bereits in dieser Session generiert UND nicht explizit Force-Refresh: skippen
  if (_aiReportGenerated && !_aiReportForceRefresh) return;
  _aiReportForceRefresh = false; // Reset für nächsten Aufruf

  // [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2.2 — Stabil 1x täglich via localStorage]
  // Cache-Key enthält das Tagesdatum (en-CA = YYYY-MM-DD), pro Voxera-Kunde isoliert
  var customerId = (typeof customerContext !== 'undefined' && customerContext && customerContext.customerId) ? customerContext.customerId : 'default';
  var today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Europe/Zurich' });
  var currentOpenTaskCount = (typeof getOpenTaskCount === 'function') ? getOpenTaskCount() : 0;
  var cacheKey = 'voxera_ai_report_v23_' + customerId + '_' + today + '_tasks' + currentOpenTaskCount;

  var deterministicReport = (typeof vxBuildDailyReportText === 'function') ? vxBuildDailyReportText(records || [], manualTasks || allManualTaskRecords || []) : buildDailyReport(records || [], manualTasks || []);
  var deterministicTime = new Date().toISOString();
  _showAiReport(deterministicReport || 'Tagesfokus konnte nicht erstellt werden.', false, deterministicTime);
  _aiReportGenerated = true;
  return;

  // Legacy KI-Pfad bleibt im Code, wird aber aktuell bewusst nicht verwendet.
  // Grund: Tagesfokus und KPIs dürfen keine abweichenden Zählungen erzeugen.
  _showAiReport('Wird geladen…', true);

  try {
    var cachedStr = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
    if (cachedStr) {
      var cached = JSON.parse(cachedStr);
      if (cached && cached.text && cached.generatedAt) {
        _showAiReport(cached.text, false, cached.generatedAt);
        _aiReportGenerated = true;
        return;
      }
    }
  } catch(e) { /* Cache kaputt → einfach neu generieren */ }

  var allRecords = records || [];

  // Nur offene Rückrufe
  var openCallbacks = allRecords.filter(function(r) {
    var f = r.fields || {};
    return !isClosedStatus(f.dashboard_status) &&
           (f.callback_requested === true || f.callback_requested === 'true');
  });

  // Nur offene Aufgaben — [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2 — Konsistenz]
  // Vorher: separates Zählen von openTasks + manualOpen → driftete von Hero und KPI-Strip
  // Jetzt: zentrale getOpenTaskCount() — dieselbe Quelle wie überall sonst
  var totalOpen = currentOpenTaskCount;

  // Dringend
  var dringend = allRecords.filter(function(r) {
    var f = r.fields || {};
    return !isClosedStatus(f.dashboard_status) &&
           (String(f.priority||'').toLowerCase() === 'high' ||
            String(f.lead_quality||'').toLowerCase() === 'hot');
  });

  var lastLogin = lastSignInAt ? new Date(lastSignInAt) : null;
  var lastLoginStr = lastLogin
    ? lastLogin.toLocaleDateString('de-CH', { weekday:'long', day:'numeric', month:'long', hour:'2-digit', timeZone:'Europe/Zurich', minute:'2-digit' })
    : 'zuletzt';

  var callbacksSummary = openCallbacks.slice(0, 5).map(function(r) {
    var f = r.fields || {};
    var name = f.caller_name || f.company_name || 'Unbekannt';
    var summary = f.summary || f.call_summary || '';
    return '- ' + name + (summary ? ': ' + String(summary).slice(0, 100) : '');
  }).join('\n');

  if (openCallbacks.length === 0 && totalOpen === 0) {
    var emptyText = 'Alles erledigt — keine offenen Aufgaben oder Rückrufe.';
    var nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    try { vxSafeJsonLocalStorageSet(cacheKey, { text: emptyText, generatedAt: nowIso }, { maxBytes: 80000 }); } catch(e) {}
    _showAiReport(emptyText, false, nowIso);
    _aiReportGenerated = true;
    return;
  }

  var prompt = 'Du bist der persönliche Assistent eines KMU-Inhabers. Schreibe 2-3 Sätze, direkt und freundlich auf Deutsch (du-Form). Keine Floskeln, keine Begrüssung. Kein Markdown, keine Sternchen, keine Hashtags. Nur Fliesstext. Fokus: Was muss der Nutzer jetzt tun?\n\nOffene Rückrufe: ' + openCallbacks.length + '\n' + (callbacksSummary || '') + '\nOffene Aufgaben total: ' + totalOpen + '\nDringend: ' + dringend.length + '\nLetzter Login: ' + lastLoginStr;

  try {
    var resp = await callDashboardFunction('ai-daily-report', { prompt: prompt });
    var text = (resp && resp.text) ? resp.text : null;
    if (text) {
      var generatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      try { vxSafeJsonLocalStorageSet(cacheKey, { text: text, generatedAt: generatedAt }, { maxBytes: 80000 }); } catch(e) {}
      _showAiReport(text, false, generatedAt);
      _aiReportGenerated = true;
    } else {
      throw new Error('No text');
    }
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn('[ai-report] fallback:', e.message);
    var fallback = buildDailyReport(records, manualTasks);
    var fallbackTime = new Date().toISOString();
    try { vxSafeJsonLocalStorageSet(cacheKey, { text: fallback || '', generatedAt: fallbackTime }, { maxBytes: 80000 }); } catch(ee) {}
    _showAiReport(fallback || '', false, fallbackTime);
    _aiReportGenerated = true;
  }
}

function _showAiReport(text, isLoading, generatedAtIso) {
  // [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2.2 — Zeitstempel + Refresh-Button]
  // Vorher: Text wurde nur angezeigt, keine Indikation wann er generiert wurde
  // Jetzt: "Stand: HH:MM" rechts oben + Klick-Option zum Neugenerieren
  var reportBlock = document.getElementById('dash-daily-report');
  var reportText = document.getElementById('dash-daily-report-text');
  if (!reportBlock || !reportText) return;
  if (!text) { reportBlock.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  // [PATCH v2.19 — Markdown-Artefakte aus KI-Text entfernen]
  // Das KI-Modell gibt manchmal Markdown-Headings (# Aktuelle Situation) oder
  // fette/kursive Formatierungen zurück, die als Rohtext unschön aussehen.
  // Hier werden die häufigsten Markdown-Artefakte bereinigt.
  var cleanText = String(text)
    .replace(/^#{1,3}\s+/gm, '')       // ## Heading → leer
    .replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '$1')   // **fett** → fett
    .replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '$1')       // *kursiv* → kursiv
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '$1')       // `code` → code
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')        // 3+ Zeilenumbrüche → max 2
    .trim();
  reportText.textContent = cleanText;
  reportText.style.color = isLoading ? 'var(--slate2)' : 'var(--ink2)';
  reportBlock.style.display = '';

  // Zeitstempel und Refresh-Button — nur wenn nicht Ladezustand
  var metaEl = document.getElementById('dash-daily-report-meta');
  if (!metaEl) {
    // Meta-Container existiert noch nicht → erstellen und einfügen
    metaEl = document.createElement('div');
    metaEl.id = 'dash-daily-report-meta';
    metaEl.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--slate2);';
    reportText.parentNode.insertBefore(metaEl, reportText.nextSibling);
  }
  if (isLoading || !generatedAtIso) {
    metaEl.style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    var d = new Date(generatedAtIso);
    var hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0');
    var mm = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
    metaEl.innerHTML = '<span>Zuletzt aktualisiert: ' + hh + ':' + mm + '</span>' +
      '<button id="dash-daily-report-refresh" type="button" ' +
      'style="background:none;border:none;color:#1A6FE8;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:11px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;" ' +
      'onmouseover="this.style.background=\'rgba(26,111,232,0.08)\'" ' +
      'onmouseout="this.style.background=\'none\'">Neu generieren</button>' +
      '<span id="dash-daily-report-status" style="display:none;color:#94A3B8;"></span>';
    metaEl.style.display = 'flex';
    var refreshBtn = document.getElementById('dash-daily-report-refresh');
    var statusEl = document.getElementById('dash-daily-report-status');
    if (refreshBtn) {
      refreshBtn.onclick = async function() {
        if (refreshBtn.disabled) return;
        var oldLabel = refreshBtn.textContent;
        refreshBtn.disabled = true;
        refreshBtn.textContent = 'Generiere…';
        if (statusEl) { statusEl.style.display = 'none'; statusEl.textContent = ''; }
        _aiReportGenerated = false;
        _aiReportForceRefresh = true;
        try {
          await generateAiDailyReport(window.allRecords || allRecords, window.allManualTaskRecords || allManualTaskRecords, null);
          if (statusEl) { statusEl.textContent = 'Aktualisiert'; statusEl.style.color = '#64748B'; statusEl.style.display = 'inline'; }
        } catch(e) {
          if (statusEl) { statusEl.textContent = 'Aktualisierung fehlgeschlagen'; statusEl.style.color = '#DC2626'; statusEl.style.display = 'inline'; }
        } finally {
          refreshBtn.disabled = false;
          refreshBtn.textContent = oldLabel;
        }
      };
    }
  }

  /* phosphor: no init needed */
}

function getReachabilityStatus(records) {
  var calls = (records || []).filter(function(r) {
    return !isActivationCallCategory((r.fields||{}).category);
  });
  if (calls.length === 0) return { status: 'unbekannt', label: 'Noch kein Anruf', cls: 'gray', daysSince: null };
  calls.sort(function(a,b) {
    return new Date(getRecordTimestamp(b)) - new Date(getRecordTimestamp(a));
  });
  var last = new Date(getRecordTimestamp(calls[0]));
  var now = new Date();
  var diffMs = now - last;
  var diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000*60*60*24));
  if (diffDays === 0) return { status: 'aktiv', label: 'Aktiv · Letzter Anruf heute', cls: 'green', daysSince: 0 };
  if (diffDays === 1) return { status: 'aktiv', label: 'Aktiv · Letzter Anruf gestern', cls: 'green', daysSince: 1 };
  if (diffDays <= 7) return { status: 'unklar', label: 'Letzter Anruf vor ' + diffDays + ' Tagen', cls: 'amber', daysSince: diffDays };
  return { status: 'inaktiv', label: 'Kein Anruf seit ' + diffDays + ' Tagen', cls: 'red', daysSince: diffDays };
}

function updateDashboardHeaderMeta() {
  const sub = document.getElementById('greeting-sub');
  if (!sub) return;
  var buckets = deriveDashboardCallBuckets(allRecords || []);
  var openCalls = buckets.open.length;
  var openCallbacks = getOpenTaskCount();
  var now2 = new Date();
  var days = ['So','Mo','Di','Mi','Do','Fr','Sa'];
  var months = ['Jan','Feb','Mär','Apr','Mai','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Okt','Nov','Dez'];
  var timeStr = days[now2.getDay()] + ', ' + now2.getDate() + '. ' + months[now2.getMonth()] + ' · ' + now2.getHours().toString().padStart(2,'0') + ':' + now2.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0');
  sub.textContent = openCalls + ' Anrufe · ' + openCallbacks + ' Rückrufe offen · ' + timeStr;
}

function isToday(raw) {
  if (!raw) return false;
  const d = parseFollowUpDate(raw) || new Date(raw);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return false;
  // Kalendertag — Mitternacht als Grenze (sauber und intuitiv)
  const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: DISPLAY_TIMEZONE, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' });
  return fmt.format(d) === fmt.format(new Date());
}

function isThisWeek(raw) {
  if (!raw) return false;
  const d = parseFollowUpDate(raw) || new Date(raw), now = new Date();
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return false;
  const start = new Date(now);
  // Monday-first week (Swiss / ISO 8601): Sun=0 → offset 6, Mon=1 → offset 0, …, Sat=6 → offset 5
  const dayOffset = now.getDay() === 0 ? 6 : now.getDay() - 1;
  start.setDate(now.getDate() - dayOffset);
  start.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  return d >= start;
}

function toast(msg, type) {
  var el = document.getElementById('toast');
  var textEl = document.getElementById('toast-text');
  var iconEl = document.getElementById('toast-icon');
  if (!el) return;
  if (textEl) textEl.textContent = msg;
  else el.textContent = msg;
  // Icon by type
  var rawMsg = String(msg || '').trim();
  var inferredType = 'success';
  if (/fehler|nicht|ungültig|konnte nicht|fehlgeschlagen/i.test(rawMsg)) inferredType = 'error';
  else if (/bitte|warn|achtung/i.test(rawMsg)) inferredType = 'warning';
  else if (/info|hinweis/i.test(rawMsg)) inferredType = 'info';
  var t = type || inferredType;
  var icons = {
    success: '<svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 10 10" fill="none" stroke="#22C55E" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M1.5 5l2.5 2.5L8.5 2"/></svg>',
    info:    '<svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 10 10" fill="none" stroke="#818CF8" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="5" cy="5" r="4"/><path d="M5 4.5v3M5 3h.01"/></svg>',
    warning: '<svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 10 10" fill="none" stroke="#FBBF24" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M5 1L9 9H1L5 1z"/><path d="M5 5v2M5 7.5h.01"/></svg>',
    error:   '<svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 10 10" fill="none" stroke="#F87171" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="5" cy="5" r="4"/><path d="M3.7 3.7l2.6 2.6M6.3 3.7L3.7 6.3"/></svg>'
  };
  if (iconEl) {
    iconEl.className = 'toast-icon ' + t;
    iconEl.innerHTML = icons[t] || icons.success;
  }
  el.classList.remove('show');
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(el._toastTimer);
  el._toastTimer = setTimeout(function() { el.classList.remove('show'); }, 2800);
}
window.toast = toast;

// [v5.8.2] Toast compatibility guard:
// Several legacy paths call showToast(...) directly. Safari/iOS throws if the
// function is missing, so keep a small adapter to the canonical toast().
function showToast(msg, type) {
  return toast(String(msg || ''), type || undefined);
}
window.showToast = showToast;
