async function loadData() {
  // ── Concurrency Guard ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Verhindert parallele loadData-Laeufe (Realtime + Polling + focus + confirm
  // koennen gleichzeitig feuern). Ohne Guard ueberschreibt der langsamere Lauf
  // customerMeta / candidateCall des schnelleren -> State Drift.
  // Wichtig: nicht hart verwerfen sondern "pending" merken und nach Abschluss
  // einmal wiederholen. Sonst werden Polling-Aufrufe waehrend pending_test
  // komplett verschluckt -> candidateCall wird nie gesetzt -> Auto-Confirm
  // laeuft nie durch.
  if (loadDataInFlight) {
    loadDataPending = true;
    return;
  }
  loadDataInFlight = true;
  loadDataPending = false;

  const btn = document.getElementById('refresh-btn');
  if (btn) { btn.textContent = '↻ Lädt...'; btn.style.opacity = '.6'; }

  try {
    await loadCustomerMeta().catch(()=>{});
    applyContractAccessStateToUI();
    await loadPlanConfigFromSupabase().catch(()=>{});
    const context = await resolveCustomerContext(true);
    setupDashboardRealtime((context && context.customerId) || '');

    // ─── ACCESS GUARD ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!(await ensureActiveCustomerOrLogout(context))) return;
    // ─── END ACCESS GUARD ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    const records = await loadCallRecords(context.customerId || '');
    const manualTasks = await loadManualTaskRecords(context.customerId || '');

    flagIncomingRecords(records);
    // Activation-Test-Calls aus der Dashboard-Anzeige ausschliessen.
    // activation_test_outbound und activation_test_inbound sind interne
    // System-Calls und sollen nicht in Anfragen/Verlauf/Dashboard erscheinen.
    // allRecordsRaw includes test calls for polling detection
    allRecordsRaw = records;
    allRecords = records.filter(function(r) {
      return !isActivationCallCategory((r.fields || {}).category);
    });
    allManualTaskRecords = manualTasks;
    window.allRecords = allRecords;
    window.allManualTaskRecords = allManualTaskRecords;
    _vxNotifDataReady = true;
    if (_vxNotifLoaded) {
      vxBellUpdateBadge();
      if (_vxBellOpen) { vxBellRender(); vxBellPageRender(); }
    }

    const titleEl = document.getElementById('greeting-main');
    if (titleEl) {
      var firstName = customerMeta.contactFirstName || (customerMeta.customerName ? customerMeta.customerName.split(' ')[0] : '') || '';
      titleEl.textContent = getTimeBasedGreeting() + (firstName ? ', ' + firstName : '');
      titleEl.dataset.custom = '1';
    }

    renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    renderAnrufe();
    renderRueckrufe(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    renderArchiv(allRecords);
    if (typeof updateLiveHero === 'function') updateLiveHero(allRecords);
    if (typeof renderAuswertung === 'function') renderAuswertung();
    applyContractAccessStateToUI();
    updateLastUpdatedLabel();

    // [legacy] Candidate-call activation polling removed — checkTestCall handles testing now

    // ── Atomarer Loader→Content Übergang ─────────────────────────────────────
    // dash-loading und dash-content werden in einer einzigen synchronen
    // Operation getauscht. Vorher: zwei separate Operationen mit einem Frame
    // Lücke dazwischen → leerer Screen / Flicker.
    // Zusätzlich: Content nur zeigen wenn customerMeta vollständig geladen
    // (customerId vorhanden) – verhindert '–' Flicker bei Voxera-Nummer/Tel.
    routeDashboardFirstSessionExperience();
    safeMountActivationV2({ reason: 'loadData', softGate: false });
    updateSidebarStatus();
    // Loader erst nach allen Render-Operationen verstecken – atomar
    var loadingEl = document.getElementById('dash-loading');
    if (loadingEl) loadingEl.style.display = 'none';

  } catch(e) {
    const rawMsg = String((e && e.message) || 'Unbekannter Fehler');
    const lower = rawMsg.toLowerCase();
    let uiMsg = rawMsg;

    if (lower.includes('airtable')) {
      uiMsg = 'Alte Version erkannt (Legacy Airtable Fehler). Bitte in Netlify "Clear cache and deploy site" ausführen und danach Hard-Reload (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R).';
    }
    // Legacy compatibility: older cached deployments can still return stale backend error texts.
    else if (lower.includes('401') || lower.includes('unauthorized')) {
      uiMsg = 'Daten konnten nicht geladen werden. Bitte neu deployen und Seite mit Hard-Reload öffnen (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R).';
    } else if (lower.includes('permission') || lower.includes('rls')) {
      uiMsg = 'Keine Berechtigung für diese Daten (RLS). Bitte Benutzer-Zuordnung in Supabase prüfen.';
    }

    const _loadingEl = document.getElementById('dash-loading');
    if (_loadingEl) _loadingEl.innerHTML =
      `<div class="error-banner">Fehler beim Laden: ${uiMsg}<br><small>Bitte Seite neu laden.</small></div>`;
  } finally {
    // Concurrency Guard: freigeben und pending-Run nachholen falls noetig
    loadDataInFlight = false;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = '↻ Aktualisieren'; btn.style.opacity = '1'; }
    if (loadDataPending) {
      loadDataPending = false;
      // Minimalverzoegerung damit Browser-Event-Loop nicht blockiert wird
      setTimeout(function() { loadData().catch(function(){}); }, 50);
    }
  }
}

===== vxHeuteRenderActivityList | LINES 21870-21910 =====
function vxHeuteRenderActivityList(records) {
  var section = document.getElementById('dash-activity-section');
  var list = document.getElementById('dash-activity-list');
  var countEl = document.getElementById('dash-activity-count');
  if (!section || !list) return;
  var rows = vxHeuteDedupeByStableId(records || []).filter(Boolean).sort(function(a,b){
    return (new Date(vxHeuteActivityTimestamp(b) || 0).getTime() || 0) - (new Date(vxHeuteActivityTimestamp(a) || 0).getTime() || 0);
  }).slice(0, 25);
  section.style.display = '';
  if (countEl) countEl.textContent = String(rows.length || 0);
  if (!rows.length) {
    vxSetHtmlIfChanged(list, '<div class="dash-empty">Heute gibt es noch keinen Verlauf.</div>');
    return;
  }
  var html = rows.map(function(rec){
    var id = String((rec && rec.id) || vxHeuteGetRecordValue(rec, ['id','call_id']) || '');
    var label = vxHeuteActivityLabel(rec);
    var title = vxHeuteRecordTitle(rec);
    var summary = vxHeuteRecordSummary(rec);
    var time = vxHeuteActivityTime(rec);
    var isDone = label === 'Erledigt';
    var icon = isDone ? 'check-circle' : (label.indexOf('Rückruf') >= 0 ? 'bell-ringing' : (vxHeuteIsManualTask(rec) ? 'calendar-check' : 'phone-incoming'));
    var iconClass = isDone ? 'vx-activity-icon is-done' : (!vxHeuteIsManualTask(rec) ? 'vx-activity-icon is-call' : 'vx-activity-icon');
    return '<div class="vx-activity-row" data-id="'+_esc(id)+'" data-record-id="'+_esc(id)+'">'
      + '<div class="vx-activity-time">'+_esc(time || '–')+'</div>'
      + '<div style="min-width:0;"><div class="vx-activity-title">'+_esc(title)+'</div>'
      + '<div class="vx-activity-sub">'+_esc(label)+(summary ? ' · '+_esc(summary) : '')+'</div></div>'
      + '<div class="'+iconClass+'"><i class="ph-bold ph-'+icon+'"></i></div>'
      + '</div>';
  }).join('');
  vxSetHtmlIfChanged(list, html);
  list.querySelectorAll('.vx-activity-row').forEach(function(row){
    row.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var recId = row.dataset.recordId || row.dataset.id;
      var rec = typeof vxResolveDprRecord === 'function' ? vxResolveDprRecord(recId) : null;
      if (rec && isManualTaskRecord(rec)) { if (typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') showTaskDetail(recId); }
      else if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') showCallDetail(recId);
    });
  });
  refreshLucideIcons();
}

function renderDashboard(records, manualTasks) {
  var buckets = deriveDashboardCallBuckets(records || []);
  var autoTasks = getUnifiedOpenTasks(records || []);
  var manualOpenTasks = (typeof vxGetOpenManualTasks === 'function') ? vxGetOpenManualTasks() : (manualTasks || allManualTaskRecords || []).filter(function(r) {
    var f = (r && r.fields) || {};
    return !vxIsClosedManualTaskStatus(f.status || f.dashboard_status);
  });
  var unifiedTasks = getUnifiedOpenTasks([].concat(autoTasks, manualOpenTasks));
  var doneToday = (records || []).filter(function(r) {
    return isClosedStatus(r.fields && r.fields.dashboard_status) && isToday(getRecordTimestamp(r));
  });
  var offen = unifiedTasks;
  var sortedOpenCallbacks = unifiedTasks;
  var allOpen = buckets.open;
  updateActivationStatusCard(records);

  // [BUG FIX v2.52b] KPI "Neue Anfragen" muss dieselbe Logik wie Chip "Neu" verwenden:
  // Records mit status=new die bereits auf Heute sind (callback/urgency/followup)
  // werden im Chip "Neu" ausgeblendet — der KPI muss das ebenfalls tun.
  var newOpenRequestsRaw = (typeof vxGetNewRequestCalls === 'function') ? vxGetNewRequestCalls(records || []) : allOpen.filter(function(r){
    var f = (r && r.fields) || {};
    return isCustomerVisibleCall(r) && String(f.live_status || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'completed' && !f.read_at;
  });
  var newOpenRequests = newOpenRequestsRaw;
  var anfragenOps = (typeof vxGetAnfragenOperationalCounts === 'function') ? vxGetAnfragenOperationalCounts(records || [], manualTasks || allManualTaskRecords || []) : { inbox: newOpenRequests.length, planned: 0, done: 0, doneToday: 0 };

  // ── KPI: neue Anfragen / offene Aufgaben / erledigt heute / überfällig ─────
  var kpiHeute = document.getElementById('kpi-heute');
  if (kpiHeute) kpiHeute.textContent = allOpen.length;

  var kpiCallbacks = document.getElementById('kpi-callbacks');
  if (kpiCallbacks) kpiCallbacks.textContent = offen.length;

  var kpiFollowups = document.getElementById('kpi-followups');
  if (kpiFollowups) kpiFollowups.textContent = doneToday.length;

  // ── Hero + Fokuskarte (nur UI-Mapping, bestehende Datenquelle) ────────────
  var statusHero = document.getElementById('dash-status-hero');
  var statusTitle = document.getElementById('dash-status-title');
  var statusText = document.getElementById('dash-status-text');
  var statusChipPrimary = document.getElementById('dash-status-chip-primary');

  if (statusHero && statusTitle && statusText && statusChipPrimary && statusChipSecondary) {
    statusChipPrimary.className = 'dash-status-chip';
    statusChipSecondary.className = 'dash-status-chip note';
    if (isContractRestrictedState()) {
      statusTitle.textContent = 'Vertrag derzeit nicht aktiv';
      statusText.textContent = 'Ihr Zugang ist eingeschränkt. Produktive Änderungen sind erst mit aktivem Vertrag wieder möglich.';
      statusChipPrimary.textContent = 'Eingeschränkter Modus';
      statusChipPrimary.classList.add('alert');
      statusChipSecondary.textContent = 'Vertragsstatus: ' + getContractStatusLabel(customerMeta.contractStatus);
    } else if (offen.length > 0) {
      statusTitle.textContent = 'Anfragen im Fokus';
      statusText.textContent = 'Sie haben aktuell ' + offen.length + ' offene Anfragen.';
      statusChipPrimary.textContent = offen.length + ' offen';
      statusChipPrimary.classList.add('alert');
      statusChipSecondary.textContent = anfragenOps.inbox + ' Inbox · ' + anfragenOps.planned + ' geplant';
    } else {
      statusTitle.textContent = 'Alles im Griff';
      statusText.textContent = 'Aktuell gibt es keine offenen Anfragen.';
      statusChipPrimary.textContent = 'Keine offenen Anfragen';
      statusChipPrimary.classList.add('ok');
      statusChipSecondary.textContent = anfragenOps.inbox + ' Inbox · ' + anfragenOps.planned + ' geplant';
    }
  }

  var focusNumberEl = document.getElementById('dash-focus-number');
  var focusHintEl = document.getElementById('dash-focus-hint');
  var focusTextEl = document.getElementById('dash-focus-text');
  var focusNextEl = document.getElementById('dash-focus-next');
  var focusStatusEl = document.getElementById('dash-focus-status');

  if (focusDateTimeEl) {
    focusDateTimeEl.textContent = formatDashboardFocusMetaNow(new Date());

    focusNumberEl.textContent = offen.length;

  if (sparkEl && records && records.length > 0) {

    var today3 = new Date();

    for (var d = 6; d >= 0; d--) {

    }).join('');
    if (sparkLabels) sparkLabels.innerHTML = weekData.map(function(d) {

    }).join('');
    if (sparkBlock) sparkBlock.style.display = '';
  var sparkSec = document.getElementById('dash-sparkline-section'); if (sparkSec) sparkSec.style.display = '';
  }

  // ── Recent Calls (dedupliziert, nur primärer Arbeitskorb) ────────────
  var allOpenCalls = buckets.recent;
  // ── Priorisierte Einheitsliste "Jetzt wichtig" ───────────────────
  // Nutzt buckets.open (alle nicht-erledigten) statt nur buckets.recent
  var liveRecord = pickLiveCall(records || []);
  var isLiveMatch = buildLiveCallMatcher(liveRecord);
  var priorityNow = new Date();
  var todayStart = new Date(priorityNow.getFullYear(), priorityNow.getMonth(), priorityNow.getDate());
  var todayEnd = new Date(todayStart.getTime() + 86400000);

  var allTasks = (typeof allManualTaskRecords !== 'undefined' && allManualTaskRecords) ? allManualTaskRecords : [];
  var workItems = buildDashboardWorkItems(buckets.open || [], allTasks);
  var manualNow = workItems.filter(function(w) {
    if (w.source !== 'manual_task') return false;
    var meta = vxGetDueSortMeta(w.record);
    return meta.hasDue && meta.sortMs <= todayEnd.getTime();
  }).map(function(w){ return w.record; });
  var manualPlanned = workItems.filter(function(w) {
    if (w.source !== 'manual_task') return false;
    var meta = vxGetDueSortMeta(w.record);
    return meta.hasDue && meta.sortMs > todayEnd.getTime();
  }).map(function(w){ return w.record; });
  var priorityRecords = buckets.open
    .filter(function(r){ return !isLiveMatch || !isLiveMatch(r); })
    .filter(function(r){
      var state = getCallDisplayState(r);
      if (state === 'short_abandoned') return false;
      var f = (r && r.fields) || {};
      var isCallback = getFollowUpTaskType(r) === 'callback';
      var badgeState = getFollowUpBadgeState(r, priorityNow);
      var hasDatedFollowUp = !!formatFollowUpDueLabel(r, priorityNow);
      var isUrgent = getPriority(r).key === 'urgent';
      if (hasDatedFollowUp && badgeState === 'planned') return false;
      if (state === 'processing') return isCallback || isUrgent || badgeState === 'overdue' || badgeState === 'today';
      return isCallback || isUrgent || badgeState === 'overdue' || badgeState === 'today' || normalizeStatus(f.dashboard_status) === CALL_STATUS.NEW;
    })
    .filter(function(r){ return !isClosedStatus(((r && r.fields) || {}).dashboard_status); })
    .sort(function(a, b) {
      var aFields = (a && a.fields) || {};
      var bFields = (b && b.fields) || {};
      var aBadge = getFollowUpBadgeState(a, priorityNow);
      var bBadge = getFollowUpBadgeState(b, priorityNow);
      var aCallback = getFollowUpTaskType(a) === 'callback';
      var bCallback = getFollowUpTaskType(b) === 'callback';
      var aUrgent = getPriority(a).key === 'urgent';
      var bUrgent = getPriority(b).key === 'urgent';
      function rank(badge, callback, urgent) {
        if (badge === 'overdue') return 0;
        if (badge === 'today') return 1;
        if (callback && badge === 'generic') return 2;
        if (urgent) return 3;
        return 4;
      }
      var ar = rank(aBadge, aCallback, aUrgent);
      var br = rank(bBadge, bCallback, bUrgent);
      if (ar !== br) return ar - br;
      if (ar <= 1) return compareFollowUpPriority(a, b, priorityNow);
      return new Date(getRecordTimestamp(b) || 0).getTime() - new Date(getRecordTimestamp(a) || 0).getTime();
    });
  // [PATCH 2026-05-13 v2 — Globale Sortierung Jetzt-wichtig]
  // Vorher: concat(manualNow, priorityRecords, manualPlanned) — Reihenfolge fest, aber Sortierung NICHT global.
  //   Folge: Silvia Müller (10.05) erschien VOR Rückruf (heute 17:53) weil sie in priorityRecords war,
  //   während der Rückruf in manualPlanned hinten landete.
  // Jetzt: Alles in ein Array, globale Sortierung nach Priorität:
  //   Rank 0: überfällig
  //   Rank 1: heute fällig
  //   Rank 2: zukünftig geplant
  //   Rank 3: ohne Datum (Rückruf-Wünsche von Anrufen ohne Nachfassen)
  var combinedAll = [].concat(manualNow, priorityRecords, manualPlanned);
  // V3.2: Heute nutzt ein bewusstes ViewModel.
  // Relevante Calls + offene customer_tasks kommen in Aufmerksamkeit;
  // irrelevante Calls bleiben im Verlauf "Heute passiert".
  if (typeof vxBuildTodayAttentionRecords === 'function') {
    _dashPriorityAllRecords = vxBuildTodayAttentionRecords(records || [], allTasks || []);
  } else {
    // Fallback auf alte Logik, falls Helper nicht geladen ist.
    var seenIds = new Set();
    var uniqueAll = combinedAll.filter(function(rec){
      if (!rec || !rec.id) return true;
      if (seenIds.has(rec.id)) return false;
      seenIds.add(rec.id);
      return true;
    });
    _dashPriorityAllRecords = uniqueAll.sort(function(a, b) {
      return vxCompareDashboardPriorityRecords(a, b, priorityNow);
    });
  }
  // Der KPI "Wichtig jetzt" muss exakt dieselbe Anzahl zeigen wie die sichtbare Liste unten.
  var visibleImportantCount = _dashPriorityAllRecords.length;
  if (kpiDn) {
    kpiDn.textContent = String(visibleImportantCount || 0);
    kpiDn.style.color = visibleImportantCount > 0 ? '#D97706' : '#94A3B8';
  }
  if (kpiCellDue) kpiCellDue.style.borderTop = visibleImportantCount > 0 ? '2px solid var(--vx-gold)' : '2px solid rgba(148,163,184,.45)';
  if (kpiDueBar) kpiDueBar.style.background = visibleImportantCount > 0 ? 'linear-gradient(90deg,#FCD34D,#D97706)' : 'linear-gradient(90deg,#CBD5E1,#94A3B8)';
  if (typeof vxSetHeuteKpiCell === 'function') vxSetHeuteKpiCell(kpiCellDue, visibleImportantCount > 0, 'vxHeuteKpiScrollImportant');
  renderDashPriorityList();
  // [v2.70] Focus-Card entfernt
  var moreBtn = document.getElementById('dash-recent-more');
  if (moreBtn) {
    if (!dashPriorityExpanded && _dashPriorityAllRecords.length > 5) {
      moreBtn.style.display = 'block';
      moreBtn.textContent = 'Alle ' + _dashPriorityAllRecords.length + ' offenen Punkte anzeigen';
    } else {
      moreBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  // Sparkline section visibility
  var sparkSection = document.getElementById('dash-sparkline-section');
  if (sparkSection && document.getElementById('dash-sparkline') && document.getElementById('dash-sparkline').children.length > 0) {
    sparkSection.style.display = '';
  }

  // ── Badges (Sidebar + Mobile Nav) ────────────────────
  var badgeA = document.getElementById('badge-anrufe');
  var badgeR = document.getElementById('badge-rueckrufe');
  var mb1    = document.getElementById('mnav-badge-anrufe');
  var mb2    = document.getElementById('mnav-badge-rueckrufe');
  // Badge = nur neue, noch nicht gesehene Anrufe
  var seenCalls = getSeenCallIdsFromStorage();
  var newCount = allOpen.filter(function(r) {
    return normalizeStatus((r.fields||{}).dashboard_status) === CALL_STATUS.NEW && !seenCalls.has(String(r.id));
  }).length;
  if (badgeA) { badgeA.textContent = newCount; badgeA.style.display = newCount > 0 ? '' : 'none'; }
  if (badgeR) { badgeR.style.display = 'none'; }
  if (mb1) { mb1.textContent = formatMobileBadgeCount(newCount); mb1.style.display = newCount > 0 ? 'block' : 'none'; }
  if (mb2) { mb2.textContent = formatMobileBadgeCount(unifiedTasks.length);   mb2.style.display = unifiedTasks.length > 0   ? 'block' : 'none'; }
  if (typeof vxUpdateAnfragenNavBadges === 'function') vxUpdateAnfragenNavBadges();

  // Callback list lives on dedicated Rückrufe tab only

  // Kompatibilität: renderUsage und updateSystemStatus bleiben unverändert
  renderUsage(records);
  updateSystemStatus(records);
}

===== vxArchivRestore | LINES 24399-24438 =====
async function vxArchivRestore(recordId) {
  if (!recordId) return;

  var btn = document.querySelector('[data-restore-id="'+recordId+'"]');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.innerHTML = '<i class="ph-bold ph-spinner" style="font-size:11px;"></i>'; }

  try {
    // Muss über Netlify Function gehen — direkter Supabase-Call scheitert an RLS + DB-Constraint
    var result = await callDashboardFunction('call-update-status', {
      call_id: recordId,
      status: 'closed'
    });

    if (result && result.error) throw new Error(result.error);

    // Lokalen State aktualisieren
    var records = (typeof allRecords !== 'undefined' && allRecords) ? allRecords : (window.allRecords || []);
    var rec = records.find(function(r) { return String((r && r.id) || '') === String(recordId); });
    if (rec && rec.fields) {
      rec.fields.dashboard_status = 'closed';
      rec.fields.completed_at = null;
    }

    if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('✓ Eintrag wiederhergestellt');
    else if (typeof toast === 'function') toast('Eintrag wiederhergestellt', 'success');

    renderArchiv(records);
    if (typeof renderAnrufe === 'function') renderAnrufe();
    if (typeof renderDashboard === 'function') renderDashboard(records, []);

  } catch(e) {
    console.error('[vxArchivRestore]', e);
    if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('⚠ Fehler: ' + (e.message || 'Unbekannter Fehler'));
    var btn2 = document.querySelector('[data-restore-id="'+recordId+'"]');
    if (btn2) {
      btn2.disabled = false;
      btn2.innerHTML = '<i class="ph-bold ph-arrow-u-up-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>';
    }
  }
}

===== exportArchiv | LINES 24441-25243 =====
function exportArchiv() {
  var done = _archivAllDone.length ? _archivAllDone :
    (allRecords||[]).filter(function(r){ return normalizeStatus((r.fields||{}).dashboard_status) === CALL_STATUS.ARCHIVED; });
  if (!done.length) { toast('Keine Einträge zum Exportieren'); return; }
  var rows = [['Name','Telefon','Kategorie','Datum','Uhrzeit','Zusammenfassung','Nachfassen','Notiz']];
  done.forEach(function(r) {
    var f = r.fields || {};
    var ts = getRecordTimestamp(r) || '';
    var d = ts ? parseCallTimestamp(ts) : null;
    var date = d ? d.toLocaleDateString('de-CH', {timeZone:'Europe/Zurich'}) : '';
    var time = d ? d.toLocaleTimeString('de-CH',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',timeZone:'Europe/Zurich'}) : '';
    var followUp = resolveFollowUpAt(f) ? fmtFollowUpDateTime(resolveFollowUpAt(f)) : '';
    rows.push([
      f.caller_name||'',
      f.caller_phone||f.phone_number||'',
      f.category||'',
      date, time,
      (f.call_summary||'').replace(/\n/g,' '),
      followUp,
      (f.notes_customer_voxera||'').replace(/\n/g,' ')
    ]);
  });
  var csv = rows.map(function(row){
    return row.map(function(cell){
      var s = String(cell||'').replace(/"/g,'""');
      return (s.includes(',')||s.includes('"')||s.includes('\n')) ? '"'+s+'"' : s;
    }).join(',');
  }).join('\r\n');
  var blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
  var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'voxera-archiv-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.csv';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  toast('CSV exportiert ('+done.length+' Einträge)');
}

var confirmModalAction = null;
var confirmModalBusy = false;
var overlayFocusReturnMap = {};

function rememberOverlayFocusReturn(overlayId) {
  if (!overlayId) return;
  var active = document.activeElement;
  if (active && typeof active.focus === 'function') overlayFocusReturnMap[overlayId] = active;
}

function restoreOverlayFocus(overlayId) {
  var el = overlayFocusReturnMap[overlayId];
  delete overlayFocusReturnMap[overlayId];
  if (el && el.isConnected && !el.disabled && el.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true') {
    try { el.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch(e) { try { el.focus(); } catch(_) {} }
  }
}

function setOverlayAriaHidden(overlayId, hidden) {
  var overlay = document.getElementById(overlayId);
  if (overlay) overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', hidden ? 'true' : 'false');
}


window.vxScrollLocks = window.vxScrollLocks || new Set();

function vxApplyScrollLock() {
  var locked = !!(window.vxScrollLocks && window.vxScrollLocks.size);
  var value = locked ? 'hidden' : '';
  if (document.body) document.body.style.overflow = value;
  if (document.documentElement) document.documentElement.style.overflow = value;
  if (window.VOXERA_DEBUG_SCROLL) {
    vxDebugLog('[scroll-lock] apply', locked, Array.from(window.vxScrollLocks || []));
  }
}

function vxSetScrollLock(reason, locked) {
  if (!window.vxScrollLocks) window.vxScrollLocks = new Set();
  if (!reason) reason = 'unknown';
  if (locked) window.vxScrollLocks.add(String(reason));
  else window.vxScrollLocks.delete(String(reason));
  vxApplyScrollLock();
}

function vxClearAllScrollLocks() {
  if (!window.vxScrollLocks) window.vxScrollLocks = new Set();
  window.vxScrollLocks.clear();
  vxApplyScrollLock();
}

function vxSyncScrollLock() {
  var hasOverlay = !!document.querySelector('.overlay.open, .detail-overlay.open, .account-overlay.open');
  var callDetail = document.getElementById('call-detail-page');
  var callDetailOpen = !!(callDetail && callDetail.style.display === 'block');
  var detailV2 = document.getElementById('vx-detail-v2');
  var detailV2Open = !!(detailV2 && detailV2.style.display !== 'none');
  vxSetScrollLock('overlay', hasOverlay);
  vxSetScrollLock('call-detail-page', callDetailOpen);
  vxSetScrollLock('detail-v2', detailV2Open);
}
function syncOverlayScrollLock() {
  vxSyncScrollLock();
}

// [VX 2026-05-17] Interaction Reliability helpers.
// Small, local UI safeguards only: no schema changes, no business-logic changes.
function vxSetActionButtonLoading(button, isLoading, loadingLabel) {
  if (!button) return;
  if (isLoading) {
    if (!button.dataset.vxOriginalText) button.dataset.vxOriginalText = button.textContent || '';
    button.dataset.vxSaving = '1';
    button.disabled = true;
    button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    button.textContent = loadingLabel || 'Speichern...';
  } else {
    button.dataset.vxSaving = '0';
    button.disabled = false;
    button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'false');
    if (button.dataset.vxOriginalText) button.textContent = button.dataset.vxOriginalText;
    delete button.dataset.vxOriginalText;
  }
}

function vxIsActionButtonSaving(button) {
  return !!(button && button.dataset && button.dataset.vxSaving === '1');
}

  try { if (typeof renderAnrufe === 'function') renderAnrufe(); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Voxera SaveFlow] renderAnrufe skipped', e); }
  try { if (typeof renderRueckrufe === 'function') renderRueckrufe(callRecords, taskRecords); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Voxera SaveFlow] renderRueckrufe skipped', e); }
  try { if (typeof renderDashPriorityList === 'function') renderDashPriorityList(callRecords, taskRecords); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Voxera SaveFlow] renderDashPriorityList skipped', e); }
}

}

}

function vxApplyPendingRowHighlight() {
  var targetId = String(window._vxPendingHighlightRecordId || '').trim();
  if (!targetId) return;
  var row = document.querySelector('.vx-heute-row[data-record-id="' + CSS.escape(targetId) + '"]')
    || document.querySelector('.vx-heute-row[data-id="' + CSS.escape(targetId) + '"]')
    || document.querySelector('.dpr-card[data-id="' + CSS.escape(targetId) + '"] .vx-heute-row');
  if (!row) return;
  row.classList.remove('vx-row-highlight');
  void row.offsetWidth;
  row.classList.add('vx-row-highlight');
  window._vxPendingHighlightRecordId = null;
  setTimeout(function() { row.classList.remove('vx-row-highlight'); }, 1600);

function vxRefreshActiveDetailAfterAction(options) {
  var opts = options || {};
  var activeType = String(window._vxCurrentDetailType || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  var currentActiveId = String(window._vxActiveRecordId || '').trim();
  var targetId = String(opts.recordId || '').trim();
  var createdId = String(opts.createdRecordId || '').trim();
  var primaryId = createdId || targetId;
  var detailId = '';

  if (activeType === 'task' && (primaryId || currentActiveId)) {
    detailId = primaryId || currentActiveId;
  } else if (activeType === 'call' && (primaryId || currentActiveId)) {
    detailId = primaryId || currentActiveId;
  } else if (!activeType && (primaryId || currentActiveId)) {
    detailId = primaryId || currentActiveId;
  }

  if (!detailId) return;

  var isTask = (typeof vxIsManualTaskRecordId === 'function')
    ? vxIsManualTaskRecordId(detailId)
    : String(detailId || '').indexOf('case:') === 0;

  if (isTask) {
    if (typeof showTaskDetail === 'function') showTaskDetail(detailId);
  } else {
    if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') showCallDetail(detailId);
  }
}

function vxAfterActionSuccess(options) {
  var opts = options || {};
  var targetId = String(opts.createdRecordId || opts.recordId || '').trim();
  if (targetId) {
    window._vxActiveRecordId = targetId;
    window._vxPendingHighlightRecordId = targetId;
  }
  if (opts.closeModal !== false) {
    if (opts.modal === 'manual-task' && typeof closeManualTaskModal === 'function') closeManualTaskModal();
    else if (opts.modal === 'followup' && typeof closeFollowup === 'function') closeFollowup();
  }
  if (typeof vxRefreshOperationalViews === 'function') vxRefreshOperationalViews(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
  else {
    if (typeof renderDashboard === 'function') renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    if (typeof renderAnrufe === 'function') renderAnrufe();
    if (typeof renderRueckrufe === 'function') renderRueckrufe(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
  }
  try { vxRefreshActiveDetailAfterAction({ recordId: opts.recordId || '', createdRecordId: opts.createdRecordId || '' }); } catch(e) {}
  if (targetId && typeof vxSetActiveRequestRow === 'function') {
    setTimeout(function(){ try { vxSetActiveRequestRow(targetId); } catch(e) {} }, 0);
  }
}

function openConfirmModal(config) {
  rememberOverlayFocusReturn('confirm-overlay');
  confirmModalBusy = false;
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('confirm-title');
  const subEl = document.getElementById('confirm-sub');
  const okBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-ok-btn');
  const modalEl = document.getElementById('confirm-modal');
  const checkboxWrap = document.getElementById('confirm-checkbox-wrap');
  const checkboxEl = document.getElementById('confirm-checkbox');
  const checkboxLabel = document.getElementById('confirm-checkbox-label');
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = (config && config.title) || 'Bitte bestätigen';
  if (subEl) subEl.textContent = (config && config.text) || 'Sind Sie sicher?';
  if (modalEl) {
    modalEl.classList.remove('confirm-tone-danger', 'confirm-tone-neutral', 'confirm-tone-primary');
    modalEl.classList.add('confirm-tone-' + ((config && config.tone) || 'primary'));
  }
  if (checkboxWrap && checkboxEl && checkboxLabel) {
    var hasCheckbox = !!(config && config.checkboxLabel);
    checkboxWrap.style.display = hasCheckbox ? 'flex' : 'none';
    checkboxEl.checked = !!(config && config.checkboxDefault);
    checkboxLabel.textContent = hasCheckbox ? String(config.checkboxLabel || '') : '';
  }
  if (okBtn) {
    okBtn.textContent = (config && config.confirmLabel) || 'Bestätigen';
    okBtn.classList.remove('danger', 'neutral', 'btn--primary', 'btn--danger', 'btn--neutral');
    if (config && config.tone === 'danger') okBtn.classList.add('btn--danger');
    else if (config && config.tone === 'neutral') okBtn.classList.add('btn--neutral');
    else okBtn.classList.add('btn--primary');
    okBtn.dataset.loadingLabel = (config && config.loadingLabel) || 'Bitte warten...';
    okBtn.disabled = false;
    okBtn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'false');
  }
  confirmModalAction = (config && typeof config.onConfirm === 'function') ? function() {
    var checked = !!(document.getElementById('confirm-checkbox') && document.getElementById('confirm-checkbox').checked);
    return config.onConfirm({ checkboxChecked: checked, archiveAfterClose: checked });
  } : null;
  const overlay = document.getElementById('confirm-overlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('open');
  setOverlayAriaHidden('confirm-overlay', false);
  syncOverlayScrollLock();
}

function closeConfirmModal() {
  if (confirmModalBusy) return;
  const overlay = document.getElementById('confirm-overlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('open');
  setOverlayAriaHidden('confirm-overlay', true);
  syncOverlayScrollLock();
  restoreOverlayFocus('confirm-overlay');
  confirmModalBusy = false;
  confirmModalAction = null;
  var checkboxWrap = document.getElementById('confirm-checkbox-wrap');
  var checkboxEl = document.getElementById('confirm-checkbox');
  if (checkboxWrap) checkboxWrap.style.display = 'none';
  if (checkboxEl) checkboxEl.checked = false;
  // [PATCH v2.40] is-loading auf Header-Buttons zurücksetzen beim Abbrechen
  var doneBtn = document.getElementById('vx-cd-qa-done');
  if (doneBtn && doneBtn.classList.contains('is-loading')) {
    doneBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
  }
}

async function runConfirmModalAction() {
  if (confirmModalBusy) return;
  const fn = confirmModalAction;
  if (typeof fn !== 'function') {
    closeConfirmModal();
    return;
  }
  const okBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-ok-btn');
  const originalLabel = okBtn ? okBtn.textContent : '';
  if (okBtn) {
    okBtn.disabled = true;
    okBtn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    okBtn.textContent = okBtn.dataset.loadingLabel || 'Bitte warten...';
  }
  confirmModalBusy = true;
  try {
    logManualTaskDoneFlow('confirm.submit', { hasAction: true });
    const result = await fn();
    if (result !== false) {
      confirmModalBusy = false;
      closeConfirmModal();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    toast(' ' + toManualTaskUserMessage(e, 'Aktion konnte nicht gespeichert werden.'));
  } finally {
    confirmModalBusy = false;
    if (okBtn) {
      okBtn.disabled = false;
    okBtn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'false');
      okBtn.textContent = originalLabel || 'Bestätigen';
    }
  }
}

function confirmClose(recordId, newStatus, rowElement) {
  if (normalizeStatus(newStatus) === CALL_STATUS.CLOSED) {
    confirmTaskDone(recordId, rowElement, 'status-dropdown');
    return;
  }
  openConfirmModal({
    title: 'Status aktualisieren?',
    text: 'Der Status dieses Eintrags wird aktualisiert.',
    confirmLabel: 'Speichern',
    loadingLabel: 'Speichere...',
    tone: 'primary',
    onConfirm: async function() {
      return await doStatusChange(recordId, newStatus, rowElement || null);
    }
  });
}

// kept for backward compat (cb-row dashboard buttons still reference this name)
function confirmCloseWithDropdownPreservation(recordId, newStatus, rowElement) {
  confirmClose(recordId, newStatus, rowElement);
}

async function doStatusChange(recordId, newStatus, rowElement) {
  if (hasKnownInactiveContract()) {
    toast(getRestrictedContractMessage('Aufgaben'), 'warning');
    logManualTaskDoneFlow('guard.blocked.contract-inactive', {
      recordId: String(recordId || ''),
      contractState: customerContractState
    });
    return false;
  }
  const normalizedStatus = normalizeStatus(newStatus);
  const isManualTask = (typeof vxIsManualTaskRecordId === 'function') ? vxIsManualTaskRecordId(recordId) : String(recordId || '').startsWith('case:');
  if (isManualTask) {
    logManualTaskDoneFlow('status-change.start', {
      recordId: String(recordId || ''),
      requestedStatus: String(newStatus || ''),
      normalizedStatus,
      isManualTask: true
    });
  }
  const row = rowElement || null;
  const sourceRecords = isManualTask ? (allManualTaskRecords || []) : (allRecords || []);
  const cached = (typeof vxResolveDprRecord === 'function')
    ? vxResolveDprRecord(recordId)
    : sourceRecords.find(r => String(r.id) === String(recordId));
  const currentStatus = normalizeStatus(cached && cached.fields ? (cached.fields.dashboard_status || cached.fields.status) : CALL_STATUS.NEW);

  if (currentStatus === normalizedStatus) {
    if (cached && cached.fields) cached.fields.dashboard_status = normalizedStatus;
    renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    renderAnrufe();
    renderRueckrufe(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    renderArchiv(allRecords);
    toast('Status bereits gesetzt');
    return true;
  }

  if (row) {
    row.style.transition = 'all .3s ease';
    if (isClosedStatus(normalizedStatus)) {
      row.style.opacity = '.5';
      row.style.background = '#F0FDF4';
      row.style.borderColor = '#BBF7D0';
    } else if ([CALL_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS, CALL_STATUS.FOLLOW_UP_SCHEDULED].includes(normalizedStatus)) {
      row.style.background = '#FFFBEB';
      row.style.borderColor = '#FDE68A';
    } else {
      row.style.opacity = '1';
      row.style.background = '';
      row.style.borderColor = '';
    }
    const secRow = row.querySelector('.call-secondary');
    if (secRow) {
      secRow.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(c => c.remove());
      const original = sourceRecords.find(r => String(r.id) === String(recordId));
      if (original && original.fields) {
        original.fields.dashboard_status = normalizedStatus;
        secRow.innerHTML = callCardBadgeHtml(original);
      }
    }
  }

  const icons = {
    [CALL_STATUS.NEW]:'Neu',
    [CALL_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS]:'In Bearbeitung',
    [CALL_STATUS.FOLLOW_UP_SCHEDULED]:'In Bearbeitung',
    [CALL_STATUS.CLOSED]:'Erledigt',
    [CALL_STATUS.ARCHIVED]:'Archiviert'
  };
  try {
    realtimeSuppressUntil = Date.now() + 2000; // Realtime unterdrücken VOR API-Call
    if (isManualTask) {
      const caseStatus = mapDashboardStatusToManualTaskDbStatus(normalizedStatus);
      logManualTaskDoneFlow('status-change.manual-mapping', {
        recordId: String(recordId || ''),
        normalizedStatus,
        mappedCaseStatus: caseStatus
      });
      const updated = await updateManualTaskStatus(recordId, caseStatus);
      const updatedRawId = String((updated && updated.fields && updated.fields.task_entity_id) || '').trim();
      const idx = (allManualTaskRecords || []).findIndex(function(r) {
        var f = (r && r.fields) || {};
        return String(r.id) === String(recordId) || String(f.task_entity_id || '') === String(recordId).replace(/^case:/,'') || (updatedRawId && String(f.task_entity_id || '') === updatedRawId);
      });
      if (idx >= 0) allManualTaskRecords[idx] = updated;
      var taskLifecyclePatch = { updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
      if (caseStatus === 'closed') {
        taskLifecyclePatch.completed_at = new Date().toISOString();
        taskLifecyclePatch.archived_at = null;
      } else if (caseStatus === 'archived') {
        taskLifecyclePatch.archived_at = new Date().toISOString();
      } else if (caseStatus === 'new') {
        taskLifecyclePatch.completed_at = null;
        taskLifecyclePatch.archived_at = null;
      }
      await vxBestEffortPatchTaskLifecycle(recordId, taskLifecyclePatch);
    } else {
      await applyStatusTransition(recordId, currentStatus, normalizedStatus);
      if (cached && cached.fields) {
        cached.fields.dashboard_status = normalizedStatus;
        if (isClosedStatus(normalizedStatus)) cached.fields.follow_up_at = null;
      }
    }
    renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    renderAnrufe();
    renderRueckrufe(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    renderArchiv(allRecords);
    toast(icons[normalizedStatus] || 'Status aktualisiert', isClosedStatus(normalizedStatus) ? 'success' : 'info');
    if (isClosedStatus(normalizedStatus) || normalizedStatus === CALL_STATUS.ARCHIVED) {
      if (typeof vxCloseAfterSuccessfulCompletion === 'function') setTimeout(vxCloseAfterSuccessfulCompletion, 120);
    }
    return true;
  } catch(e) {
    // [PATCH v2.21 — illegal call transition explizit abfangen]
    // Das Backend lehnt bestimmte Status-Übergänge mit 422 / "illegal call transition" ab.
    // Statt generischem Fehlertext: klare Erklärung + Reload-Option anbieten.
    var errMsg = String(e && e.message ? e.message : '').toLowerCase();
    var isIllegalTransition = errMsg.includes('illegal') || errMsg.includes('transition') ||
                              errMsg.includes('422') || errMsg.includes('cannot archive') ||
                              errMsg.includes('invalid status');
    if (isIllegalTransition) {
      toast('Status kann nicht geändert werden — bitte Seite neu laden.', 'warning');
      // Lokalen Status zurücksetzen damit UI nicht inkonsistent bleibt
      if (cached && cached.fields) {
        cached.fields.dashboard_status = currentStatus;
      }
    } else {
      toast('⚠ ' + toManualTaskUserMessage(e, 'Fehler beim Status-Update'));
    }
    if (row) { row.style.opacity='1'; row.style.background=''; row.style.borderColor=''; }
    return false;
  }
}


function directCall(recordId, encodedTarget) {
  const raw = decodeURIComponent(encodedTarget || '').trim();
  if (!raw) {
    toast('Keine Telefonnummer vorhanden');
    return;
  }
  pendingFollowupRecordId = recordId;
  pendingFollowupStartedAt = Date.now();
  pendingFollowupStatus = '';
  const href = /^tel:/i.test(raw) ? raw : ('tel:' + raw.replace(/\s/g,''));
  window.location.href = href;
}

function maybeOpenFollowup() {
  if (!pendingFollowupRecordId) return;
  if (Date.now() - pendingFollowupStartedAt > 10 * 60 * 1000) {
    pendingFollowupRecordId = null;
    return;
  }
  const rec = allRecords.find(r => r.id === pendingFollowupRecordId);
  if (!rec) return;
  openFollowup(rec.id, (rec.fields.caller_name || '').trim(), (rec.fields.notes_customer_voxera || '').trim(), rec.fields.dashboard_status || '', rec.fields.next_action || '', rec.fields.follow_up_at || '');
  pendingFollowupRecordId = null;
}

function openFollowupDirect(recordId, options) {
  // [v2.65] Auch Tasks (case:-Prefix) auflösen
  var rec = (typeof vxResolveDprRecord === 'function')
    ? vxResolveDprRecord(recordId)
    : allRecords.find(function(r){ return r.id === recordId; });
  if (!rec) return;
  var f = rec.fields || {};
  openFollowup(recordId, (f.caller_name || f.title || '').trim(), (f.notes_customer_voxera || f.note || f.notes || '').trim(), f.dashboard_status || '', f.next_action || '', f.follow_up_at || '', options || null);
}

function openFollowup(recordId, callerName, existingNotiz, currentStatus, nextAction, followUpAt, options) {
  rememberOverlayFocusReturn('followup-overlay');
  notizRecordId = recordId;
  followupCallerName = String(callerName || '').trim();
  var opts = options || {};
  var mode = String(opts.mode || 'callback').toLowerCase();
  if (mode !== 'due') mode = 'callback';
  followupModalMode = mode;
  const done = isClosedStatus(currentStatus);
  var hasExistingDue = !!String(followUpAt || '').trim();
  var titleEl = document.getElementById('followup-title');
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = (mode === 'due') ? (hasExistingDue ? 'Fälligkeit ändern' : 'Fälligkeit setzen') : 'Nachfassen planen';
  var subtitleEl = document.getElementById('followup-sub');
  if (subtitleEl) {
    subtitleEl.textContent = (mode === 'due')
      ? 'Lege fest, wann dieser Eintrag wieder fällig ist.'
      : 'Plane einen Rückruf oder Folgekontakt.';
  }
  document.getElementById('followup-input').value = existingNotiz || '';
  document.getElementById('followup-next-action').value = (mode === 'due') ? '' : (nextAction || '');
  document.getElementById('followup-datetime').value = fmtDateTimeLocal(followUpAt || '');
  var nextActionField = document.getElementById('followup-next-action-field');
  if (nextActionField) nextActionField.style.display = (mode === 'due') ? 'none' : '';
  const markComplete = document.getElementById('followup-mark-complete');
  if (markComplete) {
    markComplete.checked = false;
    var markRow = document.getElementById('followup-mark-row') || markComplete.closest('.followup-mark-row');
    if (markRow) markRow.style.display = (mode === 'due' || done) ? 'none' : '';
  }
  const lockWarning = document.getElementById('followup-locked-warning');
  const editableSection = document.getElementById('followup-editable');
  const saveBtn = document.getElementById('followup-save-btn');
  if (done) {
    // Erledigte Einträge bleiben abgeschlossen; ein neuer Rückruf wird als separate Aufgabe geplant.
    if (lockWarning) {
      lockWarning.style.display = 'block';
      lockWarning.childNodes[0].nodeValue = mode === 'due'
        ? 'Dieser Eintrag bleibt erledigt. Die Fälligkeit wird als neue geplante Aufgabe erstellt. '
        : 'Dieser Eintrag bleibt erledigt. Der Rückruf wird als neue geplante Aufgabe erstellt. ';
    }
  } else if (lockWarning) {
    lockWarning.style.display = 'none';
  }
  if (editableSection) {
    editableSection.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach(function(el){ el.disabled = false; });
  }
  if (saveBtn) {
    saveBtn.disabled = false;
    if (mode === 'due') saveBtn.textContent = 'Fälligkeit speichern';
    else saveBtn.textContent = done ? 'Rückruf erstellen' : 'Nachfassen speichern';
  }
  document.getElementById('followup-overlay').classList.add('open');
  setOverlayAriaHidden('followup-overlay', false);
  syncOverlayScrollLock();
}

function _completedWarningDismissed(recordId) {
  try { return !!localStorage.getItem('voxera_warn_dismissed_' + recordId); } catch(e) { return false; }
}


function rerenderFollowupMetaForCallRow(recordId) {
  if (!recordId) return;
  var rec = (allRecords || []).find(function(r) { return r && r.id === recordId; });
  if (!rec || !rec.fields) return;
  var followUpMetaText = buildFollowUpMetaText(rec, new Date());
  var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.call-row[data-id]')).filter(function(row) {
    return row && row.dataset && row.dataset.id === recordId;
  });
  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    var body = row.querySelector('.cr-body');
    if (!body) return;
    var summaryEl = body.querySelector('.call-summary');
    var existingLines = body.querySelectorAll('.followup-meta-line');
    existingLines.forEach(function(el) {
      if (!el.textContent || el.textContent.indexOf('Erledigt am') !== 0) el.remove();
    });
    if (!followUpMetaText) return;
    var metaEl = document.createElement('div');
    metaEl.className = 'followup-meta-line';
    metaEl.textContent = followUpMetaText;
    if (summaryEl) {
      var summaryParent = summaryEl.parentNode;
      if (summaryParent === body && summaryEl.nextSibling && summaryEl.nextSibling.parentNode === body) body.insertBefore(metaEl, summaryEl.nextSibling);
      else if (summaryParent && summaryEl.nextSibling && summaryEl.nextSibling.parentNode === summaryParent) summaryParent.insertBefore(metaEl, summaryEl.nextSibling);
      else if (summaryParent) summaryParent.appendChild(metaEl);
      else if (body && body.firstChild && body.firstChild.parentNode === body) body.insertBefore(metaEl, body.firstChild);
      else if (body) body.appendChild(metaEl);
    } else if (body && body.firstChild && body.firstChild.parentNode === body) body.insertBefore(metaEl, body.firstChild);
    else if (body) body.appendChild(metaEl);
  });
}

function dismissCompletedWarning() {
  const w = document.getElementById('followup-locked-warning');
  if (w) w.style.display = 'none';
  if (notizRecordId) {
    try { vxSafeLocalStorageSet('voxera_warn_dismissed_' + notizRecordId, '1'); } catch(e) {}
  }
}

function closeFollowup() {
  vxSetActionButtonLoading(document.getElementById('followup-save-btn'), false);
  document.getElementById('followup-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  setOverlayAriaHidden('followup-overlay', true);
  syncOverlayScrollLock();
  document.getElementById('followup-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('followup-next-action').value = '';
  document.getElementById('followup-datetime').value = '';
  followupCallerName = '';
  followupModalMode = 'callback';
  const mc = document.getElementById('followup-mark-complete');
  if (mc) {
    mc.checked = false;
    var mcRow = document.getElementById('followup-mark-row') || mc.closest('.followup-mark-row');
    if (mcRow) mcRow.style.display = '';
  }
  var nextActionField = document.getElementById('followup-next-action-field');
  if (nextActionField) nextActionField.style.display = '';
  const editableSection = document.getElementById('followup-editable');
  if (editableSection) {
    editableSection.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach(function(el){ el.disabled = false; });
  }
  restoreOverlayFocus('followup-overlay');
}

async function saveFollowup() {
  if (!notizRecordId) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('followup-save-btn');
  if (vxIsActionButtonSaving(btn)) return;
  const text = document.getElementById('followup-input').value.trim();
  const nextAction = document.getElementById('followup-next-action').value;
  const _followUpAtRaw = document.getElementById('followup-datetime').value;
  // [BUG FIX v2.52b] T00:00 bedeutet: Nutzer hat Datum gewählt aber keine Uhrzeit gesetzt.
  // Default-Zeit auf 09:00 setzen damit hasMeaningfulDueTime() die Uhrzeit erkennt
  // und in der Übersicht "Morgen, 09:00" statt nur "Morgen" anzeigt.
  const followUpAt = _followUpAtRaw && /T00:00$/.test(_followUpAtRaw)
    ? _followUpAtRaw.replace(/T00:00$/, 'T09:00')
    : _followUpAtRaw;
  const markComplete = document.getElementById('followup-mark-complete');
  vxSetActionButtonLoading(btn, true, 'Speichern...');

  const fields = {
    notes_customer_voxera: text,
    next_action: nextAction || null,
    follow_up_at: serializeFollowUpLocal(followUpAt) || null,
    mark_complete: !!(markComplete && markComplete.checked)
  };
  if (fields.mark_complete) fields.follow_up_at = null;

  try {
    var recordId = notizRecordId;
    var sourceRec = (typeof vxResolveDprRecord === 'function') ? vxResolveDprRecord(recordId) : null;
    if (!sourceRec && Array.isArray(allRecords)) {
      sourceRec = allRecords.find(function(r){ return r && String(r.id) === String(recordId); });
    }
    var sourceFields = (sourceRec && sourceRec.fields) || {};
    var sourceLifecycle = (sourceRec && typeof vxGetEntryLifecycleStatus === 'function') ? vxGetEntryLifecycleStatus(sourceRec) : '';
    var sourceIsDone = sourceLifecycle === 'done' || sourceLifecycle === 'archived' || isClosedStatus(sourceFields.dashboard_status || sourceFields.status || currentStatus || '');
    if (sourceIsDone && followUpAt && !fields.mark_complete) {
      var dueAt = String(followUpAt || '').slice(0, 10);
      var dueTime = String(followUpAt || '').slice(11, 16) || '09:00';
      var caller = String(sourceFields.caller_name || sourceFields.company_name || followupCallerName || '').trim();
      var phone = String(sourceFields.caller_phone || sourceFields.phone_number || sourceFields.tel_link || '').trim();
      var createdTask = await createManualTask({
        title: caller ? ('Rückruf für ' + caller) : 'Rückruf planen',
        type: 'callback',
        due_at: dueAt,
        due_time: dueTime,
        status: 'new',
        note: text || nextAction || sourceFields.call_summary || sourceFields.notes_customer_voxera || null,
        phone: phone || null,
        source_type: 'call',
        source_call_id: String(recordId || '')
      });
      if (createdTask) {
        allManualTaskRecords = Array.isArray(allManualTaskRecords) ? allManualTaskRecords : [];
        allManualTaskRecords.unshift(createdTask);
        window.allManualTaskRecords = allManualTaskRecords;
      }
      vxAfterActionSuccess({
        createdRecordId: createdTask && createdTask.id ? String(createdTask.id) : '',
        modal: 'followup'
      });
      notizRecordId = null;
      toast('Rückruf als neue Aufgabe geplant');
      vxScheduleSingleDataRefresh(500);
      return;
    }
    await patchCallRecord(recordId, fields);
    vxNotifMarkReadByRecord(recordId);

    var localFields = {
      notes_customer_voxera: fields.notes_customer_voxera,
      next_action: fields.next_action,
      follow_up_at: fields.follow_up_at
    };
    if (fields.mark_complete) localFields.follow_up_at = null;
    var localRec = vxUpdateLocalCallRecord(recordId, localFields);

    if (fields.mark_complete) {
      await applyStatusTransition(recordId, CALL_STATUS.NEW, CALL_STATUS.CLOSED);
      vxUpdateLocalCallRecord(recordId, {
        dashboard_status: CALL_STATUS.CLOSED,
        completed_at: (localRec && localRec.fields && localRec.fields.completed_at) || new Date().toISOString(),
        follow_up_at: null
      });
    }

    rerenderFollowupMetaForCallRow(recordId);
    vxAfterActionSuccess({ recordId: recordId, modal: 'followup' });
    notizRecordId = null;

    toast(fields.mark_complete ? 'Erledigt' : followUpAt ? 'Rückruf geplant' : 'Gespeichert');

    if (fields.mark_complete && typeof vxCloseAfterSuccessfulCompletion === 'function') vxCloseAfterSuccessfulCompletion();
    vxScheduleSingleDataRefresh(500);
  } catch(e) {
    const detail = e && e.message ? String(e.message) : '';
    toast(detail ? 'Speichern fehlgeschlagen: ' + detail : 'Speichern fehlgeschlagen');
    // Error contract: keep modal open and preserve inputs.
  } finally {
    vxSetActionButtonLoading(btn, false);
  }
}

  if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
    setTimeout(maybeOpenFollowup, 250);
    safeLoadData();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('focus', () => {
  setTimeout(maybeOpenFollowup, 250);
  safeLoadData();
});
window.addEventListener('online', () => safeLoadData());

// Session-safe data loader - checks session before loading, avoids false logouts
async function safeLoadData() {
  if (document.getElementById('app').style.display === 'none') return; // not logged in
  if (realtimeSuppressUntil > 0 && Date.now() < realtimeSuppressUntil) return; // Mutation läuft gerade
  const sb = getSupabaseAuthClient();
  if (!sb) return;
  try {
    var result = await sb.auth.getSession();
    if (!result.data.session) {
      // Session expired - try to recover silently
      vxDebugLog('Session check: no active session');
      return; // Don't force logout - Supabase will auto-refresh if possible
    }
    loadData();
  } catch(e) {
    vxDebugLog('Session check error:', e.message);
  }
}

function vxRefreshOperationalViews(records, manualRecords) {
  var callRecords = records || allRecords || [];
  var taskRecords = manualRecords || allManualTaskRecords || [];
  try { if (typeof renderDashboard === 'function') renderDashboard(callRecords, taskRecords); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Voxera SaveFlow] renderDashboard skipped', e); }
  try { if (typeof renderAnrufe === 'function') renderAnrufe(); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Voxera SaveFlow] renderAnrufe skipped', e); }
  try { if (typeof renderRueckrufe === 'function') renderRueckrufe(callRecords, taskRecords); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Voxera SaveFlow] renderRueckrufe skipped', e); }
  try { if (typeof renderDashPriorityList === 'function') renderDashPriorityList(callRecords, taskRecords); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Voxera SaveFlow] renderDashPriorityList skipped', e); }
}

===== vxAfterActionSuccess | LINES 24672-24693 =====
function vxAfterActionSuccess(options) {
  var opts = options || {};
  var targetId = String(opts.createdRecordId || opts.recordId || '').trim();
  if (targetId) {
    window._vxActiveRecordId = targetId;
    window._vxPendingHighlightRecordId = targetId;
  }
  if (opts.closeModal !== false) {
    if (opts.modal === 'manual-task' && typeof closeManualTaskModal === 'function') closeManualTaskModal();
    else if (opts.modal === 'followup' && typeof closeFollowup === 'function') closeFollowup();
  }
  if (typeof vxRefreshOperationalViews === 'function') vxRefreshOperationalViews(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
  else {
    if (typeof renderDashboard === 'function') renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    if (typeof renderAnrufe === 'function') renderAnrufe();
    if (typeof renderRueckrufe === 'function') renderRueckrufe(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
  }
  try { vxRefreshActiveDetailAfterAction({ recordId: opts.recordId || '', createdRecordId: opts.createdRecordId || '' }); } catch(e) {}
  if (targetId && typeof vxSetActiveRequestRow === 'function') {
    setTimeout(function(){ try { vxSetActiveRequestRow(targetId); } catch(e) {} }, 0);
  }
}

        return String(r.id) === String(recordId) || String(f.task_entity_id || '') === String(recordId).replace(/^case:/,'') || (updatedRawId && String(f.task_entity_id || '') === updatedRawId);
      });
      if (idx >= 0) allManualTaskRecords[idx] = updated;
      var taskLifecyclePatch = { updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
      if (caseStatus === 'closed') {
        taskLifecyclePatch.completed_at = new Date().toISOString();
        taskLifecyclePatch.archived_at = null;
      } else if (caseStatus === 'archived') {
        taskLifecyclePatch.archived_at = new Date().toISOString();
      } else if (caseStatus === 'new') {
        taskLifecyclePatch.completed_at = null;
        taskLifecyclePatch.archived_at = null;
      }
      await vxBestEffortPatchTaskLifecycle(recordId, taskLifecyclePatch);
    } else {
      await applyStatusTransition(recordId, currentStatus, normalizedStatus);
      if (cached && cached.fields) {
        cached.fields.dashboard_status = normalizedStatus;
        if (isClosedStatus(normalizedStatus)) cached.fields.follow_up_at = null;
      }
    }
    renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    renderAnrufe();
    renderRueckrufe(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    renderArchiv(allRecords);
    toast(icons[normalizedStatus] || 'Status aktualisiert', isClosedStatus(normalizedStatus) ? 'success' : 'info');
    if (isClosedStatus(normalizedStatus) || normalizedStatus === CALL_STATUS.ARCHIVED) {
      if (typeof vxCloseAfterSuccessfulCompletion === 'function') setTimeout(vxCloseAfterSuccessfulCompletion, 120);
    }
    return true;
  } catch(e) {
    // [PATCH v2.21 — illegal call transition explizit abfangen]
    // Das Backend lehnt bestimmte Status-Übergänge mit 422 / "illegal call transition" ab.
    // Statt generischem Fehlertext: klare Erklärung + Reload-Option anbieten.
    var errMsg = String(e && e.message ? e.message : '').toLowerCase();
    var isIllegalTransition = errMsg.includes('illegal') || errMsg.includes('transition') ||
                              errMsg.includes('422') || errMsg.includes('cannot archive') ||
                              errMsg.includes('invalid status');
    if (isIllegalTransition) {
      toast('Status kann nicht geändert werden — bitte Seite neu laden.', 'warning');
      // Lokalen Status zurücksetzen damit UI nicht inkonsistent bleibt
      if (cached && cached.fields) {
        cached.fields.dashboard_status = currentStatus;
      }
    } else {
      toast('⚠ ' + toManualTaskUserMessage(e, 'Fehler beim Status-Update'));
    }
    if (row) { row.style.opacity='1'; row.style.background=''; row.style.borderColor=''; }
    return false;
  }
}

===== saveManualRequest | LINES 25450-25487 =====
function saveManualRequest() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('manual-request-save-btn');
  if (vxIsActionButtonSaving(btn)) return;
  vxSetActionButtonLoading(btn, true, 'Erstelle...');
  try {
  var name = String(document.getElementById('manual-request-name').value || '').trim();
  if (!name) { toast('Bitte Name / Firma ausfüllen.'); return; }
  var phone = String(document.getElementById('manual-request-phone').value || '').trim();
  var category = String(document.getElementById('manual-request-category').value || 'anruf');
  var priority = String(document.getElementById('manual-request-priority').value || 'hot');
  var summary = String(document.getElementById('manual-request-summary').value || '').trim();
  var forceInbox = !!document.getElementById('manual-request-inbox').checked;
  var nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  var rec = {
    id: 'manual_req_' + Date.now(),
    fields: {
      caller_name: name,
      company_name: name,
      phone_number: phone || null,
      category: category,
      lead_quality: priority,
      call_summary: summary || 'Manuell erfasst',
      dashboard_status: forceInbox ? 'new' : 'in_progress',
      created_at: nowIso,
      updated_at: nowIso
    }
  };
  allRecords = Array.isArray(allRecords) ? allRecords : [];
  allRecords.unshift(rec);
  closeManualRequestModal();
  renderDashboard(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
  renderAnrufe();
  vxUpdateAnfragenCount();
  toast('Anfrage erstellt');
  } finally {
    vxSetActionButtonLoading(btn, false);
  }
}

  vxSetupMorphingBanner();
}

function showTaskDetail(taskId) {
  taskId = String(taskId || '').trim();
  if (!taskId) {
    console.warn('[detail] blocked open without id', { source: 'showTaskDetail' });
    if (typeof vxForceCloseCallDetail === 'function') vxForceCloseCallDetail('showTaskDetail:missing-id');
    return;
  }
  var rec = vxFindManualTaskRecord(taskId);
  if (!rec) { vxTaskDetailNotify('Aufgabe nicht gefunden', 'warning'); return; }
  var page = document.getElementById('call-detail-page');
  if (!page) return;
  if (typeof vxResetCallDetailViewState === 'function') vxResetCallDetailViewState();
  window._vxCurrentDetailType = 'task';
  window._vxCurrentCallId = null;
  window._vxCurrentTaskId = String(taskId);
  window._vxActiveRecordId = String(taskId);
  page.classList.add('is-open');
  page.dataset.vxDetailType = 'task';
  page.dataset.vxDetailId = String(taskId);

  // [v2.66] Dieselbe Split-Logik wie showCallDetail:
  // Im Anfragen-Tab auf Desktop → Split-Panel, sonst Fullscreen
  var splitRight = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-right');
  var splitEmpty = document.getElementById('anrufe-split-empty');
  var anrufeTabActive = document.getElementById('tab-anrufe') &&
    document.getElementById('tab-anrufe').classList.contains('active');
  var useSplitDetail = anrufeTabActive && splitRight && window.innerWidth >= 768;

  if (useSplitDetail) {
    if (!splitRight.contains(page)) splitRight.appendChild(page);
    page.classList.remove('is-fullscreen');
    if (splitEmpty) splitEmpty.style.display = 'none';
    page.style.position = 'absolute';
    page.style.top = '0';
    page.style.left = '0';
    page.style.right = '0';
    page.style.bottom = '0';
    page.style.zIndex = '10';
    page.style.display = 'block';
    page.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    page.style.overflowY = '';
    var _swSplit = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
    if (_swSplit) {
      _swSplit.style.overflowY = 'auto';
      _swSplit.style.overflowX = 'hidden';
      _swSplit.style.height = '100%';
      _swSplit.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
      _swSplit.style.width = '100%';
    }
  } else {
    // App-Shell Detailmodus (Header/Nav bleiben sichtbar)
    if (splitRight && splitRight.contains(page)) document.body.appendChild(page);
    page.classList.add('is-fullscreen');
    page.style.position = 'fixed';
    if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
      page.style.top = '60px';
      page.style.left = '0';
      page.style.right = '0';
      page.style.bottom = 'calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))';
      page.style.zIndex = '44';
    } else {
      page.style.top = '0';
      page.style.left = '232px';
      page.style.right = '0';
      page.style.bottom = '0';
      page.style.zIndex = '39';
    }
    page.style.display = 'block';
    page.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    page.style.overflowY = 'hidden';
    var _swFull = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
    if (_swFull) { _swFull.style.minHeight = ''; _swFull.style.height = '100%'; _swFull.style.overflowY = 'auto'; _swFull.style.boxSizing = 'border-box'; _swFull.style.width = '100%'; }
    vxSetScrollLock('call-detail-page', true);
  }

  page.scrollTop = 0;
  var wrap = document.getElementById('call-detail-scroll-wrap');
  if (wrap) wrap.scrollTop = 0;
  var contentEl = document.getElementById('call-detail-content');
  if (contentEl) contentEl.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--slate);">Lade…</div>';
  var phone = vxTaskDetailPhone(rec.fields || {});
  if (phone && typeof buildCallHistory === 'function') {
    buildCallHistory(phone).then(function(history) { renderTaskDetailPage(rec, history || []); }).catch(function(err) {
      console.warn('[task-detail] history error:', err);
      renderTaskDetailPage(rec, []);
    });
  } else {
    renderTaskDetailPage(rec, []);
  }
  // [v2.67] sp-active auf anrufe-list UND dash-priority-list
  document.querySelectorAll('#anrufe-list .dpr-card, #dash-priority-list .dpr-card').forEach(function(c) {
    c.classList.toggle('sp-active', c.dataset.id === String(taskId));
  });
  try { window.location.hash = '#task/' + encodeURIComponent(String(taskId)); } catch(e) {}
}

function openDetail(recordId) {
  const recForRouting = allRecords.find(r => r.id === recordId) || allManualTaskRecords.find(r => r.id === recordId);
  if (!recForRouting) return;
  if (isManualTaskRecord(recForRouting)) { showTaskDetail(recordId); return; }
  if (typeof showCallDetail === 'function') { showCallDetail(recordId); return; }
  rememberOverlayFocusReturn('detail-overlay');
  const rec = allRecords.find(r => r.id === recordId) || allManualTaskRecords.find(r => r.id === recordId);
  if (!rec) return;
  const f = rec.fields || {};
  const isManual = isManualTaskRecord(rec);
  const phone = (f.phone_number || f.caller_phone || '').trim();
  const tel = (f.tel_link || (phone ? ('tel:' + phone.replace(/\s/g,'')) : '')).trim();
  const detailMetaParts = [];
  if (f.company_name && !isDashLikePlaceholder(f.company_name)) detailMetaParts.push(f.company_name);
  const createdLabel = fmtDate(getRecordTimestamp(rec));
  if (createdLabel) detailMetaParts.push(createdLabel);
  const renderDetailLine = function(label, value) {
    const text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
    if (!text || isDashLikePlaceholder(text)) return '';
    return '<div class="detail-line"><span>' + escHtml(label) + '</span><span>' + escHtml(text) + '</span></div>';
  };
  document.getElementById('detail-heading').textContent = isManual ? (f.title || 'Aufgabe') : (getCallDisplayName(f) || 'Call-Detail');
  document.getElementById('detail-sub').textContent = detailMetaParts.join(' · ');
  const infoTitle = isManual ? 'Aufgabe' : 'Zusammenfassung';
  const infoText = isManual ? (f.note || f.call_summary || 'Keine Notiz vorhanden.') : (f.call_summary || 'Keine Zusammenfassung vorhanden.');
  document.getElementById('detail-content').innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;">

      <!-- Badges + Summary -->
      <div style="padding:0;">
        <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px;">${callCardBadgeHtml(rec, { includeMetaQuality: true })}</div>
        <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--slate2);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;margin-bottom:6px;">${escHtml(infoTitle)}</div>
        <div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.65;">${escHtml(infoText)}</div>
        ${f.notes_customer_voxera ? `<div style="margin-top:10px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--surface2);border:0.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink2)"><span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--slate2);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;">Interne Notiz</span>${escHtml(f.notes_customer_voxera)}</div>` : ''}
      </div>

      <!-- Aktionen -->
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;padding-top:12px;border-top:0.5px solid var(--line);">
        ${tel ? `<a class="btn btn--primary" href="${tel}" onclick="directCall('${rec.id}','${encodeURIComponent(tel)}')">
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M6.6 10.8c1.4 2.8 3.8 5.1 6.6 6.6l2.2-2.2c.3-.3.7-.4 1-.2 1.1.4 2.3.6 3.6.6.6 0 1 .4 1 1V20c0 .6-.4 1-1 1C10.6 21 3 13.4 3 4c0-.6.4-1 1-1h3.5c.6 0 1 .4 1 1 0 1.3.2 2.5.6 3.6.1.3 0 .7-.2 1L6.6 10.8z"/></svg>
          Anrufen
        </a>` : ''}
        ${!isManual ? `<button class="btn btn--secondary" onclick="closeDetail(); openFollowupDirect('${rec.id}')">Nachfassen</button>` : ''}
        ${!isManual ? `<button class="btn btn--secondary" onclick="closeDetail(); openNotiz('${rec.id}','${encodeURIComponent(f.notes_customer_voxera||'')}','${encodeURIComponent(f.caller_name||'')}')">Notiz</button>` : ''}

function openNotizFromBtn(btn) {
  const id = btn.getAttribute('data-id');
  const notiz = decodeURIComponent(btn.getAttribute('data-notiz') || '');
  const name = decodeURIComponent(btn.getAttribute('data-name') || '');
  openNotiz(id, notiz, name);
}

function openNotiz(recordId, existingNotiz, callerName) {
  rememberOverlayFocusReturn('notiz-overlay');
  notizRecordId = recordId;
  let safeName = callerName || '';
  let safeNotiz = existingNotiz || '';
  try { safeName = decodeURIComponent(safeName); } catch(e) {}
  try { safeNotiz = decodeURIComponent(safeNotiz); } catch(e) {}
  document.getElementById('notiz-sub').textContent = safeName ? 'Anrufer: ' + safeName : '';
  const existEl = document.getElementById('notiz-existing');
  const text = (safeNotiz || '').trim();
  if (text) {
    existEl.innerHTML = '<strong>Aktuelle Notiz:</strong> ' + text;
    existEl.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    existEl.style.display = 'none';
  }
  const input = document.getElementById('notiz-input');
  input.value = text;
  document.getElementById('notiz-save-btn').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('notiz-save-btn').textContent = 'Speichern';
  document.getElementById('notiz-overlay').classList.add('open');
  setOverlayAriaHidden('notiz-overlay', false);
  syncOverlayScrollLock();
  setTimeout(() => { input.focus(); input.setSelectionRange(input.value.length, input.value.length); }, 150);
}

function closeNotiz() {
  vxSetActionButtonLoading(document.getElementById('notiz-save-btn'), false);
  document.getElementById('notiz-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  setOverlayAriaHidden('notiz-overlay', true);
  syncOverlayScrollLock();
  document.getElementById('notiz-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('notiz-existing').style.display = 'none';
  notizRecordId = null;
  restoreOverlayFocus('notiz-overlay');
}

async function saveNotiz() {
  if (!notizRecordId) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('notiz-save-btn');
  if (vxIsActionButtonSaving(btn)) return;
  const text = document.getElementById('notiz-input').value.trim();
  vxSetActionButtonLoading(btn, true, 'Speichern...');
  const recordId = notizRecordId;
  const rec = (allRecords || []).find(function(r){ return r && String(r.id) === String(recordId); });
  const currentStatus = rec && rec.fields ? normalizeStatus(rec.fields.dashboard_status) : CALL_STATUS.NEW;
  try {
    await patchCallRecord(recordId, { notes_customer_voxera: text });
    vxUpdateLocalCallRecord(recordId, { notes_customer_voxera: text });
    if (currentStatus === CALL_STATUS.NEW) {
      await applyStatusTransition(recordId, currentStatus, CALL_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS);
      vxUpdateLocalCallRecord(recordId, { dashboard_status: CALL_STATUS.IN_PROGRESS });
    }
    vxRefreshOperationalViews(allRecords, allManualTaskRecords);
    closeNotiz();
    toast('Notiz gespeichert');
    vxScheduleSingleDataRefresh(600);
  } catch(e) {
    const detail = e && e.message ? String(e.message) : '';
    toast(detail ? 'Speichern fehlgeschlagen: ' + detail : 'Speichern fehlgeschlagen');
    // Error contract: keep modal open and preserve inputs.
  } finally {
    vxSetActionButtonLoading(btn, false);
  }
}

document.getElementById('notiz-input').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.metaKey) saveNotiz();
});

(function initOverlayEscapeHandling(){
  if (window.__VOXERA_OVERLAY_ESC_BOUND__) return;
  window.__VOXERA_OVERLAY_ESC_BOUND__ = true;
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    var active = document.activeElement;
    if (active && active.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') {
      active.blur();
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    if (confirmModalBusy && document.getElementById('confirm-overlay').classList.contains('open')) return;
    if (document.getElementById('confirm-overlay').classList.contains('open')) { closeConfirmModal(); return; }
    if (document.getElementById('manual-task-overlay').classList.contains('open')) { closeManualTaskModal(); return; }
    if (document.getElementById('followup-overlay').classList.contains('open')) { closeFollowup(); return; }
    if (document.getElementById('notiz-overlay').classList.contains('open')) { closeNotiz(); return; }
    if (document.getElementById('detail-overlay').classList.contains('open')) { closeDetail(); }
  });
})();
